artillery.body: Leonardo developed and recently presented a new artillery system centered on a fully automated turret, including an automated loading and completion system for 155mm shells. The system is intended for experimentation and evaluation, with initial firings conducted since October.
artillery.impact: The automated loading and completion system enhances operational efficiency and reduces manpower requirements for artillery units, aligning with the Italian Army's need for advanced 155mm self-propelled howitzers.

artillery.t: BAE Systems develops new 155mm extended range ammo
artillery.body: BAE Systems Land UK developed new 155mm ammunition with an extended range and tail-firing unit. It will enter serial production within 30 months.
artillery.impact: This new ammunition offers enhanced range and accuracy, potentially improving artillery capabilities for both domestic and export markets.

artillery.t: ERAP extends 155mm range to 60-70 km
artillery.body: The Indian Army is developing an Enhanced Range Artillery Projectile (ERAP) to extend the range of its 155mm artillery systems to 60-70 km. ERAP integrates advanced rocket, mortar, and base bleed technologies.
artillery.impact: ERAP significantly enhances the firepower and operational reach of Indian artillery, providing a decisive edge in deep strike capabilities.

artillery.t: Sherpa Light A2M with 120mm rifled mortar unveiled
artillery.body: Arquus unveiled the Sherpa Light A2M, featuring a 120mm rifled mortar from Thales, at EuroSatory 2022. The system is three times more precise than smoothbore mortars and uses fewer shots for similar operational effects.
artillery.impact: The enhanced precision and efficiency of the Sherpa Light A2M could significantly improve artillery effectiveness and reduce ammunition consumption.

artillery.t: K9 Vajra-T localization level raised to 60%
artillery.body: Larsen & Toubro has raised the localization level of the K9 Vajra-T self-propelled howitzer to 60% for the second batch, up from over 50% in the first batch.
artillery.impact: This increase in localization enhances India's domestic manufacturing capabilities and reduces dependency on foreign suppliers.

artillery.t: Developed M454 S-HE 155mm artillery projectile
artillery.body: Elbit Systems developed the M454 S-HE, a 155mm artillery projectile with advanced Controlled Fragmentation technology. It is designed to increase effectiveness and reduce collateral damage.
artillery.impact: The M454 S-HE enhances artillery precision and effectiveness, reducing unintended damage and improving operational flexibility.

artillery.t: HIMARS FLEX introduced with two-pod launcher design
artillery.body: Lockheed Martin introduced the HIMARS FLEX with a two-pod launcher design, doubling offensive output and enhancing tactical flexibility. The new system addresses previous criticisms and supports mixed munition configurations.
artillery.impact: The HIMARS FLEX significantly enhances artillery capabilities by doubling the number of rockets or guided missiles it can launch, improving both offensive capacity and tactical adaptability.

artillery.t: BAE Systems delivers Bofors 155mm BONUS ammunition
artillery.body: BAE Systems has secured a contract to deliver Bofors 155mm BONUS ammunition to the Swedish Army, with production at their facility in Karlskoga, Sweden. The BONUS system, developed in cooperation with Nexter, deploys two sensor-fused munitions from a single shell.
artillery.impact: The BONUS ammunition provides a significant advantage over traditional rounds due to its higher mission success rate per round, enhancing the Swedish Army's artillery capabilities.

artillery.t: Nammo developing 155mm ramjet artillery round
artillery.body: Nammo is developing a 155mm artillery round with ramjet propulsion, expected to have its first flight test in 2019/2020 and operational by 2023-2024. The round uses solid hydrocarbon fuel and an advanced fly-out simulator to study its flight trajectories.
artillery.impact: The ramjet propulsion could significantly extend the range and speed of artillery rounds, providing a tactical advantage on the battlefield.

artillery.t: CAESAR 6X6 MkII with 155mm system developed
artillery.body: The CAESAR 6X6 MkII, a new version of the artillery system, was developed with a 155mm artillery system. DGA ordered its development in 2021 for the French Army.
artillery.impact: The MkII version, featuring a new chassis and advanced capabilities, strengthens Nexter's position in the global artillery market.

artillery.t: BAE Systems tests guided Sub-Caliber Long-Range Projectile
artillery.body: BAE Systems successfully tested a guided Sub-Caliber Long-Range Projectile, designed to defeat long-range targets and advance cannon artillery capabilities. The projectile is part of the U.S. Army’s XM1155 Extended Range Artillery Projectile program.
artillery.impact: This development enhances the Army's precision fires capabilities, addressing modernization goals for long-range engagements.

artillery.t: Nexter develops 155mm KATANA guided shell
artillery.body: Nexter has developed the KATANA, a 155mm guided shell that can be fired from all 52 calibre artillery systems. It features a specific architecture allowing for close support and multi-mode programmable rocket capabilities.
artillery.impact: KATANA enhances artillery precision and flexibility, enabling effective engagement of various targets and providing close support in diverse combat scenarios.

artillery.t: Leonardo developing 120/L55 high-pressure gun
artillery.body: Leonardo is developing a 120/L55 high-pressure gun at its La Spezia site. The gun is designed to be compatible with the turret of the upgraded Ariete C2 MBT and new-generation infantry vehicles.
artillery.impact: This development enhances the firepower and versatility of modern MBTs and infantry vehicles, providing a significant tactical advantage.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates new 155-mm Waffenanlage L60
artillery.body: Rheinmetall showcased its new 155-mm Waffenanlage L60 at Eurosatory 2026, highlighting its capabilities in artillery systems. The system is set for its first live firing demonstration in 2026.
artillery.impact: The introduction of the L60 underscores Rheinmetall's leadership in 155-mm artillery systems, offering advanced capabilities that could influence modern warfare tactics.

artillery.t: Saab to develop and maintain artillery and weapon locating capability
artillery.body: Saab received an order to develop and maintain Sweden's artillery and weapon locating capability, including the Giraffe 4A radar and Arthur system life extension.
artillery.impact: This development enhances Sweden's long-range surveillance and threat detection capabilities, crucial for handling existing and future security challenges.

artillery.t: K9/K10 demonstrated compatibility with US munitions
artillery.body: Hanwha Defense successfully demonstrated the K9 155mm Self-propelled Howitzer and K10 Ammunition Supply Vehicle's compatibility with US munitions at Yuma Proving Ground. The demonstration was part of a CRADA with the US Army.
artillery.impact: This demonstration enhances Hanwha's credibility in the North American market by showcasing the K9/K10's interoperability with US military systems, potentially opening up new export opportunities.

artillery.t: Trajan 155/52 tested in extreme conditions
artillery.body: Nexter's Trajan 155/52 was tested in extreme climatic conditions for firing and mobility. The prototype includes 40% Indian-origin components.
artillery.impact: The successful testing of Trajan 155/52 in harsh conditions and its Indian content indicate readiness for the Indian Army's Towed Gun System program.

artillery.t: DAC cleared bulk production of 18 indigenous Dhanush artillery guns
artillery.body: The DAC approved the bulk production of 18 Dhanush artillery guns, an upgraded version of the 155 mm howitzer, to be manufactured in India. The guns will be produced at a cost of $1.8 million per piece by the Ordnance Factory Board.
artillery.impact: This decision supports India's self-reliance in artillery production and enhances the capability of the Indian Army with domestically developed and manufactured artillery systems.

artillery.t: Raytheon demonstrated autonomous mobile launcher vehicle
artillery.body: Raytheon demonstrated an autonomous mobile launcher vehicle at Project Convergence, showcasing its ability to operate in various conditions and terrains. The vehicle uses a new missile developed for the Joint Reduced Range Rocket program.
artillery.impact: The demonstration highlights the potential for autonomous artillery systems to enhance operational flexibility and efficiency, aligning with the U.S. Army's future fires requirements.

artillery.t: GMARS rocket artillery system presented
artillery.body: Rheinmetall and Lockheed Martin presented the GMARS rocket artillery system at Eurosatory 2024. The GMARS is a new rocket artillery system designed for future battlefields.
artillery.impact: The GMARS system represents a significant advancement in artillery technology, offering enhanced capabilities for long-range precision strikes.

artillery.t: NORA B-52 155mm self-propelled howitzer demonstrated
artillery.body: The Serbian Army has fielded the NORA B-52, a 155mm self-propelled howitzer, which has been in service since 2007. The system includes advanced features like a computerized fire control system and multiple rounds simultaneous impact capability.
artillery.impact: The NORA B-52 has significantly enhanced the Serbian Armed Forces' ability to provide reliable and accurate fire support, improving overall combat readiness.

artillery.t: Elbit Systems develops 120mm Mortar System
artillery.body: Elbit Systems has developed a 120mm Mortar System designed for modern military operations, providing versatile fire support for infantry and mechanized forces.
artillery.impact: The system's mobility and adaptability, with weights ranging from 144 kg to 440 kg and the ability to be towed by light vehicles, enhance its operational flexibility and effectiveness.

artillery.t: CAESAR 6X6 MkII with 460 hp engine and new chassis
artillery.body: Nexter developed the CAESAR 6X6 MkII with a 460 hp engine and new chassis, enhancing mobility and crew protection. Lithuania will participate in developing its national configuration.
artillery.impact: The MkII's enhanced mobility and protection make it more versatile and safer for crews, likely increasing its appeal in export markets.

artillery.t: Hanwha Aerospace showcased a laser cannon concept
artillery.body: Hanwha Aerospace demonstrated a concept for a laser cannon at the Korea Army International Defense Industry Exhibition 2024. The concept is aimed at countering drones and other unmanned systems.
artillery.impact: The laser cannon concept represents a significant advancement in directed energy weapons for defense against unmanned aerial threats.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall and DEVCOM signed CRDA to extend cannon range
artillery.body: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition and DEVCOM signed a CRDA to extend the range of existing cannon artillery systems, indicating ongoing R&D in artillery technology.
artillery.impact: This CRDA aims to enhance the long-range precision capabilities of artillery systems, aligning with the US Army's modernization efforts.

artillery.t: Hanwha manufactures K9 self-propelled 155mm howitzer
artillery.body: Hanwha Corp. manufactures the K9 self-propelled 155mm howitzer, which is equipped with advanced mobility systems. This artillery system is a key product for Hanwha Corp., enhancing its reputation in the global defense market.
artillery.impact: The K9 howitzer's advanced mobility and firepower capabilities strengthen Hanwha's competitive position in the global artillery market.

artillery.t: EURENCO developed modular artillery head
artillery.body: EURENCO developed a modular artillery head that can be assembled in various configurations. This head can penetrate up to 800 mm of armored steel and can be used for both offensive strikes and anti-drone defense.
artillery.impact: The modular design allows for flexible and adaptable use in different combat scenarios, enhancing the effectiveness of artillery systems.

artillery.t: NM269 155mm artillery ammunition developed
artillery.body: NAMMO developed the NM269 155mm artillery ammunition, which is safer for soldiers to handle and transport. NDMA procured this ammunition for use with K9 VIDAR howitzers.
artillery.impact: The safer handling and transport of NM269 enhances operational safety and efficiency for NDMA's artillery units.

artillery.t: X-Fire platform for Chunmoo family missile compatibility
artillery.body: Thales and Hanwha Aerospace signed an LOI to make Chunmoo family missiles compatible with Thales' X-Fire launch platform, a system designed for long-range ammunition.
artillery.impact: This cooperation enhances interoperability and precision in long-range artillery systems, strengthening European and South Korean defense ties.

artillery.t: developing new technology to boost 155mm Assegai range over 155km
artillery.body: Rheinmetall Denel Munition is developing a new technology to extend the range of its 155mm Assegai projectiles beyond 155km, enhancing its long-range artillery capabilities.
artillery.impact: This development significantly extends the operational range of artillery systems, providing strategic advantages in long-range engagements.

artillery.t: 4th Regiment, Royal Australian Artillery conducted tactical field exercise with AS9 Huntsman 155mm SPH
artillery.body: The 4th Regiment, Royal Australian Artillery conducted a tactical field exercise using the AS9 Huntsman 155mm self-propelled howitzers manufactured locally. This exercise demonstrated the operational readiness of the AS9 SPH in a tactical setting.
artillery.impact: The field exercise signifies the successful integration and operational capability of the AS9 Huntsman in the Australian military, enhancing its artillery capabilities.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall develops MK20 Rh202 automatic cannon
artillery.body: Rheinmetall is developing the MK20 Rh202 automatic cannon, featuring high precision and reliability. It has a high rate of fire and long combat range, engaging targets unreachable by rifles and early 20mm guns.
artillery.impact: The MK20 Rh202 enhances battlefield effectiveness by providing superior firepower and engagement range, setting a new standard for medium-calibre cannons.

artillery.t: GRIZZLY SPH received drone detection capability
artillery.body: GRIZZLY 155mm self-propelled howitzer received a passive acoustic drone detection system from Arcani Systems. This system aims to enhance survivability by providing early warning against drone threats.
artillery.impact: The addition of drone detection capability to GRIZZLY enhances its operational effectiveness and survivability on the battlefield, addressing the growing threat of unmanned aerial vehicles to artillery systems.

artillery.t: 105 LG1 artillery system deployable by various means
artillery.body: Nexter is showcasing the 105 LG1 artillery system at CANSEC 2017, which is deployable by lightweight vehicles, helicopters, or parachute drops. The system is in service with multiple armed forces including Canada, Belgium, Colombia, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand.
artillery.impact: The 105 LG1's versatility in deployment enhances rapid reaction forces' mobility and fire support capabilities, making it a valuable asset for modern military operations.

artillery.t: Excalibur S demonstrated robust SAL guidance transition
artillery.body: Raytheon conducted live firing tests of the Excalibur S, showing its ability to transition from GPS to laser guidance after firing. The tests validated the projectile's robustness in a severe gun-firing environment.
artillery.impact: The successful transition from GPS to SAL guidance enhances the precision and effectiveness of artillery against moving targets, providing a significant tactical advantage.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates Vingmate FCS with 1500m hit probability
artillery.body: Rheinmetall's Vingmate FCS was demonstrated with a hit probability of 1500 meters, featuring day and night vision technology. It is designed for manned weapon systems of middle caliber and optimized for various weapon types.
artillery.impact: The Vingmate FCS enhances accuracy and situational awareness, significantly improving combat effectiveness in challenging environments.

artillery.t: Trajan 155mm/52-calibre towed artillery gun system demonstrated
artillery.body: The Trajan 155mm/52-calibre towed artillery gun system was showcased to PM Modi. Despite initial setbacks, it has found success in the export market.
artillery.impact: The Trajan's export success validates its long-range precision firepower and strategic mobility, positioning it as a competitive system in the global market.

artillery.t: Tata Advanced Systems tests new armoured cabin for mounted gun system
artillery.body: Tata Advanced Systems is testing a new armoured cabin for a mounted gun system based on ATAGS technology. The cabin is designed to integrate a 155/52 mm artillery gun and protect personnel during firing sequences.
artillery.impact: This development aligns with India’s modernization roadmap for artillery, emphasizing platforms that can deliver precision fire while minimizing exposure time.

artillery.t: Thundart rocket artillery system selected
artillery.body: Thundart, a guided artillery rocket system, has been selected to replace the French Army's LRU. It features a maximum range of 150 km, Mach 5 speeds, and a quasi-ballistic flight path.
artillery.impact: Thundart's advanced capabilities, including high speed and extended range, significantly enhance the French Army's artillery precision and survivability.

artillery.t: M-71 155mm Towed Howitzer achieves high rate of accurate fire
artillery.body: The M-71 155mm Towed Howitzer, forged from high-strength steel, demonstrates a high rate of accurate fire. It has been field-proven and tested globally under various conditions.
artillery.impact: The M-71's reliability and performance in diverse conditions enhance its operational effectiveness and appeal to military forces.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates 81mm mortar system with <2 Mil accuracy
artillery.body: Rheinmetall has demonstrated an 81mm mortar system with high precision and rapid deployment. The MWS81 is fully compatible with most C2 systems and features a barrel-independent design.
artillery.impact: The MWS81's precision and compatibility enhance indirect fire capabilities, making it a reliable and flexible solution for modern warfare.

artillery.t: Elbit Systems developed guided rockets Predator Hawk, EXTRA, and Accular
artillery.body: Elbit Systems has developed guided rockets named Predator Hawk, EXTRA, and Accular, designed for precise firepower across diverse ranges and mission profiles.
artillery.impact: These rockets enhance artillery precision and flexibility, making them a preferred choice for nations seeking advanced artillery solutions.

artillery.t: Nexter developed the Trajan towed howitzer
artillery.body: Nexter Systems developed the Trajan towed howitzer, based on the Caesar 155/52 mm barrel. This system is part of a larger agreement with Larsen & Toubro for the Indian Army.
artillery.impact: The Trajan towed howitzer represents a significant advancement in artillery systems, leveraging Nexter's expertise to provide enhanced capabilities to the Indian Army.

artillery.t: Tiberius Aerospace demonstrated liquid-fueled ramjet artillery shell
artillery.body: Tiberius Aerospace successfully demonstrated a liquid-fueled ramjet artillery shell, Sceptre, launched from a NATO-standard 155mm howitzer in April 2026. The shell accelerates beyond Mach 3, reaches altitudes over 65,000 feet, and delivers precision effects up to 150 kilometers.
artillery.impact: This demonstration marks a significant advancement in artillery technology, offering sustained propulsion and enhanced range and accuracy, setting a new standard for future artillery systems.

artillery.t: Hanwha unveils K9A3 155mm SPH concept
artillery.body: Hanwha Aerospace unveiled the K9A3, a next-generation 155mm self-propelled howitzer concept, featuring enhanced range, mobility, and operational flexibility. The K9A3 doubles the effective range to 80 kilometers and reduces maintenance needs.
artillery.impact: The K9A3 represents a significant advancement in self-propelled artillery, offering improved performance and survivability, likely setting new benchmarks for artillery systems.

artillery.t: Developing India's first 155mm smart ammunition
artillery.body: MIL is developing India's first 155mm smart ammunition to improve accuracy and lethality, aiming for a 10m CEP from the current 500m.
artillery.impact: This development significantly enhances MIL's artillery capabilities and strengthens India's defence export potential.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates 130mm tank gun at Eurosatory
artillery.body: Rheinmetall has demonstrated a new 130mm tank gun at Eurosatory, which offers a 50% increase in kinetic energy over 120mm guns. The company is funding further development of the gun and its ammunition.
artillery.impact: The 130mm gun represents a significant advancement in tank armament technology, enhancing the firepower of future tank designs.

artillery.t: Rheinmetall focuses on long-range precision fires
artillery.body: Rheinmetall emphasizes long-range precision fires in artillery systems, focusing on cannon-delivered projectiles and propellants.
artillery.impact: This focus enhances artillery systems' range and precision, setting new standards for modernization.

artillery.t: ATMOS 2000 155mm truck-mounted howitzer developed
artillery.body: ATMOS 2000 is a 155mm truck-mounted howitzer developed by Soltam Systems and now manufactured by Elbit Systems. It is based on a 155mm 52 caliber cannon mounted on a 6x6 Tatra truck chassis.
artillery.impact: The ATMOS 2000 enhances artillery capabilities with its mobility and versatility, serving multiple countries.

artillery.t: Cockerill 3105 light turret with 105mm cannon qualified
artillery.body: John Cockerill Defense has qualified the Cockerill 3105 light turret, featuring a 105mm NATO cannon, which is now in service with several armies. The system is ITAR-free and designed for mobile fire support.
artillery.impact: The Cockerill 3105's qualification and deployment signify a significant capability in mobile artillery, offering high-pressure firepower and protection to multiple military forces.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall awarded contract for Trailblazer camera system
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Electronics UK has been awarded a contract by the UK Ministry of Defence to supply the Trailblazer camera system for Warrior Infantry Fighting Vehicles. The system provides a Rear Safety Camera System (RSCS) and meets SIL1 and EMC Land Class A compliance.
armoured.impact: The Trailblazer system enhances the safety and operational capability of Warrior IFVs, aligning with the UK Army's modernisation goals and ensuring effective rearward operations.

armoured.t: Nurol Makina introduces Ejder Yalçın EWB 4x4 armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Nurol Makina introduced the Ejder Yalçın EWB 4x4 armoured vehicle at IDEX 2025, designed for military and tactical operations with enhanced capacity and off-road performance.
armoured.impact: The Ejder Yalçın EWB's advanced features, including MRAP standards and versatile weapon systems, address contemporary operational challenges, positioning Nurol Makina as a key player in protected mobility solutions.

armoured.t: Paramount Group unveiled Mbombe 8 8x8 Infantry Combat Vehicle
armoured.body: Paramount Group unveiled the Mbombe 8, an advanced 8x8 Infantry Combat Vehicle, at Kazakhstan Defence Expo in 2016. The vehicle is designed for high mobility and mine resistance, drawing on the company's experience with previous models.
armoured.impact: The Mbombe 8 represents a significant advancement in armoured vehicle technology, offering enhanced mobility and protection, and is poised to compete in the global defence market.

armoured.t: EJDER YALÇIN 4x4 platform developed with high protection and mobility
armoured.body: Nurol Makina has developed the EJDER YALÇIN 4x4 platform, which offers high protection and mobility for military units. The vehicle is designed to meet operational requirements in various terrains and can be customized for different missions.
armoured.impact: The EJDER YALÇIN 4x4 provides a versatile and secure platform for military operations, enhancing the efficiency and security of personnel in the field.

armoured.t: KNDS 30M781 cannon integrated with EOS R500 RWS
armoured.body: KNDS and EOS have integrated the 30M781 cannon onto the EOS R500 RWS, enabling a fully ITAR-free system. The R500 RWS was unveiled at IDEX 2025 and features AI and counter-UAS radar.
armoured.impact: This integration enhances the R500 RWS's capabilities, providing a robust and autonomous weapon system for armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall completed development of 120mm KE 2020 Neo ammo
armoured.body: Rheinmetall has completed the development of the 120mm KE 2020 Neo ammunition, enhancing armour-piercing capabilities. The Bundeswehr and British Army have commissioned qualification samples.
armoured.impact: This development significantly improves the armour-piercing capabilities of main battle tanks, providing a tactical advantage against advanced protection systems.

armoured.t: BAE Systems demonstrated ACV 1.1 amphibious combat vehicle
armoured.body: BAE Systems demonstrated the ACV 1.1 amphibious combat vehicle, showcasing its ship launch and recovery capabilities. The vehicle offers enhanced survivability and performance compared to its predecessor, the AAV.
armoured.impact: The ACV 1.1's superior capabilities in both amphibious and land operations significantly enhance the U.S. Marine Corps' operational effectiveness and strategic flexibility.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall and Leonardo to develop European main battle tank and AICS
armoured.body: Leonardo and Rheinmetall signed an MoU to develop a 50:50 joint venture for two armoured vehicles: an Italian main battle tank and an armoured infantry combat system. The joint venture aims to industrialize and commercialize these vehicles for the Italian Army and other partner nations.
armoured.impact: This collaboration aims to set new standards for state-of-the-art combat vehicles in Europe, leveraging the technological and industrial synergies between the two companies.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveiled 6x6 Caracal air assault vehicle variant
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled a 6x6 variant of its Caracal air assault vehicle, designed for 'fly and drive' missions. The vehicle can be transported by various helicopters and transport aircraft, offering ballistic protection up to NATO STANAG 4569.
armoured.impact: The 6x6 Caracal variant enhances rapid deployment capabilities for German and Dutch forces, potentially expanding Rheinmetall's market share.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates logistic leader-follower tech
armoured.body: Rheinmetall UK demonstrated logistic leader-follower technology using RMMV’s HX vehicles, showcasing autonomous capabilities. The PATH Autonomous Kit, which secured first place in ELROB 2024, enables precision operation of uncrewed ground vehicles and logistics convoys.
armoured.impact: This technology enhances operational effectiveness and safety by enabling precise autonomous operations in challenging terrains, aligning with the UK's commitment to defence modernisation.

armoured.t: AJAX vehicle completed initial manned live firing tests
armoured.body: General Dynamics Land Systems–UK conducted initial manned live firing tests on the AJAX vehicle, demonstrating the platform's weapon system performance. The trials are a critical step towards the AJAX fleet's delivery to the British Army.
armoured.impact: The successful trials signify a significant advancement in the AJAX programme, highlighting its capability to support the British Army's 'Strike Brigades' in various operational scenarios.

armoured.t: Panhard offers Sphinx with Lockheed Martin turret
armoured.body: Panhard has developed the Sphinx armoured vehicle, which is offered with a Lockheed Martin turret to the French Army. The Sphinx is designed to be cost-effective and meet the French Army's requirements.
armoured.impact: The Sphinx, with its lower procurement cost and advanced turret, could enhance the French Army's operational efficiency and readiness.

armoured.t: NORINCO unveils 8M mini MRAP
armoured.body: NORINCO has unveiled the 8M mini MRAP at the CIEPE exhibition. The vehicle uses a 4x4 chassis and is powered by a Cummins QSB 5.9 engine with a ZF VG 750 transfer case.
armoured.impact: The 8M mini MRAP offers enhanced mobility and protection for tactical operations, reflecting NORINCO's capability in developing advanced armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: BAE Systems developed a new turret for CV90 upgrade
armoured.body: BAE Systems Hägglunds developed a new turret for the CV90 upgrade, enhancing the vehicle's capabilities. The upgrade includes changes to the main weapon position to improve balance, accommodate new weaponry, and offer ergonomic improvements.
armoured.impact: The new turret and upgrades will modernize the CV90 fleet, making it more adaptable to new threats while reducing lifetime costs.

armoured.t: Hanwha proposes two turret configurations for Redback
armoured.body: Hanwha Defense is testing the Redback armoured vehicle in Poland and proposes two turret configurations. The Redback, based on the MT-30 platform, can be delivered with or without the turret.
armoured.impact: The proposed turret configurations could enhance Redback's adaptability and operational flexibility for Polish mechanized units.

armoured.t: Denel fitted T7 gun on RG41 8x8 platform
armoured.body: Denel fitted the T7 gun on its RG41 8x8 platform, which was designed and tested for potential Middle Eastern markets. The platform includes advanced features like a V-shaped hull and hardened armoured shell.
armoured.impact: This development enhances the RG41's combat capabilities and flexibility, making it more competitive in the international market for armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: Intermediate Gear Box for tanks developed
armoured.body: MPF has developed an Intermediate Gear Box for various tank variants, including T-90 and T-72. The gear box is crucial for power transmission and auxiliary functions in tanks.
armoured.impact: This development enhances the operational capabilities and reliability of armoured vehicles, supporting India's defence requirements.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveils SEOSS 400 fire control sensor
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the SEOSS 400 fire control sensor at DSEI 2025, designed for next-generation combat vehicles. The sensor offers superior performance with enhanced range, precision, and stabilization.
armoured.impact: SEOSS 400 sets a new standard for battle tanks and air defence platforms, offering advanced capabilities like multi-mode tracking and Beyond Line-of-Sight fire control.

armoured.t: VBL Ultima with new engine, gearbox, and suspension
armoured.body: Arquus delivered two VBL Ultima vehicles to the Hellenic Army, featuring a 95-horsepower diesel engine, new gearbox, and improved suspension systems.
armoured.impact: The VBL Ultima enhances the vehicle's mobility, safety, and reliability, setting a new standard for the VBL series.

armoured.t: BAE Systems test-fired Vantage ATS turret at 750 m range
armoured.body: BAE Systems test-fired the Vantage ATS turret, which can engage targets at 750 m. The turret completed FAT in May 2025 and features scalable architecture and ATTCS.
armoured.impact: The successful test firing demonstrates the Vantage ATS's capability and readiness for integration with the ATLAS CCV, enhancing its combat effectiveness.

armoured.t: 50mm Unmanned Turret completed live fire demo
armoured.body: Elbit Systems of America completed a live fire demonstration of its 50mm Unmanned Turret (UT50) for the Optionally Manned Fighting Vehicle (OMFV) project. The UT50 is designed to be versatile with multiple mission payloads.
armoured.impact: The successful live fire demonstration of the UT50 showcases advanced unmanned turret technology, enhancing the combat effectiveness and flexibility of future combat vehicles.

armoured.t: TITUS® armoured vehicle fulfills multiple missions
armoured.body: TITUS® is an armoured vehicle that can perform various missions including counter-terrorism, counter-insurgency, peace-keeping, and frontier surveillance. It has been deployed for COP 21 and used in anti-terrorist operations.
armoured.impact: The versatility and robust protection features of TITUS® make it a valuable asset for multiple security and military operations, enhancing operational flexibility and effectiveness.

armoured.t: PIRANHA 5 completed live firing tests with 30mm system
armoured.body: The PIRANHA 5 armored vehicle completed live firing tests with a 30mm system, exceeding Romanian Army requirements. The vehicle is now qualified for series production in Romania.
armoured.impact: This milestone ensures the Romanian Army can receive advanced wheeled armored vehicles, enhancing their mobility and firepower.

armoured.t: Nexter unveils Aravis Assault Vehicle with roof-mounted ladders
armoured.body: Nexter unveiled the Aravis Assault Vehicle at Milipol Qatar 2012, featuring roof-mounted ladders for rapid entry into various structures.
armoured.impact: The ladders enable rapid assault and entry into multiple types of buildings and vehicles, enhancing the vehicle's versatility in urban combat scenarios.

armoured.t: PARS 6x6 demonstrated to Malaysian royalty
armoured.body: FNSS demonstrated the PARS 6x6 armored vehicle to the Malaysian royalty during a visit. The vehicle is intended to replace aging Condor and Sibmas vehicles.
armoured.impact: The demonstration highlights FNSS's efforts to meet the Malaysian Army's need for modern 4x4 and 6x6 armored vehicles.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveiled Lynx KF41 infantry fighting vehicle
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the Lynx KF41 infantry fighting vehicle at Eurosatory, designed to meet future combat requirements. The vehicle features advanced protection, a powerful 850-kilowatt power pack, and the Wotan 35 electric cannon.
armoured.impact: The Lynx KF41 is significant as it addresses the evolving needs of modern warfare, including peer-on-peer conflict and advanced threats, making it a potential candidate for the U.S. Army's NGCV program.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall will mount Oerlikon Revolver Gun Mk3 on HX77
armoured.body: Rheinmetall will mount the Oerlikon Revolver Gun Mk3 on an HX77 at IDEX 2019, showcasing its Hybrid Protection Module. This module combines active and passive protection technology for vehicles.
armoured.impact: The integration of the Oerlikon Revolver Gun Mk3 on the HX77 enhances the vehicle's defensive capabilities, providing a robust solution for force protection.

armoured.t: Developed tracked and wheeled FICV prototypes
armoured.body: India has developed tracked and wheeled FICV prototypes under the DCPP programme, incorporating Indian-designed subsystems. These vehicles are intended to replace BMP-2 infantry combat vehicles.
armoured.impact: The FICVs represent a significant technological advancement, reflecting India's capability to produce advanced armoured vehicles that can compete with international manufacturers.

armoured.t: Denel delivered 100th turret under Malaysian contract
armoured.body: Denel Land Systems delivered the 100th turret out of 122 to Malaysia, fitting them onto AV8 vehicles. The turrets were manufactured outside South Africa based on South African design and intellectual property.
armoured.impact: This milestone establishes Denel's capability to manufacture and export advanced armoured vehicle turrets tailored for tropical and jungle conditions, enhancing its international defence market presence.

armoured.t: AJAX vehicles demonstrated reliability and performance
armoured.body: General Dynamics Land Systems has delivered over 160 AJAX armoured vehicles to the British Army. AJAX has undergone rigorous testing, including firing over 20,000 rounds and advanced mobility exercises.
armoured.impact: The AJAX vehicles' reliability and performance in demanding trials enhance the British Army's operational readiness and lethality in high-intensity operations.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall develops AEV3 KODIAK armoured engineer vehicle
armoured.body: Rheinmetall has developed the AEV3 KODIAK, a third-generation armoured engineer vehicle for German and NATO forces. It is highly mobile and versatile, used for creating barriers to inhibit enemy troop movement.
armoured.impact: The AEV3 KODIAK enhances battlefield engineering capabilities with its advanced protection and mobility, providing a significant tactical advantage.

armoured.t: DRS demonstrated ruggedized battle management hardware
armoured.body: DRS demonstrated its ruggedized battle management hardware in an operational exercise with Australian M1A1SA tanks, improving connectivity and interoperability.
armoured.impact: The demonstration highlights the system's capability to enhance situational awareness and interoperability for armored units, crucial for modern combat scenarios.

armoured.t: Paramount Group unveiled Mbombe 4 armoured personnel carrier
armoured.body: Paramount Group unveiled the Mbombe 4 armoured personnel carrier, which has been contracted by the UAE. The Mbombe 4 is part of a family of combat vehicles designed to meet advanced military requirements.
armoured.impact: The Mbombe 4 represents a significant advancement in armoured vehicle technology, showcasing Paramount Group's leadership in the field and enhancing the UAE's defence capabilities.

armoured.t: First Hungarian-built Lynx rolled off assembly line
armoured.body: The first Lynx infantry fighting vehicle built in Hungary has been completed. It will be transferred to the Hungarian armed forces after inspections in mid-2024.
armoured.impact: This marks a significant milestone for Rheinmetall's local production capabilities in Hungary, enhancing European security and meeting growing customer demand.

armoured.t: Developing Futuristic Infantry Combat Vehicle (FICV)
armoured.body: AVNL is developing the Futuristic Infantry Combat Vehicle (FICV) as part of its ongoing projects. The project is in its early stages and is part of AVNL's efforts to explore futuristic projects.
armoured.impact: The development of FICV signifies AVNL's commitment to modernizing its armoured vehicle portfolio and enhancing its capabilities for future combat scenarios.

armoured.t: Hanwha upgrades APS to detect UAVs and elevate launchers
armoured.body: Hanwha Systems is developing an upgraded version of its APS to counter UAVs and improve launcher elevation. The upgrade includes new software for these enhancements.
armoured.impact: This upgrade enhances the system's capability to protect against a wider range of threats, including slow-moving UAVs, thereby improving vehicle survivability.

armoured.t: BAE Systems delivers RG31 and RG32M armoured vehicles
armoured.body: BAE Systems is delivering RG31 and RG32M armoured vehicles to the UAE and Sweden. The RG31 is a mature, combat-proven vehicle with over 2,166 units delivered.
armoured.impact: The delivery of RG31 and RG32M vehicles underscores BAE Systems' capability in providing robust armoured solutions to multiple international clients.

armoured.t: Nexter launches BALDUR to improve energy management on armored vehicles
armoured.body: Nexter has launched the BALDUR initiative to improve energy management on armored vehicles, aiming to master onboard energy for future multi-role armored vehicles. The initiative includes developing hybrid propulsion groups and leveraging expertise from the SCORPION program and the FAMOUS European project.
armoured.impact: BALDUR could enhance the operational efficiency and sustainability of future armored vehicles by optimizing energy use and integrating hybrid propulsion systems.

armoured.t: Hanwha unveils K-NIFV with unmanned turret
armoured.body: Hanwha Aerospace unveiled the K-NIFV at ADEX 2025, featuring an unmanned turret and locally produced systems to replace foreign-made components.
armoured.impact: The K-NIFV's unmanned turret and domestic alternatives to foreign systems signify a step towards reducing reliance on foreign technology and enhancing indigenous capabilities.

armoured.t: Scata unveiled MK1 modular four-wheel-drive platform
armoured.body: Scata unveiled the MK1 modular four-wheel-drive platform at Eurosatory, designed to carry troops, command systems, counter-drone equipment, logistics loads, and weapons. Production is set to begin in Pietarsaari or Jakobstad in 2027.
armoured.impact: The MK1 platform's modular design and versatility could attract Gulf region demand, positioning Scata as a player in the armoured vehicle market despite high start-up risks.

armoured.t: Nexter unveils CASEVAC variant of VBCI
armoured.body: Nexter unveiled a CASEVAC variant of its VBCI armoured infantry fighting vehicle at Eurosatory 2012. The VBCI CASEVAC can transport up to four casualties, including one or two lying patients.
armoured.impact: This development enhances battlefield medical capabilities, allowing for more efficient and effective casualty evacuation and care.

armoured.t: Ocelot vehicle weapons pod variant unveiled
armoured.body: Force Protection unveiled the Ocelot vehicle weapons pod variant at the Protected Mobility Exhibition, offering enhanced protection and easy integration between missions.
armoured.impact: The Ocelot weapons pod variant expands the Ocelot family's capabilities, providing commanders with additional options for fire support and special operations.

armoured.t: Elbit Systems' UT50 turret completed live fire demo
armoured.body: Elbit Systems of America successfully demonstrated its 50mm Unmanned Turret (UT50) for the Optionally Manned Fighting Vehicle (OMFV). The UT50 features multiple mission payloads and capabilities.
armoured.impact: This live fire demonstration showcases the UT50's readiness and advanced capabilities, enhancing the OMFV's combat effectiveness.

armoured.t: Arquus developed axles and gearboxes for GRIFFON
armoured.body: Arquus developed specialized axles and gearboxes for the GRIFFON, which also equip the JAGUAR vehicle. These components contribute to the GRIFFON's great tactical mobility and performance.
armoured.impact: The development of these components enhances the GRIFFON's operational capabilities, making it more versatile and effective in various terrains.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall launches ACW program with DST, CSIRO, QUT, RMIT
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Defence Australia launched the ACW program with DST, CSIRO, QUT, and RMIT to develop advanced automated military vehicle technologies. The program aims to automate driving capabilities and fundamentally change how land vehicles support military operations.
armoured.impact: This initiative will enhance Australia's capability to develop next-generation automated combat vehicle technologies, potentially leading to more autonomous and efficient military vehicles.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall equipped Ripsaw M5 with Skyranger 30 turret
armoured.body: Rheinmetall has equipped the Ripsaw M5 platform with the Skyranger 30 turret, featuring a 30mm Oerlikon KCE autocannon and advanced radar systems. The turret also supports airburst ammunition and can mount two air defense missiles.
armoured.impact: This development enhances the Ripsaw M5's capability as a modernized air defense platform, offering improved firepower and situational awareness.

armoured.t: Yugoimport unveils Milosh 4x4 armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Yugoimport unveiled the Milosh 4x4 armoured vehicle at IDEX 2017. The vehicle features a monocoque hull with an engine at the front, crew in the middle, and troop compartment at the rear.
armoured.impact: The Milosh vehicle addresses modern military needs with enhanced situational awareness for troops and the capacity to carry eight personnel.

armoured.t: Hanwha and Milrem developing tracked RCV
armoured.body: Hanwha Aerospace and Milrem Robotics are developing a tracked robotic combat vehicle (RCV) to address modern military needs. The partnership aims to leverage both companies' expertise in autonomous systems.
armoured.impact: This collaboration could enhance the capabilities of Hanwha's existing wheeled RCVs and ARION-SMET systems, expanding their product line to include tracked vehicles.

armoured.t: AMAP armor kit developed for Leopard 2PL
armoured.body: Rheinmetall developed the AMAP armor kit for the Leopard 2PL, which uses nano-ceramics and modern alloys. This armor is planned to be produced in Poland under license.
armoured.impact: The AMAP armor kit significantly enhances the protection level of the Leopard 2PL against various threats, making it a critical upgrade for the Polish Army's tank fleet.

armoured.t: Caracal armoured vehicle with RCWS 100 and electro-optical sensors
armoured.body: Rheinmetall demonstrated the Caracal armoured vehicle, featuring a remote-controlled weapon station and advanced sensors for detecting and combating small drones. The vehicle is designed for rapid deployment and reconnaissance missions.
armoured.impact: The Caracal's integration of advanced detection and combat systems enhances its capability to protect against drone threats, making it a versatile platform for modern military operations.

armoured.t: Lockheed Martin delivers AJAX turrets with 40mm cannon
armoured.body: Lockheed Martin has delivered AJAX turrets equipped with a 40mm cannon capable of rapid firing on the move. These turrets are designed to enhance the combat and survivability of AJAX vehicles.
armoured.impact: The AJAX turrets significantly boost the intelligence, surveillance, and combat capabilities of the AJAX vehicles, contributing to the modernisation of the UK's frontline fleet.

armoured.t: Redback infantry fighting vehicle launched for trials
armoured.body: Hanwha-led Team Redback launched the Redback infantry fighting vehicle for trials in Australia's Project Land 400 Phase 3. The vehicle is based on South Korea’s AS21 and features advanced protection and armament systems.
armoured.impact: The Redback's advanced protection and armament systems, including STANAG Level 6 protection and an EOS T2000 turret, make it a strong contender against Rheinmetall’s Lynx KF41 in the Australian Army competition.

armoured.t: BAE Systems tested VANTAGE ATS with target engagement
armoured.body: BAE Systems Australia tested the VANTAGE Automated Turret System, demonstrating its capability to engage targets at 750 meters. This system is designed for use on armoured vehicles like the ATLAS UGV.
armoured.impact: The VANTAGE ATS enhances the combat effectiveness of armoured vehicles by improving accuracy and engagement range, crucial for modern battlefield scenarios.

armoured.t: AMPV designed for military requirements with enhanced protection
armoured.body: The AMPV is a light armoured vehicle designed specifically for military requirements, featuring a central armoured crew cell for enhanced protection. It includes options for remote weapon stations and advanced protection systems like ROSY.
armoured.impact: The AMPV's specialized design and advanced protection features represent a significant advancement in armoured vehicle technology, offering enhanced survivability and operational flexibility.

armoured.t: NORINCO unveils VT2 main battle tank
armoured.body: NORINCO unveiled the VT2 main battle tank at DSA 2012, featuring advanced technology and a low life-circle cost. The VT2 includes an advanced Image Stabilized Fire Control System and a powerful V12 turbo-charged diesel engine.
armoured.impact: The VT2's advanced features and efficient production line position it as a competitive main battle tank in the global market, enhancing NORINCO's capabilities in armoured vehicle development.

armoured.t: Elbit Systems awarded contract for armored vehicle systems
armoured.body: Elbit Systems was awarded a $300 million contract to supply weapon, reconnaissance, driving, and situational awareness systems for armored vehicles to the Austrian Army over six years.
armoured.impact: This contract highlights Elbit Systems' leadership in the armored vehicle market and their commitment to delivering advanced solutions that meet customer requirements.

armoured.t: Kalashnikov demonstrates Soratnik armored tracked vehicle
armoured.body: Kalashnikov group demonstrated the Soratnik armored tracked vehicle, featuring an automated control system, secure radio channels, and surveillance equipment. Soratnik can work with other automated combat systems and unmanned aerial vehicles.
armoured.impact: The Soratnik's advanced features and interoperability with other systems enhance its capability in modern combat scenarios, providing a significant technological edge.

armoured.t: BAE Systems debuts TRT-R30MK 30mm Tactical Remote Turret
armoured.body: BAE Systems introduced the TRT-R30MK 30mm Tactical Remote Turret at AAD 2012, showcasing its capability for day and night operations and a firing range exceeding 2,500 meters.
armoured.impact: The TRT-R30MK enhances vehicle versatility and crew safety by providing comprehensive self-protection and ground fire support, suitable for various operational environments.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall modernizes Bergepanzer 3 Büffel ARVs
armoured.body: Rheinmetall is modernizing the Dutch military's Bergepanzer 3 Büffel armoured recovery vehicles, extending their service life to 2040 with new features and equipment.
armoured.impact: The modernization enhances the vehicles' tactical effectiveness and crew safety, ensuring they remain state-of-the-art combat support vehicles.

armoured.t: PSM Projekt System & Management developing Leopard 3 main battle tank
armoured.body: PSM Projekt System & Management, a joint venture between KNDS Germany and Rheinmetall, is developing the Leopard 3 main battle tank. The Leopard 3 will feature a new 130-mm howitzer and automatic loading system.
armoured.impact: The Leopard 3 represents a significant advancement in tank technology, incorporating advanced features like a new 130-mm howitzer and automatic loading, enhancing combat effectiveness and operational efficiency.

armoured.t: TASL demonstrated a 30mm crewless turret on WHAP 8x8
armoured.body: TASL showcased a 30mm crewless turret on the WHAP 8x8 platform, featuring multi-weapon compatibility and advanced precision targeting. The turret is designed for integration on various armoured vehicles.
armoured.impact: This development enhances the tactical flexibility and survivability of armoured vehicles by providing remote-operated firepower delivery, reducing crew exposure to enemy fire.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall Canada modernizing 42 Leopard 2A4 main battle tanks
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Canada has begun modernizing 42 Leopard 2A4 main battle tanks to meet the needs of the Canadian military. This follows substantial infrastructure investment in St-Jean-sur-Richelieu.
armoured.impact: The modernization of Leopard 2A4 tanks enhances the Canadian military's armoured capabilities, ensuring these vehicles remain effective and relevant in modern warfare scenarios.

armoured.t: indigenously developed Neptune 360 engine
armoured.body: Ashok Leyland has developed the Neptune 360 engine for the Super Stallion 8x8 HMV, which powers the vehicle with 360hp and 1,400Nm torque. The engine is coupled with an 8S151 gearbox and supports various optional features for enhanced mobility and utility.
armoured.impact: The indigenously developed Neptune 360 engine enhances India's self-reliance in armoured vehicle technology, providing a powerful and efficient powertrain solution.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall and Supashock develop load handling system for HX77 8x8
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Defence and Supashock developed a load handling system for the HX77 8x8 logistic vehicle, improving efficiency and safety. The system was launched at Eurosatory by the Minister for Defence Industry.
armoured.impact: The load handling system enhances the operational capabilities of the HX77 8x8, making it more efficient and safer for container loading, which is crucial for military logistics.

armoured.t: Installed MAPS Gen 1 on Stryker vehicles
armoured.body: General Dynamics Mission Systems has installed MAPS Gen 1 on US Stryker vehicles in Germany, enhancing their PNT capabilities. The system monitors GPS signals and ensures data transmission even under degraded conditions.
armoured.impact: This installation closes a capability gap for the US Army, providing reliable PNT services for combat operations in Europe.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall equips Leopard 2 with advanced fire control systems
armoured.body: Rheinmetall has equipped Leopard 2 tanks with advanced fire control systems, including the Vingmate FCS, which is suitable for various environments and can be mounted on soft mount brackets.
armoured.impact: This advancement enhances the combat effectiveness and versatility of Leopard 2 tanks in diverse operational conditions, providing precise fire control for infantry weapons.

armoured.t: CSG and FNSS unveiled the CFL-120 Karpat medium tank
armoured.body: CSG and FNSS unveiled the CFL-120 Karpat medium tank at IDEB 2026, featuring a 120 mm cannon and Leonardo's HITFACT® MkII turret. The vehicle is designed to match main battle tank capabilities with lower weight and improved mobility.
armoured.impact: The CFL-120 Karpat represents a strategic partnership between CSG and FNSS, aiming to meet the growing demand for modern tracked armoured vehicles in Europe and beyond.

armoured.t: UTAAS fire-control system with universal sight
armoured.body: UTAAS is a modular fire-control system for armoured vehicles, featuring a universal sight and automatic gun-laying. It is in service on Combat Vehicle 90 in multiple countries.
armoured.impact: UTAAS enhances combat effectiveness by providing stable, high-performance fire control with large deflection angles, crucial for engaging fast-moving aircraft.

armoured.t: Denel develops latest RG32M for Namibia
armoured.body: Denel Vehicle Systems is developing the latest version of the RG32M armoured patrol vehicle for deployment in Namibia. The RG32M is a mine-resistant vehicle designed for various roles with enhanced protection and mobility.
armoured.impact: The latest RG32M leverages operational experience from deployments in Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and the Balkans, enhancing its adaptability and effectiveness in diverse environments.

armoured.t: ECP2 contract funds RDT&E for Bradley upgrades
armoured.body: BAE Systems received a $55 million contract for the second phase of ECP for the Bradley Fighting Vehicle, aiming to upgrade the full fleet and improve vehicle performance. The contract funds RDT&E efforts to enhance the Bradley’s engine, transmission, and power distribution.
armoured.impact: The upgrades will provide soldiers with new technologies and improved vehicle performance to counter existing and future threats, ensuring the Bradley remains a key asset in the U.S. Army's arsenal.

armoured.t: ARV completed prototype trials
armoured.body: General Dynamics completed prototype trials for the ARV, focusing on C4, mobility, and resistance. The ARV demonstrated ocean mobility and surf zone transition capabilities.
armoured.impact: The ARV's capabilities in command, control, and mobility set a new standard for reconnaissance vehicles, enhancing the USMC's operational flexibility.

armoured.t: Leonardo Rheinmetall displayed NMBT concept demonstrator
armoured.body: Leonardo Rheinmetall displayed an NMBT concept demonstrator at Eurosatory 2026, featuring a new turret on a Leopard 2A4 hull. The focus is on mobility and situational awareness, with plans to increase engine output to 1,800 hp.
armoured.impact: The concept aims to enhance the capabilities of the MBT by improving mobility and situational awareness, addressing limitations of the Leopard 2A4 hull.

armoured.t: BAE Systems and IDV display ACV-P at FEINDEF
armoured.body: BAE Systems and IDV displayed the Amphibious Combat Vehicle Personnel variant (ACV-P) at FEINDEF 2023, marking its first appearance outside the US. The ACV-P is the base platform for the ACV family, designed to meet the needs of the US Marine Corps and the Spanish Navy.
armoured.impact: The ACV-P's international debut highlights its advanced amphibious capabilities and readiness for international deployment, underscoring its strategic importance for NATO allies.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall introduced hybrid protection module integrating ADS into passive armour
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled a hybrid protection module at IDEX 2019 that integrates Active Defence System elements into passive armour, reducing parasitic weight and enhancing protection. The module includes sensors, an insensitive explosive effector, and interfaces with radar sensors for all-round pre-warning.
armoured.impact: This development reduces the weight and complexity of integrating Active Defence Systems into armoured vehicles, potentially improving vehicle performance and survivability.

armoured.t: WhAP 8×8 armored vehicle hulls produced
armoured.body: Metlonics Morocco has produced 20 hulls for the WhAP 8×8 armored vehicle at the Berrechid facility for the Moroccan army. The vehicle features the UT30MK2 unmanned turret with a 30mm cannon and anti-tank guided missiles.
armoured.impact: The production marks a significant milestone for India's defense industry in overseas manufacturing and export, highlighting the WhAP 8×8's capabilities and Tata Advanced Systems' growing role in global defense networks.

armoured.t: PIRANHA 5 showcased with innovations in mobility and protection
armoured.body: General Dynamics Land Systems–UK demonstrated the PIRANHA 5 at the International Armoured Vehicle Conference, highlighting its innovations in electronic architectures, mobility, and protection. The PIRANHA 5 is a highly-mobile and flexible platform with a large free payload and is a contender for the UK’s Mechanised Infantry Vehicle programme.
armoured.impact: The demonstration of PIRANHA 5’s capabilities underscores its potential to meet diverse mission objectives and its competitive edge in modern military vehicle programmes.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall installs ADS AMAP-APS on armoured truck
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Defence has installed its ADS AMAP-APS on an armoured truck, demonstrating a hard-kill active protection system. The system is modular, weighing up to 500 kg for heavy vehicles, and uses directed energy to counter threats.
armoured.impact: The AMAP-APS system's modular design and effectiveness against large caliber weapons make it a significant advancement in armoured vehicle protection, offering superior speed and reduced power requirements compared to rivals.

armoured.t: Elbit Systems demonstrated an AFV with autonomous capabilities and AI
armoured.body: Elbit Systems demonstrated an Armored Fighting Vehicle (AFV) with autonomous capabilities and AI, showcasing enhanced operational capability and survivability. The AFV operates two warriors via a Helmet Mounted Display and functions as an independent high fire-power strike cell.
armoured.impact: The AFV's autonomous capabilities and AI significantly enhance decision-making and target engagement accuracy, setting a new standard for combat vehicle operational efficiency.

armoured.t: submitted AJAX-based bid for LAND 400 Phase 3
armoured.body: General Dynamics Land Systems–Australia submitted an AJAX-based bid for LAND 400 Phase 3. AJAX is a fifth-generation, fully-digital platform with a modern 30mm turret.
armoured.impact: The AJAX platform, with its advanced digital capabilities and proven performance, offers Australia a highly adaptable and technologically advanced armoured vehicle solution.

armoured.t: ACV family of vehicles is fully operational
armoured.body: BAE Systems and IDV showcased the Amphibious Combat Vehicle (ACV) at FEINDEF, the sole fully operational amphibious combat vehicle in production, designed to enhance US Marine Corps mobility.
armoured.impact: The ACV's unique amphibious capabilities and modular design set a new standard for expeditionary mobility and mission versatility in armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: Modular Mine Plow with lane marking system demonstrated
armoured.body: Global Clearance Solutions demonstrated a Modular Mine Plow with an integrated lane marking system for armored vehicles. The system clears and marks passageways through mined terrain, enabling controlled movement.
armoured.impact: This system significantly enhances operational mobility and safety for armored vehicles in high-risk environments by automating the process of minefield breaching and lane marking.

armoured.t: Thales developing threat prioritisation software
armoured.body: Thales is developing DigitalCrew software for armoured vehicles to prioritize threats and reduce cognitive burden on operators. The software uses machine learning to analyze sensor data and human decision-making.
armoured.impact: This development aims to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of armoured vehicle operators by automating threat assessment, potentially improving response times and situational awareness.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall overhauls and delivers Marder IFVs to Ukraine
armoured.body: Rheinmetall is overhauling and delivering Marder IFVs to Ukraine, including the 1A3 version with laser range finders. These vehicles are being supplied at Rheinmetall's expense and have been in operation since 2023.
armoured.impact: The delivery of overhauled Marder IFVs enhances Ukraine's combat capabilities with advanced features like laser range finders, supporting efficient and precise target engagement.

armoured.t: Nexter developed VBMR demonstrator XP-2
armoured.body: Nexter developed a demonstrator for the VBMR, the successor to the VAB. The VBMR is designed to transport 9 infantry soldiers and replace the VAB used since the 1970s.
armoured.impact: The development of the VBMR demonstrator is crucial for the French army, addressing the need for an updated armoured vehicle to replace the aging VAB fleet.

armoured.t: LaZ400 aiming device to replace thermal imaging system
armoured.body: Rheinmetall will equip the Dutch military's Fennek armoured recon vehicle with the LaZ400 aiming device, replacing its existing thermal imaging system. The order for 246 devices is worth €36 million and will be delivered by 2027.
armoured.impact: The LaZ400 enhances the Fennek's reconnaissance capabilities, providing improved targeting and situational awareness.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall won first place in autonomous convoy scenarios
armoured.body: Rheinmetall won first place in the 'Convoy Scenarios' category at ELROB 2026, demonstrating autonomous convoy management and sensor fusion under realistic military conditions.
armoured.impact: This achievement underscores Rheinmetall's leadership in developing autonomous military logistics systems, advancing secure and cooperative operations between different vehicle platforms.

armoured.t: BMP-II indigenized to 98.5%
armoured.body: Ordnance Factory Medak has indigenized the BMP-II to 98.5%, making it a state-of-the-art armoured vehicle. The BMP-II, known as APC ‘Sarath’, is a fully tracked, highly mobile amphibian ICV.
armoured.impact: This achievement places India among a select group of nations capable of producing advanced infantry combat vehicles, enhancing its self-reliance in armoured vehicle manufacturing.

armoured.t: TASL unveils new mine protected vehicle platform
armoured.body: TASL is developing a new mine protected vehicle (MPV) platform with a heavy-duty engine and a V-shaped single-piece hull for superior blast protection. The platform is designed to protect against IEDs and landmines by deflecting blast energy outward.
armoured.impact: The new MPV platform enhances India's capability to produce advanced armoured vehicles with superior survivability, reinforcing the country's self-reliance in defense manufacturing.

armoured.t: BAE Systems and Sitno offer remote TRT family turret for tactical vehicles
armoured.driver: BAE Systems Land Systems South Africa
armoured.body: BAE Systems and Sitno are collaborating to offer a remote TRT family turret for tactical vehicles at IDEB 2012. The TRT is designed to provide self-protection and ground fire support for light armoured vehicles.
armoured.impact: This partnership leverages the expertise of both companies to deliver a modern, customizable turret solution for armoured vehicles, enhancing their defensive and offensive capabilities.

armoured.t: development of next generation armoured vehicle systems
armoured.body: Paramount Group and PT Pindad signed an MOU to develop next generation armoured vehicle systems for Indonesia, focusing on local manufacturing and technology transfer.
armoured.impact: This collaboration aims to strengthen Indonesia's land systems capability and create new jobs, leveraging Paramount's expertise in armoured vehicle design and engineering.

armoured.t: BAE Systems awarded contract for 30 ACV 1.1 vehicles
armoured.body: BAE Systems received a $140.3 million contract to produce 30 Amphibious Combat Vehicles (ACV) 1.1 for the USMC. The ACV 1.1 is a new armoured vehicle designed to replace the AAVs.
armoured.impact: The ACV 1.1 represents a significant upgrade in amphibious assault capabilities for the USMC, enhancing mobility and survivability on land and water.

armoured.t: AMPV C-UAS prototype successfully tested
armoured.body: BAE Systems successfully tested the AMPV C-UAS prototype, which can engage ground targets and small drones with 30mm proximity rounds. The prototype uses the same chassis as existing AMPV variants and integrates Moog's RIwP turret and other advanced systems.
armoured.impact: This test demonstrates the AMPV's adaptability and rapid integration of new technologies, enhancing its capability to counter unmanned aerial threats.

armoured.t: StrikeMaster unveiled with NSM missile
armoured.body: Thales Australia unveiled the StrikeMaster at Land Forces 2022, integrating the Bushmaster Utility vehicle with Kongsberg's NSM missile. The NSM has a range exceeding 250km and can penetrate modern naval defenses.
armoured.impact: This integration showcases a new capability for land-based anti-ship defense, enhancing the Bushmaster's utility in coastal defense scenarios.

armoured.t: BAE Systems develops new light tank based on M8 Buford
armoured.body: BAE Systems is developing a new light tank based on the M8 Buford, featuring a 105mm XM35 gun and an automatic loading system. The tank includes a diesel engine, advanced armor, and active protection systems like Elbit Systems Iron Fist APS and BAE 'RAVEN' DIRCM.
armoured.impact: This development enhances BAE Systems' capability to provide advanced armoured vehicles with superior firepower and protection, targeting modern battlefield requirements.

armoured.t: Sherpa vehicles with assault ladder developed in-house
armoured.body: ARQUUS developed an assault ladder version of the Sherpa vehicle in-house. The Sherpa, launched in 2006, is used by multiple countries and is now at its 1000th production unit.
armoured.impact: The in-house development of the assault ladder version enhances the Sherpa's tactical capabilities, providing unique support for anti-crime and counter-terrorism operations.

armoured.t: Norinco exhibits CS/VA1 Light Strike Vehicle
armoured.body: Norinco exhibited the CS/VA1 Light Strike Vehicle for the first time in Africa. The vehicle is a 4x4 multi-role platform designed for fast strike, scout, and patrol missions.
armoured.impact: The CS/VA1's versatility and mobility enhance its appeal for diverse tactical operations, potentially increasing Norinco's market presence in Africa.

armoured.t: Leclerc XLR fitted with roof-mounted cage armor
armoured.body: The French Army demonstrated the Leclerc XLR tank with roof-mounted cage armor to protect against drone threats. KNDS France is manufacturing this armor for the tank units.
armoured.impact: This cage armor addresses the growing threat of drones to main battle tanks, a measure adopted by other forces as well.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall demonstrated guided rocket firing from A-UGV
armoured.body: Rheinmetall demonstrated guided rocket firing capabilities from an autonomous uncrewed ground vehicle (A-UGV) called Rheinmetall Mission Master SP in a live-fire drill in Sweden.
armoured.impact: This demonstration showcases Rheinmetall's capability to integrate advanced firing systems into autonomous vehicles, enhancing force protection and operational flexibility.

armoured.t: Developing next generation armoured platforms
armoured.body: FAMOUS2 aims to develop next generation armoured platforms and upgrade existing ones. Arquus is part of this ambitious European consortium.
armoured.impact: This initiative represents a significant advancement in European defense cooperation, focusing on innovative technological building blocks for future armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates Trailblazer Vehicle Vision System
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Electronics UK is demonstrating the Trailblazer Vehicle Vision System at DSEI, which enhances platform vision capability and driver effectiveness. The system offers thermal and daylight-thermal fusion vision and is easy to integrate.
armoured.impact: The Trailblazer Vehicle Vision System improves situational awareness and safety for armoured vehicle operators, extending their field of view beyond daylight spectrum.

armoured.t: BAE Systems Australia demonstrated ATLAS CCV autonomy levels
armoured.body: BAE Systems Australia conducted trials for the ATLAS CCV, demonstrating autonomy levels from teleoperation to full 'sense and avoid' navigation. The vehicle is a fully functional prototype.
armoured.impact: The demonstration of advanced autonomy in ATLAS CCV could enhance battlefield efficiency and reduce risk to personnel by enabling remote operation and autonomous navigation.

armoured.t: Elbit Systems developed an advanced MBT simulator
armoured.body: Elbit Systems developed an advanced MBT simulator that generates interest internationally. The simulator allows tank crews to practice coordinated operations in various combat scenarios.
armoured.impact: The simulator significantly enhances training realism for tank crews, improving their combat readiness and coordination with infantry.

armoured.t: SHERPA APC Police tested in various terrains
armoured.body: The SHERPA APC Police was showcased at Milipol Paris 2023, demonstrating its capacity for up to 10 soldiers and high mobility. It has been deployed in various international armies and police units, including during the 2015 attacks in France.
armoured.impact: The SHERPA APC Police's versatility and proven performance in diverse security operations highlight its significance in the armoured 4x4 segment, meeting the growing demand for advanced APCs.

armoured.t: Tata Advanced Systems unveiled Advanced Armored Platform - Tracked vehicle
armoured.body: Tata Advanced Systems unveiled the Advanced Armored Platform - Tracked vehicle, a tracked vehicle for India’s next-generation infantry combat vehicles. This vehicle is part of Tata's vision for future armored platforms.
armoured.impact: The unveiling of the Advanced Armored Platform - Tracked vehicle represents a significant step in India's indigenous development of advanced armored vehicles, enhancing its capability to produce next-generation infantry combat vehicles.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall to build Lynx IFV test chassis for US
armoured.body: Rheinmetall will build and export a Lynx Infantry Fighting Vehicle test chassis to the US for the Optionally Manned Fighting Vehicle campaign. The chassis will demonstrate advanced features of mobility.
armoured.impact: This development showcases Rheinmetall's next-generation electronic architecture and advanced mobility features, positioning the Lynx as a highly protected and adaptable IFV for future battlefields.

armoured.t: KNDS France showcased VBCI MK2 at DIMDEX 2026
armoured.body: KNDS France showcased the VBCI MK2 at DIMDEX 2026, highlighting its combat-proven reliability and advanced operational capabilities. The vehicle is adapted to the Qatari armed forces' logistics and is capable of engaging a wide range of targets.
armoured.impact: The VBCI MK2's combat-proven reliability and advanced features make it a superior choice for modern infantry operations, enhancing the Qatari forces' operational effectiveness.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveils Widder van with 131 HP engine
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the Widder van at AAD 2012, featuring a 131 HP diesel engine and all-terrain capability. The vehicle is used by the German Bundeswehr for various missions.
armoured.impact: The Widder van's high mobility and operational flexibility enhance the versatility of military operations, providing a robust solution for diverse mission requirements.

armoured.t: AMEV armoured medical evacuation vehicle developed
armoured.body: DAPA and Hyundai Rotem developed the AMEV for frontline casualty treatment. It can accommodate up to six ambulatory patients or four stretcher patients, and includes medical systems and CBRN protection.
armoured.impact: The AMEV enhances South Korea's medical evacuation capabilities with advanced medical equipment and CBRN protection, improving soldier survivability.

armoured.t: Marauder Mark2 armoured vehicle upgraded with universal hull and improved driver interface
armoured.body: Paramount Group unveiled the Marauder Mark2, an armoured vehicle with a universal hull and enhanced driver interface. The upgrades improve ergonomics, comfort, and functionality for the crew.
armoured.impact: The ergonomic and functional improvements in the Marauder Mark2 reduce driver and crew fatigue, enhancing usability and readiness in rugged and remote theaters.

armoured.t: Challenger 3 mobility trials conducted
armoured.body: RBSL conducted mobility trials for the Challenger 3, refining the vehicle to meet customer requirements. Data from these trials will be used to program a Turret Test Rig for reliability growth.
armoured.impact: The trials ensure the Challenger 3 meets reliability and performance standards, crucial for its planned service by 2030.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall signed contract for 123 Boxer Heavy Weapon Carriers
armoured.body: Rheinmetall signed a contract with Australia to produce 123 Boxer Heavy Weapon Carriers, with deliveries starting in 2025 and the first Australian-made unit in 2026. The Boxer Heavy Weapon Carrier is equipped with the Lance turret featuring a 30mm automatic cannon.
armoured.impact: This contract marks a significant export opportunity for Rheinmetall, with over 100 units to be exported to Germany, making it the largest military export from Australia to Germany.

armoured.t: First upgraded Ariete C2 tank delivered
armoured.body: The first upgraded Ariete C2 tank was delivered to the Italian Army, enhancing the armored capabilities of the Army. The upgrade includes ten-year logistical support.
armoured.impact: The modernization program strengthens the Italian defense industry's expertise in tracked vehicles and extends the operational life of the Ariete platform.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveils Lynx 120 mechanized fire support vehicle
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Defence Australia unveiled the Lynx 120, a mechanized fire support vehicle featuring a 120mm smoothbore gun and advanced combat technologies. The vehicle is designed to deliver maximum lethality and firepower, with growth potential and assured overmatch capability.
armoured.impact: The Lynx 120 represents a significant advancement in mechanized fire support, offering enhanced lethality and flexibility on the battlefield, complemented by its modular design and integration with advanced defensive systems.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall demonstrated Skyranger 35 on Leopard 1 tank
armoured.body: Rheinmetall showcased the Skyranger 35 system on a Leopard 1 tank during the Skyranger System Demonstration 2024. Successful firing tests were conducted.
armoured.impact: The demonstration highlights Rheinmetall's capability to adapt Leopard 1 tanks with advanced air defense systems, targeting potential orders from Ukraine.

armoured.t: Denel to debut GI-30 30mm CamGun at DSEI
armoured.body: Denel is set to unveil the GI-30 30mm CamGun at DSEI, designed to be the main weapon system for the South African Badger ICV. The GI-30 features a drum-cam mechanism for reduced gas emissions and a dual feeder for link-less ammunition, marking a world-first.
armoured.impact: The GI-30's unique features, including its drum-cam mechanism and dual feeder for link-less ammunition, position it as a global leader in infantry combat vehicle weapon systems, enhancing firing rates and reducing gas emissions.

armoured.t: BAE Systems completed shipboard testing of ACV prototype
armoured.body: BAE Systems completed shipboard testing of its Amphibious Combat Vehicle prototype with Iveco Defense Vehicles. The vehicle demonstrated capabilities in surf and white caps, including traction and self-recovery onto the ship.
armoured.impact: This testing marks a significant milestone in the ACV development, showcasing the vehicle's ability to operate effectively in challenging maritime environments, crucial for amphibious operations.

armoured.t: Plasan unveiled ATHENA, TAPS, and LAPS for armoured vehicles
armoured.body: Plasan unveiled three new protection systems for armoured vehicles: ATHENA, TAPS, and LAPS. These systems address various threats including shaped charges, medium calibre KE rounds, and top attack bomblets.
armoured.impact: The new systems enhance the survivability of armoured vehicles against a range of threats, offering modular and lightweight solutions.

armoured.t: Mbombe 4x4 passes STANAG 4569 tests
armoured.body: The Mbombe 4x4 armoured vehicle has passed rigorous STANAG 4569 tests, including TNT explosions and IED simulations, demonstrating its mine protection capabilities. The vehicle is designed for local manufacturing and prioritizes soldier survivability.
armoured.impact: The successful completion of these tests positions the Mbombe 4x4 as a highly reliable and survivable armoured vehicle, meeting stringent international standards for occupant protection.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall tests Soucy Composite Rubber Track on Lynx IFV
armoured.body: Rheinmetall demonstrated the Soucy Composite Rubber Track on the Lynx KF41 Infantry Fighting Vehicle, showcasing its operational capability and flexibility.
armoured.impact: This test highlights the modularity of the Lynx IFV, allowing it to be configured with either steel or composite rubber tracks based on operational needs, enhancing its adaptability.

armoured.t: BAE Systems demonstrated AMPV prototypes
armoured.body: BAE Systems has built and demonstrated prototypes for the five AMPV variants. This move is seen as an opportunity to accelerate the program’s schedule.
armoured.impact: The demonstration of AMPV prototypes by BAE Systems could expedite the program's timeline and secure a significant position in the Army’s largest combat vehicle program.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates modular Lynx KF41 armoured vehicle concept
