armoured.body: Rheinmetall has demonstrated the Lynx KF41, a modular armoured vehicle concept with a common drive module and flexible mission modules. The concept allows for various vehicle variants including infantry fighting, air defence, command, and medical vehicles.
armoured.impact: The modular design of Lynx KF41 reduces lifecycle costs and enhances adaptability for military users, enabling them to develop new capabilities and adapt force structures efficiently.

armoured.t: BLT T-72 bridge layer tank demonstrated
armoured.body: BLT T-72 is a bridge layer tank that can deploy a 20m or 22m prefabricated steel bridge to facilitate rapid crossing of obstacles by armoured units. It has limited armament and can optionally be fitted with a KMT-6 mine plough.
armoured.impact: The BLT T-72 enhances mobility and operational flexibility for armoured units by enabling quick bridge deployment over obstacles, crucial for maintaining momentum in offensive operations.

armoured.t: GDLS unveiled MPF light tank prototype
armoured.body: GDLS revealed a prototype light tank for the US Army's MPF program. The tank features an M1 Abrams turret and a 105 mm cannon.
armoured.impact: This prototype addresses the US Army's need for increased firepower and protection in light tanks, potentially setting a new standard for future armored vehicles.

armoured.t: Arquus demonstrates ARMIS 6x6 armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Arquus demonstrated the ARMIS 6x6 armoured vehicle, designed to replace the GBC-180. The vehicle features reinforced chassis and can cross slopes at 50%.
armoured.impact: The ARMIS 6x6, with its advanced capabilities and integration of civilian technologies, positions Arquus to secure a significant share of the French military's heavy truck replacement program.

armoured.t: GDLS successfully tested ARV C4/UAS variant with USMC
armoured.body: GDLS completed testing of its ARV C4/UAS variant with the USMC, designed for future reconnaissance needs. The vehicle incorporates advanced C4/UAS capabilities and is set for further development.
armoured.impact: The successful testing positions GDLS to meet USMC requirements for advanced reconnaissance, enhancing battlefield coordination and sensor integration.

armoured.t: Indra unveiled Keiler Next Generation armoured vehicle platform
armoured.body: Indra unveiled the Keiler Next Generation armoured vehicle platform in June 2024. The platform includes a mine plough, rocket-assisted mine-clearing line charge, and a magnetic signature duplicator.
armoured.impact: The unveiling of the Keiler Next Generation platform highlights Indra's capability in developing advanced mine-clearing and signature management technologies for armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: PSM to upgrade 154 Puma IFVs with MELLS and new sensors
armoured.body: PSM, a Rheinmetall JV, will upgrade 154 Puma IFVs with MELLS missiles and new sensors. Rheinmetall's share is €501m.
armoured.impact: This upgrade enhances Puma IFVs' standoff capabilities and sensor suite, improving their combat effectiveness.

armoured.t: Lockheed Martin proposed lighter, more affordable JLTV
armoured.body: Lockheed Martin proposed a lighter and more affordable JLTV for the U.S. Army. The company optimized its EMD design for production, reducing weight by hundreds of pounds.
armoured.impact: This advancement could lead to more cost-effective and maneuverable armoured vehicles for the U.S. Army, enhancing operational flexibility and efficiency.

armoured.t: Patria signs MoUs for AMV XP 8x8 CZ platform
armoured.body: Patria signed MoUs with Czech state enterprises for the AMV XP 8x8 CZ platform, aiming to involve Czech industry in the project. The AMV XP 8x8 CZ is the latest version of Patria's combat-proven AMV platform.
armoured.impact: This cooperation will ensure significant domestic industry participation, technology transfer, and capability development for the Czech Armed Forces' new 8x8 wheeled armoured vehicle.

armoured.t: CVRDE and L&T developed the Indian Light Tank
armoured.body: CVRDE (DRDO) and L&T jointly developed the Indian Light Tank, a next-generation armoured vehicle. It weighs 25 tons and features a high power-to-weight ratio for agility and mobility.
armoured.impact: The Indian Light Tank's advanced design and capabilities enhance India's border security and operational flexibility, especially in challenging terrains.

armoured.t: Developing autonomous combat vehicle technologies
armoured.body: Rheinmetall is partnering with DST, CSIRO, QUT, and RMIT to develop autonomous combat vehicle technologies under the ACW program. The aim is to create advanced sovereign robotics and automated vehicle technologies in Australia.
armoured.impact: This partnership will enhance Australia's capability to develop next-generation automated combat vehicle technologies, fostering local innovation and expertise.

armoured.t: Thales unveils Bushmaster Mulga MRAP variant
armoured.body: Thales Australia unveiled the Bushmaster Mulga MRAP variant at Eurosatory 2026, featuring advanced integration capabilities for sensors, effectors, and mission systems.
armoured.impact: The Bushmaster Mulga variant aims to meet current warfighting requirements with enhanced features, targeting global customers and potentially influencing MRAP procurement decisions.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveils KF51 Panther tank
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the KF51 Panther tank at Eurosatory, a 50-ton plus class vehicle designed for export. The Panther uses components of the Leopard 2 hull but features a new turret and 130mm cannon.
armoured.impact: The KF51 Panther represents a significant advancement in Rheinmetall's armoured vehicle portfolio, targeting export markets with a modern, versatile tank design.

armoured.t: BAE Systems delivers first ACV-30 test vehicle
armoured.body: BAE Systems delivered the first ACV-30 test vehicle to the US Marine Corps for evaluation. The ACV-30 features a remote turret that enhances troop transport and reduces weight.
armoured.impact: The ACV-30's remote turret design improves mobility and operational efficiency, providing a significant upgrade over legacy systems.

armoured.t: Thales launched Bushmaster MR6 with improved blast and ballistic protection
armoured.body: Thales unveiled the Bushmaster Multi Role 6 (MR6) with enhanced blast and ballistic protection. The MR6 is designed for the UK’s Multi-Role Vehicle Protected (MRVP) program and features a deep V-Hull for improved crew safety.
armoured.impact: The MR6's advanced protection and flexibility in multiple configurations make it a significant upgrade for modern battlefield requirements, ensuring operational readiness for the next 15-to-20 years.

armoured.t: Leonardo and KNDS signed agreement for MBT programme
armoured.body: Leonardo and KNDS signed an agreement to collaborate on the development, manufacturing, and maintenance of the Leopard 2A8 MBT for the Italian Army. This strategic alliance aims to strengthen the national industrial base and support future European and export projects.
armoured.impact: The alliance will enhance Italy's armoured vehicle capabilities and industrial base, aligning with the Italian MoD's modernisation strategy and supporting the procurement of advanced MBTs.

armoured.t: Hawkei vehicle passes blast tests
armoured.body: Thales Australia's Hawkei vehicle has successfully passed blast tests, demonstrating its high level of protection. The vehicle is designed to meet the needs of global defense forces for a protected, mobile, and integrated vehicle.
armoured.impact: The successful blast tests and user trials indicate that Hawkei meets stringent requirements for protection and mobility, positioning it as a leading option for global defense forces.

armoured.t: LRMV JV delivers first Lynx infantry fighting vehicles to Italian Army
armoured.driver: Leonardo Rheinmetall Military Vehicles (LRMV) Joint Venture
armoured.body: The LRMV JV delivered the first Lynx infantry fighting vehicles to the Italian Army, marking the start of the A2CS programme. The vehicles aim to strengthen land systems through advanced platforms.
armoured.impact: The delivery of the Lynx vehicles represents a significant step in modernizing the Italian Army's combat capabilities, aligning with the evolving international security landscape.

armoured.t: Lockheed Martin to test and validate Havoc 8x8 vehicle
armoured.body: Lockheed Martin received a contract to test and validate its Havoc 8x8 vehicle for the Marine Personnel Carrier program. The Havoc 8x8 is a combat-proven solution in service with six countries.
armoured.impact: The validation of the Havoc 8x8 vehicle for the MPC program underscores its reliability and advanced capabilities, positioning it as a strong contender for future armored vehicle requirements.

armoured.t: Jackal 3 (Extenda) platform build programme completed
armoured.body: Supacat completed the Jackal 3 (Extenda) platform build programme, delivering high-mobility vehicles to the British Army. The programme marks a significant milestone in collaboration between British industry and the armed forces.
armoured.impact: The completion of the programme enhances the British Army's capability with highly adaptable and off-road capable vehicles, underscoring the importance of such collaborations in supporting local industry and defence.

armoured.t: BAE Systems displays RG35 4x4 mine protected vehicle
armoured.body: BAE Systems showcased the RG35 4x4 at Eurosatory 2012, a mine-protected vehicle adaptable for various battlefield roles.
armoured.impact: The RG35 4x4's adaptability and protection capabilities address current battlefield needs, enhancing operational flexibility and soldier safety.

armoured.t: SHERPA Scout 120 MC integrates 120mm mortar
armoured.body: Arquus showcased the SHERPA Scout 120 MC at Eurosatory, featuring an onboard 120mm mortar with 32 rounds. The vehicle meets STANAG 4569 requirements and offers enhanced protection and mobility.
armoured.impact: This integration enhances the vehicle's firepower and versatility, providing a robust solution for ground forces.

armoured.t: Hanwha displayed MIFV-CH25, an upgraded K200 IFV
armoured.body: Hanwha Aerospace showcased the MIFV-CH25, an upgraded version of the K200 IFV, at the DSA 2026 exhibition. The MIFV-CH25 is a proof-of-concept prototype developed in collaboration with Cendana.
armoured.impact: The MIFV-CH25 represents a significant upgrade to the K200 platform, enhancing its capabilities and potentially opening new markets for Hanwha Aerospace.

armoured.t: Nexter presents PG Guard wire cage armour
armoured.body: Nexter introduced the PG Guard wire cage armour at IAV 2012 to protect vehicles from RPG threats. The system is part of a trend by multiple companies to develop such armour.
armoured.impact: PG Guard addresses a critical vulnerability of armoured vehicles against RPGs, enhancing soldier protection in conflict zones.

armoured.t: Titus armoured vehicle with tethered drone
armoured.body: Nexter unveiled a Titus armoured vehicle concept with a tethered drone that can fly up to 50 meters. The drone can be launched from the vehicle’s roof for reconnaissance.
armoured.impact: The tethered drone enhances the Titus vehicle's reconnaissance capabilities, providing real-time surveillance for special forces and other military units.

armoured.t: Leclerc tank sights modernized with latest optronic tech
armoured.body: Safran Electronics & Defense is developing modernized sights for the Leclerc tank, incorporating latest optronic and inertial technologies to enhance observation and engagement capabilities.
armoured.impact: The modernization will significantly improve the tank's ability to detect, identify, and target objects at long distances, enhancing its combat effectiveness.

armoured.t: Thales develops Bushmaster medevac variant for Netherlands
armoured.body: Thales Australia is developing a new Bushmaster medevac variant for the Netherlands, involving over 60 Australian businesses in the process.
armoured.impact: This development enhances the Bushmaster's versatility and export potential, securing jobs and investment in Australia.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall unveiled Natter 7.62 remote-controlled weapon station
armoured.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the Natter 7.62, a remote-controlled weapon station for tracked vehicles. It integrates advanced day and night vision technology and modular weapon kits.
armoured.impact: The Natter 7.62 sets new standards for vehicle protection and dynamic targeting, offering significant operational advantages in combat scenarios.

armoured.t: Arquus developed hybrid propulsion for Griffon armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Arquus developed a hybrid propulsion system for the Griffon armoured vehicle, aiming to reduce fuel consumption and lower thermal and acoustic signatures. This system is part of ongoing research to simplify vehicle use and logistics.
armoured.impact: The hybrid propulsion system enhances the tactical maneuverability and stealth of the Griffon, reducing its detectability and operational costs.

armoured.t: Hanwha unveiled the Tigon armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Hanwha unveiled the Tigon, an armoured vehicle that builds on the success of the Black Fox. The Tigon can host a crew of two and 11 dismounts, and it is designed for amphibious operations.
armoured.impact: The Tigon's amphibious capabilities and modular design, allowing for various calibers of turrets, make it a versatile platform for future military operations.

armoured.t: VBCI 3030 with new turret unveiled
armoured.body: Nexter unveiled the VBCI 3030 at HEMUS 2020, featuring a new turret developed with John Cockerill Defense. The new turret, Cockerill 3030, can integrate various types of cannons and anti-tank missile launchers.
armoured.impact: The VBCI 3030 showcases modular design flexibility, enhancing its adaptability to different combat scenarios and potentially making it more competitive in international markets.

armoured.t: Panther KF51 EVO to feature L55A1 smoothbore gun and autoloader
armoured.body: Rheinmetall is developing the Panther KF51 EVO tank for Hungary, featuring an L55A1 smoothbore gun and an autoloader. The contract is worth €288 million.
armoured.impact: The Panther KF51 EVO sets a new standard for combat effectiveness in mechanized formations, enhancing Hungary's national defense capabilities.

armoured.t: KAAV II prototype with increased waterborne speed demonstrated
armoured.body: Hanwha Aerospace demonstrated the KAAV II prototype, an amphibious assault vehicle with a waterborne speed exceeding 20km/h. This prototype aims to replace the current KAAV fleet used by the ROKMC.
armoured.impact: The KAAV II's higher speed allows for quicker beach landings and safer launches from farther distances, enhancing operational flexibility and reducing exposure to enemy fire.

armoured.t: Sarath BMP-II demonstrated amphibious and mobility capabilities
armoured.body: Sarath BMP-II demonstrated mobility on land and water, with a speed of 65 kmph on land and 7 kmph in water, and the ability to overcome steep slopes and obstacles.
armoured.impact: The vehicle's amphibious and mobility capabilities enhance battlefield flexibility and operational range, providing significant tactical advantages.

armoured.t: Fenris fire support vehicle with Cockerill 3105 turret
armoured.body: John Cockerill and Arquus debuted the Fenris fire support vehicle at Eurosatory 2026, integrating the Cockerill 3105 turret onto the Jaguar AFV platform with minor modernisations.
armoured.impact: The Fenris vehicle offers a rapid 16-month delivery timeframe, enhancing operational readiness and flexibility for military forces.

armoured.t: Elbit Systems developed M-RCV Medium Robotic Combat Vehicle
armoured.body: Elbit Systems developed the M-RCV Medium Robotic Combat Vehicle, featuring autonomous reconnaissance and controlled lethality in all-terrain conditions.
armoured.impact: The M-RCV's advanced autonomous capabilities and versatility in terrain conditions represent a significant technological advancement in robotic combat vehicles.

armoured.t: Developing autonomous vehicle systems for Boxer CRVs
armoured.body: Rheinmetall Defence Australia and DST are developing autonomous vehicle systems for the Boxer combat reconnaissance vehicle fleet. This builds on their existing collaboration in simulation and augmented reality.
armoured.impact: The autonomous technology will enhance the capabilities of the Boxer CRVs, supporting the Australian Defence Force's modernization efforts.

armoured.t: Thales unveils Bushmaster 5.6 (Mulga) with enhanced capabilities
armoured.body: Thales Australia unveiled the Bushmaster 5.6 (Mulga) at Eurosatory 2026, featuring advanced threat detection, autonomous system support, and rapid technology integration. The vehicle can carry a range of sensors and effectors, including Thales’s LGR275 Proxy 70mm rockets.
armoured.impact: The Mulga enhances battlefield adaptability and survivability, addressing modern combat requirements and threats such as drones, positioning it as a leading protected mobility vehicle.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall upgrades Marder 1A3 IFVs
armoured.body: Rheinmetall has upgraded 50 Marder 1A3 infantry fighting vehicles for Jordan, with plans for a third batch. The upgrades include modernization for border patrol.
armoured.impact: The upgrade enhances the combat readiness and operational capabilities of Jordan's Marder fleet, ensuring they remain effective in border security operations.

armoured.t: First digital twin demonstrator for ground combat systems
armoured.body: KNDS and ARQUUS developed the first digital twin demonstrator for ground combat systems, building on years of experience. This technology is central to the digital architectures of future combat vehicles.
armoured.impact: This development signifies a significant step towards integrating advanced digital technologies into armoured vehicle design and operation, enhancing simulation and testing capabilities.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall's StrikeShield APS fitted to Lynx vehicles
armoured.body: Rheinmetall's StrikeShield hard-kill active protection system will be integrated into Hungary's Lynx infantry fighting vehicles. The system is claimed to have the fastest reaction time and is part of a hybrid armour design.
armoured.impact: The integration of StrikeShield into Lynx vehicles enhances their protection against modern anti-tank threats, aligning with Hungary's commitment to NATO missions.

armoured.t: SEDA 100 L C acoustic shot detection system demonstrated
armoured.body: ASELSAN's SEDA 100 L C system can detect and locate gunshots, directing vehicle weapons for rapid return fire. It offers 360-degree coverage and operates effectively in various conditions.
armoured.impact: This system enhances armoured vehicle survivability by enabling quick response to threats, improving combat effectiveness.

armoured.t: WhAP 8x8 showcased as amphibious APC/ICV
armoured.body: Tata Advanced Systems Limited showcased the WhAP 8x8 at DEFEA 2025, an amphibious APC/ICV capable of accommodating up to 12 soldiers and supporting various weapon systems. The Greek military expressed interest in the vehicle.
armoured.impact: The WhAP 8x8's versatility and amphibious capabilities make it a strong contender for export, particularly in markets like Greece, underscoring India's growing defence manufacturing prowess.

armoured.t: Software tested to help armoured vehicles shoot down drones
armoured.body: The U.S. Army tested software enabling armoured vehicles to target and destroy moving drones. The SWAT-FC project demonstrated this capability in April using a Common Remotely Operated Weapon Station.
armoured.impact: This advance enhances the defensive capabilities of armoured vehicles against drone threats, improving situational awareness and response times.

armoured.t: Arquus developed Advanced Survivability System against RPGs
armoured.body: Arquus developed the Advanced Survivability System to protect against RPGs and tandem shaped charges. The system includes two types of add-on armour and SMART-PROTech active protection.
armoured.impact: This system enhances the VAB Mk III's survivability, showcasing the vehicle's modularity in protection upgrades.

armoured.t: Roshel introduced new-generation Captain at Eurosatory 2026
armoured.body: Roshel introduced the new-generation Captain at Eurosatory 2026, a vehicle designed to bridge the gap between traditional armored personnel carriers and lighter protected vehicles.
armoured.impact: The new-generation Captain offers a smaller, more cost-effective solution with high payload capacity and STANAG level 2 protection, addressing the needs of smaller militaries and security forces.

armoured.t: Challenger 2 tanks upgraded with new turret and 120mm L55A1 gun
armoured.body: Rheinmetall is upgrading 148 Challenger 2 tanks with new turrets and 120mm L55A1 guns, enhancing their combat effectiveness. The upgrades will place the modernized tanks at the forefront of NATO technology.
armoured.impact: The modernization will significantly improve the tanks' lethality and survivability, making them more effective on the battlefield.

armoured.t: VAB MK3 armoured personnel carrier presented
armoured.body: Arquus presented the VAB MK3 armoured personnel carrier at the World Defense Show 2024, showcasing performance improvements in drivetrain, braking, and steering.
armoured.impact: The VAB MK3's enhancements demonstrate Arquus's capability to modernize tactical vehicles, meeting specific client requirements and establishing strong industrial partnerships.

armoured.t: MK44 Bushmaster Chain Gun demonstrated with air-bursting munition fuze
armoured.body: Orbital ATK demonstrated the MK44 Bushmaster Chain Gun with proprietary air-bursting munition fuze-setting equipment, showcasing its precision and capability in live fire.
armoured.impact: The demonstration highlights the MK44's advanced capabilities in engaging targets with precision air-bursting munitions, enhancing armoured vehicle effectiveness.

armoured.t: NORINCO developing new export-oriented AFVs and MBTs
armoured.body: NORINCO is developing a range of export-oriented armoured fighting vehicles and main battle tanks. The VT5 light tank, with a 105mm gun and modular armour, is being marketed for its terrain capabilities.
armoured.impact: The development of the VT5 light tank and other export-oriented AFVs and MBTs positions NORINCO to compete in international markets, offering versatile and lightweight solutions.

armoured.t: Development of Skyranger 30 turret for Lynx KF41
armoured.body: Rheinmetall received a development order from Hungary to customize the Skyranger 30 turret for the Lynx KF41 tracked armoured vehicle, integrating additional effectors to address current aerial threats.
armoured.impact: This development underscores Rheinmetall's position as a leader in short-range air defence, providing a solution to contemporary threats such as drone attacks.

armoured.t: Leopard 2 PL modernization program demonstrated
armoured.body: Rheinmetall demonstrated the Leopard 2 PL modernization program at IDEX 2017, showcasing upgrades for 128 Polish Leopard 2 MBTs. The program includes advanced thermal imaging and enhanced main armament capabilities.
armoured.impact: This modernization program enhances the combat effectiveness and longevity of the Leopard 2 MBT, positioning Rheinmetall as a key player in tank modernization.

armoured.t: Paramount Group showcases Mbombe 6 infantry combat vehicle
armoured.body: Paramount Group demonstrated the Mbombe 6 infantry combat vehicle at ADEX 2016, highlighting its adaptability and protection features.
armoured.impact: The Mbombe 6's sophisticated adaptability and shared technologies across the Mbombe family offer cost-effective solutions for multi-role combat and personnel carrier needs.

armoured.t: Rheinmetall establishes MILVEHCOE for Boxer 8x8 programme
armoured.body: Rheinmetall is establishing a Military Vehicle Centre of Excellence (MILVEHCOE) near Brisbane to support the Boxer 8x8 programme for the UK Ministry of Defence’s Mechanized Infantry Vehicle programme. The MILVEHCOE will serve as a focal point for the execution of the programme and support the Australian Government’s Defence Export Strategy.
armoured.impact: The establishment of MILVEHCOE signifies Rheinmetall's commitment to localizing advanced armoured vehicle manufacturing in Australia, enhancing its export potential.

armoured.t: Hanwha Defense Australia demonstrated Redback combat vehicle
armoured.body: Hanwha Defense Australia demonstrated the Redback combat vehicle, a variant of the K21 BMP designed for the South Korean army. The vehicle has a mass of 42 tons, a maximum speed of 65 km/h, and a range of 520 km.
armoured.impact: The demonstration of the Redback combat vehicle is significant for the LAND 400 Phase 3 program, as it aims to supply 450 infantry fighting vehicles to the Australian Army with a budget of 18 to 27 billion dollars.

armoured.t: Lockheed Martin unveiled an unmanned turret for armoured vehicles
armoured.body: Lockheed Martin UK unveiled an unmanned turret at WDS 2026, designed to be agnostic in terms of weapons and sensors, fitting cannons from 25mm to 40mm. The turret can be up-armoured and includes radar panels and a camera system for 360° coverage.
armoured.impact: This turret enhances the flexibility and combat effectiveness of armoured vehicles, allowing for integration with various weapon systems and advanced sensor packages.

armoured.t: Hanwha demonstrated Tigon 6×6 armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Hanwha showcased the Tigon 6×6 at EDEX 2018, a vehicle capable of transporting up to nine dismounts and fitting with a medium calibre remote-controlled turret. Hanwha is also developing an 8×8 version of the vehicle.
armoured.impact: The Tigon 6×6 offers enhanced mobility and firepower, making it a competitive option for Middle Eastern and African markets seeking versatile armoured vehicles.

armoured.t: BAE demonstrated upgraded Challenger 2 tank with new turret and L55 main armament
armoured.body: BAE showcased an upgraded version of the Challenger 2 tank at the British Army's Defence Vehicle Dynamics event, featuring a new turret and 120 mm smoothbore L55 main armament. The upgrade includes advanced electronic architecture and various defensive systems.
armoured.impact: The upgrade enhances the tank's combat effectiveness and survivability, aligning with modern warfare requirements.

armoured.t: Simha 4x4 unveiled as next-gen light armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Paramount and Kalyani Strategic Systems unveiled the Simha 4x4, a next-generation light armoured multi-purpose vehicle designed for evolving military needs. The vehicle is highly adaptable and developed to meet the requirements of modern armed forces.
armoured.impact: The Simha 4x4 addresses critical mobility and protection needs for armed forces in various regions, offering a versatile platform for urban warfare and reconnaissance.

armoured.t: Arquus unveiled Scarabée 'Akeron' hybrid armoured vehicle
armoured.body: Arquus unveiled the Scarabée 'Akeron', a hybrid armoured vehicle designed for urban combat. It features two independent directions and a turning radius under 5 meters.
armoured.impact: The Scarabée 'Akeron' offers enhanced maneuverability and flexibility for urban combat scenarios, making it a significant advancement in armoured vehicle technology.

smallarms.t: IWI developed ARBEL system to control trigger timing against drones
smallarms.body: IWI developed the ARBEL system to control trigger timing for soldiers engaging small aerial targets like FPV drones. ARBEL is designed as a last-line defensive capability against such drones.
smallarms.impact: ARBEL enhances infantry's ability to counter small tactical drones, providing a critical defensive edge in modern combat scenarios.

smallarms.t: Rheinmetall develops PTAL aiming laser module for pistols
smallarms.body: Rheinmetall has developed the PTAL, a compact aiming laser module for pistols. It features IR and visible lasers, adjustable power, and a training mode.
smallarms.impact: PTAL enhances precision and versatility in pistol aiming, offering tactical advantages without ITAR restrictions.

smallarms.t: Thales developed ACAR assault rifle
smallarms.body: Thales developed the ACAR assault rifle, an evolution of the F90, for Australian and foreign defense needs. It was unveiled at the Land Forces exhibition in 2022.
smallarms.impact: The ACAR's versatility in multiple calibers and recent delivery to Ukraine highlights its strategic importance for modern military operations.

smallarms.t: DRDO developed a Close Quarter Battle carbine
smallarms.body: DRDO developed the Close Quarter Battle carbine, a 5.56×45mm NATO weapon with a rate of fire over 600 rounds/min. Bharat Forge manufactures it for the Indian Armed Forces.
smallarms.impact: The carbine's high rate of fire and effective range of 200m make it a potent close-quarters weapon for Indian forces, enhancing their tactical flexibility.

smallarms.t: Thales demonstrates F-90 assault rifle
smallarms.body: Thales has developed the F-90 assault rifle, a light and innovative weapon derived from the F88 Austeyr. The F-90 features an open architecture that integrates NATO Tri Rail and allows for centralized power supply and data distribution.
smallarms.impact: The F-90's open architecture and modular design enhance its adaptability and functionality, making it a significant advancement in small arms technology.

smallarms.t: Raytheon and Saab developed guided Carl-Gustaf munition
smallarms.body: Raytheon and Saab developed a guided version of the Carl-Gustaf munition, offering greater precision and multi-target capability. The new munition will allow armed forces to engage targets up to 2,000 metres with pin-point accuracy.
smallarms.impact: This development enhances the combat effectiveness of infantry forces by minimising collateral damage and increasing engagement range and accuracy.

smallarms.t: Thales develops next gen soldier weapon system
smallarms.body: Thales Australia's Lithgow facility is developing a next generation soldier weapon system for the ADF, integrating advanced digital technologies and sensors.
smallarms.impact: This system aims to provide Australian soldiers with an enduring battlefield advantage by leveraging disruptive digital technologies and advanced sensors.

smallarms.t: Thales unveiled the F90MBR assault rifle
smallarms.body: Thales introduced the F90MBR assault rifle at DSEI 2017, featuring ambidextrous and modular design. It is a new generation of the F90 rifle used by the Australian Defence Force.
smallarms.impact: The F90MBR's advanced features enhance user flexibility and adaptability, aligning with Thales's commitment to support military forces.

smallarms.t: Kalashnikov Concern develops AK-12 modernized rifle
smallarms.body: Kalashnikov Concern is developing the AK-12, a modernized rifle for the Russian Army. The AK-12 features enhanced ergonomics, Picatinny rails, and adjustable components.
smallarms.impact: The AK-12 aims to replace three aging rifle models, standardizing on a single modernized rifle. Its competitive price and enhanced features make it attractive for both domestic and export markets.

smallarms.t: Saab and Raytheon completed guided flight tests for Carl-Gustaf
smallarms.body: Saab and Raytheon completed guided flight tests for the Carl-Gustaf Munition, demonstrating semi-active laser guidance and optional seeker technologies. Tests included firing against static and moving targets.
smallarms.impact: The guided munition enhances precision and minimizes collateral damage, marking a significant advancement in shoulder-launched weapon systems.

smallarms.t: Kalashnikov's anti-drone shotgun shells developed
smallarms.body: Techcrim developed specialized anti-drone ammunition for Kalashnikov's shotguns. The 12-gauge 'Antidrone KS' shell maximizes striking small aerial targets with hardened lead pellets.
smallarms.impact: The ammunition is designed to engage FPV drones and quadcopters up to 75 metres, addressing a significant battlefield threat.

smallarms.t: Saab demonstrated programmable Carl-Gustaf HE 448 munition
smallarms.body: Saab showcased the programmable Carl-Gustaf HE 448 munition at a live fire event, indicating its readiness for delivery to customers. The munition communicates with the new Fire Control Device 558, enhancing battlefield capabilities.
smallarms.impact: The programmable HE 448 munition increases range and effectiveness, providing a more efficient sighting solution for Carl-Gustaf users, enhancing tactical flexibility and precision.

smallarms.t: Saab developed AT4, a disposable weapon system
smallarms.body: Saab developed the AT4, a disposable weapon system for the U.S. Army. The AT4 allows soldiers to engage targets effectively and safely.
smallarms.impact: The AT4's multi-target capabilities and behind-the-wall effects enhance soldier safety and combat effectiveness.

smallarms.t: AI-Enabled Containerised Small Arms Firing Range commissioned
smallarms.body: Zen Technologies has commissioned India's first AI-Enabled Containerised Small Arms Firing Range for the Indian Navy, offering advanced simulation and live-fire training.
smallarms.impact: This facility enhances training realism and accessibility for armed forces, aligning with the Indian Navy's strategic vision for modern training infrastructure.

smallarms.t: Fabryka Broni “Łucznik” Radom delivers MSBS GROT A3 assault rifles
smallarms.body: Fabryka Broni “Łucznik” Radom has delivered the MSBS GROT A3 assault rifles to Poland, an upgraded version of the GROT rifle. The A3 configuration includes improvements to ergonomics and internal components, making it the most refined iteration to date.
smallarms.impact: The GROT A3's improvements enhance reliability and flexibility in various operational scenarios, positioning it to become the standard individual weapon for a significant portion of Poland's ground forces.

smallarms.t: MMT-76 door gun passed 40 NATO tests
smallarms.body: The MMT-76 door gun has passed 40 NATO standard tests, qualifying it for serial production. It is designed for use on general-purpose helicopters and as an infantry-type light machine gun.
smallarms.impact: The MMT-76's multi-role capability and high reliability will enhance the operational effectiveness of Turkish and allied forces, providing a lighter and more durable option compared to NATO-standard counterparts.

smallarms.t: Kalashnikov unveils AK-200 family of assault rifles
smallarms.body: Kalashnikov Group unveiled the AK-200 family of assault rifles at IDEX 2019, designed to replace the AK-100 family and AK-74M. The AK-200 supports multiple calibers and features a rate of fire of 600 rounds per minute.
smallarms.impact: The AK-200 family represents an evolution in small arms technology, offering enhanced flexibility with interchangeable magazines and support for various ammunition types.

smallarms.t: Saab and Raytheon develop guided munition for Carl-Gustaf
smallarms.body: Saab and Raytheon are developing a guided munition for the Carl-Gustaf system to meet U.S. Special Operations Command requirements. The new munition aims to increase precision and operational benefits for ground troops.
smallarms.impact: The guided munition will enhance the Carl-Gustaf's capability to engage multiple targets precisely, reducing collateral damage and increasing effectiveness against light armor and fortified structures.

smallarms.t: 7.62×39 SSS Defence Weapon rifle nearing completion
smallarms.body: SSS Defence is developing a 7.62×39 rifle, a modified version of the P-72 Rapid Engagement Combat Rifle, with a full-length rail and other improvements. The company aims to present it as an alternative to the AK-203 due to import bans.
smallarms.impact: The new rifle could challenge the dominance of the AK-203 and SIG 716 in the Indian Army's small arms inventory, offering a domestic alternative.

smallarms.t: Rheinmetall and Steyr Mannlicher developed RS556 modular assault rifle
smallarms.body: RS556 is a modular assault rifle based on STM 556, chambered in 5.56×45 mm NATO. It features a dry lubrication system and can accommodate 7 different barrel lengths.
smallarms.impact: RS556's modular design and reliability in extreme conditions make it a strong contender for modern infantry needs, addressing criticisms of previous models like the HK G-36.

smallarms.t: Developing advanced individual weapon system
smallarms.body: Thales is developing an advanced individual weapon system in Lithgow, NSW, integrating digital technologies and sensors to maintain a capability edge.
smallarms.impact: This system will provide Australian soldiers with an enduring battlefield advantage by integrating advanced technologies, ensuring they maintain a capability edge in a digitised battlespace.

smallarms.t: General Dynamics developed M2A1 upgrade for M2 machine gun
smallarms.body: General Dynamics developed the M2A1 upgrade for the M2 machine gun, offering new features and design improvements. These enhancements aim to reduce operator error, decrease muzzle flash, and streamline barrel changes.
smallarms.impact: The M2A1 upgrade maintains the proven performance of the M2HB while introducing innovations that enhance operational effectiveness and ease of use for military personnel.

ammunition.t: Developing 30mm x 173 Airburst Solution for U.S. Navy
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall is developing a 30mm x 173 Airburst Solution for the U.S. Navy under a $14.3M contract. The aim is to provide cost-effective ammunition to enhance existing and future weapon systems.
ammunition.impact: This development will likely improve the effectiveness and cost-efficiency of naval weapon systems, aligning with the U.S. Navy's modernization efforts.

ammunition.t: Leonardo's Vulcano munition triples Mk 45 gun range
ammunition.body: Leonardo's Vulcano munition, when adapted for BAE's Mk 45 gun, triples the gun's range. The munition uses GPS guidance and deployable fins for extended range.
ammunition.impact: This development addresses the U.S. Navy's need for a long-range guided munition, potentially replacing cancelled programs like the Long Range Land Attack Projectile.

ammunition.t: Live detonation of co-developed GMLRS warhead
ammunition.body: Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Thales conducted a live detonation of a co-developed GMLRS warhead in Australia, demonstrating local manufacturing capability. The warhead is intended for integration with the GMLRS precision munition.
ammunition.impact: This demonstration highlights Australia's capability to design, manufacture, and test advanced ammunition locally, reducing reliance on foreign supply chains.

ammunition.t: Fiocchi produces 12-gauge anti-drone ammunition
ammunition.body: Fiocchi has produced 12-gauge anti-drone ammunition, which has entered service through various routes to Russian and Ukrainian units. The ammunition is designed to maximize range, dispersion, and kinetic energy on target.
ammunition.impact: This development enhances the capability of infantry to counter unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with a wide array of projectiles, providing flexibility and effectiveness in close-range engagements.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall developed improved 120mm KE and HE ammunition
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall Defence has developed advanced 120mm kinetic energy and high explosive ammunition for Leopard 2 tanks, ensuring it remains effective against modern threats. The DM11 high explosive round is now the standard for several Leopard 2 user nations.
ammunition.impact: The improved ammunition enhances the Leopard 2's combat effectiveness, providing superior performance against a range of targets and ensuring continued dominance on the battlefield.

ammunition.t: Saab and Raytheon completed test firings of guided Carl-Gustaf munition
ammunition.body: Saab and Raytheon successfully tested the guided Carl-Gustaf munition, demonstrating its precision and multi-target capability. The munition uses a semi-active laser for guidance.
ammunition.impact: This development enhances the precision and effectiveness of the Carl-Gustaf system, reducing collateral damage and increasing operational flexibility.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall secures €4bn tank ammo order
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall has secured a significant €4bn contract to supply 120mm tank ammunition to the Bundeswehr and Ukrainian forces, demonstrating its capability in producing a wide range of tank ammunition types.
ammunition.impact: This contract underscores Rheinmetall's strategic importance in supplying critical ammunition for modern tank operations, supporting both NATO and Ukraine's defense needs.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall produces KE2020Neo high-performance ammunition
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH is contracted to produce the KE2020Neo high-performance ammunition for the Bundeswehr and British Army. The KE2020Neo uses a tungsten penetrator and is part of Rheinmetall's kinetic energy ammunition series.
ammunition.impact: This development underscores Rheinmetall's leading role in tank main armament and smoothbore technology, providing advanced ammunition for NATO and Western countries.

ammunition.t: 25mm FAP projectiles production line installed
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall NIOA Munitions will produce 25mm FAP projectiles at the Benalla plant, enabling a sovereign capability in medium-calibre munitions. The production line is scheduled to be installed by mid-2021.
ammunition.impact: This development enhances Australia's self-reliance in ammunition production, particularly for the F-35 programme.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall produces MK80 series bombs from raw material to end product
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall produces the entire MK80 series of bombs (MK82, MK83, MK84) from raw material to end product, catering to various users. The MK82 is the most widely used bomb body for air-to-ground bombs, developed in the 1950s by NAVAIR.
ammunition.impact: This production capability ensures Rheinmetall's dominance in the global market for MK80 series bombs, used by multiple air forces and navies worldwide.

ammunition.t: Nammo to produce 155mm, 120mm shells and 5.56/7.62mm cartridges
ammunition.body: Nammo will establish a production facility in Denmark to produce various ammunition types, including 155mm and 120mm shells, and 5.56 and 7.62mm cartridges. The facility will be minority-owned by the Danish government and is set to begin production in the second half of 2027.
ammunition.impact: This initiative will strengthen Denmark's ammunition supply chain and reinforce its strategic partnership within the Nordic region.

ammunition.t: Delivering 155mm artillery ammunition to Ukraine
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall is delivering 155mm artillery ammunition, including RH1412 projectiles, to Ukraine from its Niedersachsen plant for the first time. More than half of the order has already been delivered.
ammunition.impact: This delivery marks Rheinmetall's first direct shipment from the Niedersachsen plant to Ukraine, highlighting its expertise and expanding production capacity.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall developed DM98 120mm practice round
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH developed the DM98 120mm practice round, a successor to the DM18, featuring above average accuracy and tracer visibility.
ammunition.impact: The DM98 round enhances training effectiveness for Leopard 2 MBT operators by providing realistic full-calibre practice ammunition with superior accuracy and visibility.

ammunition.t: 70mm rocket systems for German market
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall Waffe Munition GmbH and Thales signed an agreement to develop and produce 70mm rocket systems for the German market. Thales' 70mm rockets are currently used on UHT Tiger and are under certification for H145M.
ammunition.impact: This collaboration leverages Thales' expertise in 70mm rockets and Rheinmetall's knowledge of the German customer, enhancing the capability of German military platforms.

ammunition.t: Joint test of Excalibur N5 munition
ammunition.body: Raytheon and the U.S. Navy conducted a joint test of the Excalibur N5 munition at Yuma Proving Ground. The test was a key step forward for the program, aiming to fire the munition from Arleigh Burke-class destroyer Mk 45 guns.
ammunition.impact: The test demonstrates the potential for Excalibur N5 to significantly extend the range of naval guns while maintaining precision, addressing the Navy's need for sea-launched precision projectiles.

ammunition.t: Nammo invested in a new primer factory
ammunition.body: Nammo announced a EUR 33 million investment in a new primer factory to bolster its supply chain and security of supply for Nordic defense forces. The factory is scheduled for completion in 2025.
ammunition.impact: This investment will enhance Nammo's production capacity and supply chain resilience, ensuring a steady supply of primers for both military and commercial ammunition.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall developing new generation 40mm MV ammunition
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall is developing a new generation of 40mm medium-velocity (MV) ammunition with an effective range of 800 metres. This ammunition is undergoing NATO qualification and will be available in service and practice versions.
ammunition.impact: The new 40mm MV ammunition significantly extends the combat range for infantry and provides enhanced engagement capabilities against lightly armoured and soft targets.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall can expand production to 600,000-700,000 shells/year
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall's CEO announced the company's capability to increase artillery shell production to 600,000 to 700,000 shells annually, during a visit by European Commissioner Thierry Breton.
ammunition.impact: This expansion highlights Germany's strategic role in enhancing EU ammunition production and supporting Ukraine's defense.

ammunition.t: Thales Toutatis teleoperated ammunition demonstrated
ammunition.body: Thales demonstrated its teleoperated ammunition Toutatis at the 2023 Bourget exhibition. Toutatis has a range of 10 km and is designed to neutralize light armoured vehicles.
ammunition.impact: The development of Toutatis represents a significant advancement in teleoperated ammunition technology, enhancing France's capability to counter light armoured threats.

ammunition.t: Nammo to develop 120mm ammunition for K2 MBT
ammunition.body: Nammo will develop 120mm ammunition for the K2 MBT, initially focusing on integration and safety standards. The agreement includes the development of a programmable fuze for enhanced functionality.
ammunition.impact: This development enhances the K2 MBT's interoperability with NATO standards and strengthens ammunition supply security for Norway and other users.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall developed the MITHRAS family of portable rockets
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall has developed the MITHRAS family of portable rockets, featuring improved effectiveness, reliability, and ease of use. The new ignition system meets STANAG 4497 safety standards.
ammunition.impact: The MITHRAS family of rockets enhances operational flexibility and training efficiency by standardizing ignition mechanisms and reducing training costs.

ammunition.t: Rheinmetall develops 30mm Airburst Munition for US Navy
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall is developing a 30mm Airburst Munition for the US Navy under a $14.3 million contract. The new MK 340 KEET ammunition aims to enhance the effectiveness of existing and future weapon systems.
ammunition.impact: This development could significantly increase the lethality of naval weapon systems with reduced ammunition expenditure, providing a cost-effective solution.

ammunition.t: Joint venture to develop 25mm ammunition for F35
ammunition.body: Rheinmetall and Day & Zimmermann established a joint venture to design and manufacture 25mm ammunition for the F35 Joint Strike Fighter. The venture combines Rheinmetall's expertise in ammunition design with D&Z's manufacturing capabilities.
ammunition.impact: This joint venture enhances Rheinmetall's position in the US ammunition market by leveraging D&Z's manufacturing expertise, ensuring high-quality production for advanced aircraft like the F35.

ammunition.t: Hanwha and WITU to jointly test 155mm ammunition
ammunition.body: Hanwha and WITU are collaborating to jointly test 155mm ammunition for Polish platforms, aiming to secure certification for self-propelled howitzers and establish an ammunition production base in Europe.
ammunition.impact: This collaboration enhances Poland's self-reliance in defense manufacturing by securing certification for its howitzers and potentially localizing ammunition production.

ammunition.t: Developed explosive removal and disassembly processes
ammunition.body: Nammo Vingåker has developed innovative processes for removing explosives and disassembling ammunition, including automatic and semiautomatic methods.
ammunition.impact: These processes enable efficient and environmentally friendly demilitarization, reducing costs and environmental impact.

ammunition.t: facility started rolling out small calibre ammunition
ammunition.body: Adani Defence & Aerospace has inaugurated a facility that started rolling out small calibre ammunition, with an initial output of 150 million rounds.
ammunition.impact: This production milestone significantly enhances India's self-reliance in ammunition supply, meeting up to 25% of the country's annual requirement.

ammunition.t: Saab launched HEAT 758 for Carl-Gustaf
ammunition.body: Saab has launched HEAT 758, an ammunition type for Carl-Gustaf designed to combat vehicles with explosive reactive armor. It uses Firebolt technology for communication between the grenade, weapon, and FCD 558 equipment.
ammunition.impact: HEAT 758 neutralizes explosive reactive armor and penetrates up to 700mm of armor, providing soldiers with enhanced protection against heavily armored vehicles.

ammunition.t: developed electronic fuze fb-40 for artillery
ammunition.body: AVNL developed the Electronic FUZE FB-40, a modular proximity fuze for artillery ammunition. It meets international standards and is designed to defeat aircraft, missiles, and small boat targets.
ammunition.impact: The FB-40's advanced features, including proximity and self-destruction modes, enhance the effectiveness and safety of artillery ammunition, aligning India's capabilities with international standards.

ammunition.t: AI-based inspection systems for real-time quality control
ammunition.body: Adani Defence uses AI-based inspection systems to monitor ammunition manufacturing in real-time, ensuring high quality and safety.
ammunition.impact: This advance ensures absolute safety, structural integrity, and elite performance standards for ammunition, reducing reliance on foreign imports.

ammunition.t: Nammo developed programmable ammunition
ammunition.body: Nammo has developed programmable ammunition that can be set to explode with pinpoint accuracy at various stages relative to the target. This technology is adaptable to multiple weapon platforms and aims to reduce collateral damage.
ammunition.impact: This advance significantly enhances the precision and effectiveness of ammunition against threats like armed drones, reducing the risk to personnel and infrastructure.

missiles.t: Ursa Major completes ground tests of new hypersonic rocket engine
missiles.body: Ursa Major has completed ground tests of its new hypersonic rocket engine, a significant step in developing hypersonic weapons technology. The company is expanding its capabilities into hypersonic weapons and solid rocket motors.
missiles.impact: This development enhances Ursa Major's position in the hypersonic weapons market and represents a critical milestone in the technological race for advanced missile systems.

missiles.t: Taiwan tested HF-III air-launched anti-ship missile
missiles.body: Taiwan conducted a test-fire of its HF-III air-launched supersonic anti-ship missile on July 1st, demonstrating its capability. This missile is part of Taiwan's efforts to enhance its asymmetric defence posture against China.
missiles.impact: The successful test of the HF-III missile reinforces Taiwan's naval defence capabilities, providing a potent anti-ship deterrent.

missiles.t: Japan deployed upgraded Type 12 ground-launched anti-ship missiles
missiles.body: Japan has deployed the upgraded Type 12 ground-launched anti-ship missiles to Camp Kengun in Kumamoto Prefecture. This deployment marks a significant enhancement in Japan's maritime defense capabilities.
missiles.impact: The deployment of the upgraded Type 12 missiles represents a substantial improvement in Japan's anti-ship missile capabilities, providing enhanced range and accuracy to defend against maritime threats.

missiles.t: India tested LRAShM, a long-range hypersonic missile
missiles.body: India successfully tested the LRAShM, a long-range hypersonic missile designed for precision strikes over 1,500 kilometers. The missile incorporates a delta-wing hypersonic glide vehicle and operates at speeds surpassing Mach 5.
missiles.impact: The LRAShM's successful test enhances India's capability to engage dynamic or heavily defended targets with high accuracy and survivability, marking a significant advancement in India's missile technology.

missiles.t: Thales FZ275 LGR certified for Arnold Defense launcher
missiles.body: Thales' FZ275 70mm/2.75in laser guided rocket has been certified to launch from Arnold Defense's LAND-LGR4 rocket launcher, expanding its compatibility and range.
missiles.impact: This certification enhances the precision and flexibility of ground-based rapid reaction forces, reducing collateral damage and dependency on other systems.

missiles.t: Raytheon demonstrated GhostEye MR sensor for NASAMS
missiles.body: Raytheon demonstrated the GhostEye MR sensor for NASAMS, showing its capability to provide a detailed air picture and support in neutralizing threats. The sensor was tested in a live threat scenario, confirming its viability for integrated air and missile defense.
missiles.impact: The successful demonstration of GhostEye MR enhances NASAMS' capability to counter sophisticated airborne threats, marking a significant step towards fielding an integrated air base defense system.

missiles.t: Doubling Stinger missile production
missiles.body: Raytheon is doubling Stinger missile production with European partners, including Diehl Defence, to meet global demand. Final assembly will occur in the Netherlands.
missiles.impact: This expansion ensures reliable supply to allies and strengthens Raytheon's industrial base and global network for air defense.

missiles.t: Developing SHORAD missiles and capabilities
missiles.body: LIG Defense&Aerospace and Rheinmetall are developing SHORAD missiles and capabilities to close existing gaps in air defense. They aim to localize and further develop air defense missile systems in Europe.
missiles.impact: This collaboration strengthens LIG Defense&Aerospace's product portfolio and enables them to offer comprehensive air defense solutions, enhancing their market position in Europe and NATO territories.

missiles.t: India flight-tested a land-attack BRAHMOS missile
missiles.body: India successfully flight-tested a land-attack version of the BRAHMOS supersonic cruise missile from the Integrated Test Range in Balasore. The test included many 'Made in India' subsystems.
missiles.impact: This milestone advances India's goal of increasing local content in defence equipment, enhancing self-reliance and capability.

missiles.t: Arrow Weapon System test launch completed
missiles.body: IMDO and MDA completed a test launch of the Arrow Weapon System to validate enhancements and bolster defenses against threats from Iran and Yemen. The test is part of a multiyear program to develop and upgrade the Arrow ballistic-missile shield.
missiles.impact: The successful test demonstrates ongoing advancements in the Arrow system, enhancing Israel's top-tier air defense capabilities against ballistic missile threats.

missiles.t: Compatibility of Hanwha Chunmoo guided missiles with Thales X-Fire launcher demonstrated
missiles.body: Thales and Hanwha demonstrated the compatibility of Hanwha Chunmoo guided missiles with Thales's X-Fire launcher, enhancing interoperability for deep strike missions. The MoU aims to strengthen collaboration and deliver flexible solutions for European markets.
missiles.impact: This collaboration enhances the operational flexibility and interoperability of missile systems, allowing for more effective deep strike capabilities in modern warfare.

missiles.t: India test-fires BrahMos missile from Su-30 fighter jet
missiles.body: India successfully test-fired the BrahMos missile from a modified Su-30 fighter jet, hitting a land target. The test demonstrated the missile's capability to be launched from aircraft.
missiles.impact: This test highlights India's advancement in air-launched missile technology, enhancing its strategic military capabilities and potentially opening avenues for export.

missiles.t: DRDO developing LRAShM with longer range and lower cost
missiles.body: DRDO is developing the LRAShM missile, which has undergone multiple trials and is expected to complement the BrahMos missile by offering a longer range and lower cost for coastal defence.
missiles.impact: LRAShM's extended range of 1,500 kilometres and cost-effectiveness will enhance India's A2/AD capabilities and complicate adversary naval planning, making it a preferred weapon for future coastal defence batteries.

missiles.t: Saab unveils surface launch RBS15 Gungnir missile
missiles.body: Saab unveils the surface launch version of RBS15 Gungnir at Euronaval, featuring the RBS15 Mk4 Surface missile with enhanced capabilities. The missile is designed for integration on land- and sea-based platforms.
missiles.impact: The RBS15 Gungnir's flexibility and advanced features enhance its strategic value for navies and coastal defense systems, offering improved range and defense penetration.

missiles.t: BrahMos-NG faces design modifications due to stricter customer requirements
missiles.body: The BrahMos-NG missile is undergoing design modifications to meet stricter customer requirements. Flight tests have not yet begun as the missile needs refinement to satisfy these new demands.
missiles.impact: These modifications ensure the final product meets all operational expectations, avoiding extensive redesigns later in the development cycle.

missiles.t: Development of a hypersonic BRAHMOS-II missile with scramjet engine
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing BRAHMOS-II, a hypersonic missile with a scramjet engine, aiming for speeds above Mach 5. Initial groundwork is underway in collaboration with DRDO.
missiles.impact: BRAHMOS-II's advanced technology, including scramjet propulsion, positions it as a future game-changer in missile and aerospace science.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile successfully test-fired from submerged platform
missiles.body: The submarine-launched version of the BRAHMOS supersonic cruise missile was successfully test-fired from a submerged platform in the Bay of Bengal. The missile demonstrated vertical launch capability and precision targeting.
missiles.impact: This test marks a significant milestone as it is the first instance of a supersonic cruise missile being launched vertically from a submerged platform, enhancing the offensive capabilities of India's naval fleet.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS to be test-fired from Su-30MKI
missiles.body: BRAHMOS, a heavy supersonic cruise missile, will undergo test-firing from the Su-30MKI. This test is part of a series including dummy and technology missile tests, and a pure drop test.
missiles.impact: The successful integration of BRAHMOS on Su-30MKI would represent a significant milestone in missile and aeronautics technology, marking the first time such a heavy missile is integrated with this aircraft.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall unveils Skynex air defence system
missiles.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the Skynex air defence system at Eurosatory 2016, featuring an open, modular architecture that allows for the connection of various sensors and effectors, including anti-aircraft missiles and high-energy lasers.
missiles.impact: Skynex's modular design enhances its flexibility and effectiveness in defending against a wide range of airborne threats, making it a significant advancement in air defence technology.

missiles.t: Indonesia buys BrahMos and Astra missiles from India
missiles.body: Indonesia has purchased BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles and Astra beyond-visual-range air-to-air missiles from India, enhancing its maritime denial strategy and air force modernization.
missiles.impact: The acquisition of these advanced missiles significantly boosts Indonesia's defense capabilities, particularly in the Indo-Pacific and Malacca Strait regions, altering the regional power balance.

missiles.t: Block-II version of BRAHMOS launched
missiles.body: The Block-II version of the BRAHMOS supersonic cruise missile was successfully launched by the Indian army. This version includes significantly improved guidance software.
missiles.impact: The launch of the Block-II version enhances the missile's accuracy and effectiveness, solidifying BRAHMOS as a sophisticated and reliable weapon system for both land and sea-based deployments.

missiles.t: air-launched BrahMos missile tested successfully
missiles.body: DRDO successfully tested the air-launched variant of the BrahMos missile, proving its structural integrity and functional performance. The test clears the way for serial production within India.
missiles.impact: This milestone advances India's capability to integrate BrahMos missiles with air platforms, enhancing its multi-domain strike capabilities.

missiles.t: UKZN's Phoenix 1 D hybrid rocket launched
missiles.body: UKZN's Phoenix 1 D hybrid rocket was successfully launched from Denel Overberg Test Range, carrying experimental sensors and cameras. The rocket is part of a programme to develop larger, orbital launch systems.
missiles.impact: This launch demonstrates progress in developing advanced propulsion systems, potentially aiding in the development of more efficient and controllable rocket technologies.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile test-fired with enhanced indigenous content
missiles.body: BRAHMOS supersonic cruise missile was successfully test-fired off the coast of Odisha with increased indigenous content and improved performance. The test involved advanced indigenous technologies and a modified optimal trajectory.
missiles.impact: The enhanced indigenous content and improved performance of the BRAHMOS missile signify a step towards greater self-reliance and technological advancement in India's missile capabilities.

missiles.t: Saab unveiled RBS15 Mk4 Gungnir with >300 km range
missiles.body: Saab Dynamics unveiled the RBS15 Mk4 Gungnir, an advanced anti-ship missile with over 300 km range. It features an improved target seeker and is offered in air-launched and surface-launched configurations.
missiles.impact: The RBS15 Mk4 Gungnir enhances naval warfare capabilities by providing robust, autonomous, and all-weather engagement against various targets.

missiles.t: JDAM-LR completed first test flights
missiles.body: The JDAM-LR system completed its first test flights off the coast of California. This marks a significant step in the development of the system.
missiles.impact: The successful test flights indicate progress towards a new long-range precision strike capability for the Air Force, enhancing standoff strike options.

missiles.t: Raytheon introduced StormBreaker smart weapon to F/A-18E/F
missiles.body: Raytheon introduced the StormBreaker smart weapon to the US Navy's F/A-18E/F Super Hornet. The weapon's integration process was streamlined, reducing required flight tests.
missiles.impact: StormBreaker's accuracy and adaptability allow fewer aircraft to address the same number of targets, enhancing operational efficiency and reducing aircrew risk.

missiles.t: 90º vertical firing of JAGM from JAGM Quad Launcher
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated 90º vertical firing of JAGM from a JAGM Quad Launcher using its millimeter-wave doppler radar. The launcher was mounted on a ground vehicle for the demonstration.
missiles.impact: This capability allows for the elimination of a clear forward firing arc, enabling platforms previously unable to launch missiles to do so, enhancing flexibility and defensive capabilities.

missiles.t: Chinese scientists develop AI neural networks for HGV intercept avoidance
missiles.body: Chinese scientists at NUAA are developing AI neural networks to enhance the maneuverability of HGVs, enabling them to evade defensive interceptors. The research aims to improve the HGV's ability to recognize and adapt to interceptor flight paths.
missiles.impact: This development significantly enhances the threat posed by Chinese HGVs, as it could render current defensive systems ineffective against these advanced missiles.

missiles.t: BrahMos develops hypersonic BRAHMOS variant
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing a hypersonic variant of the BRAHMOS missile. The company also showcased advanced variants including the BRAHMOS Next-Generation (NG).
missiles.impact: The development of hypersonic BRAHMOS variants represents a significant technological leap, enhancing India's strategic deterrence capabilities.

missiles.t: Successful test launches of GLSDB ground-launched missile
missiles.body: Boeing and Saab completed three successful test launches of the GLSDB system, proving its capability to launch a SDB weapon from the ground and sync with GPS.
missiles.impact: The GLSDB program leverages existing technologies, reducing development risk and potentially offering a cost-effective precision strike capability for international customers.

missiles.t: Thailand evaluating BrahMos supersonic anti-ship cruise missile
missiles.body: Thailand is evaluating BrahMos, a supersonic anti-ship cruise missile. The evaluation could enhance Thailand's coastal defence and maritime security.
missiles.impact: If Thailand procures BrahMos, it could strengthen its naval deterrence and strategic autonomy, potentially forming part of an informal 'BrahMos belt' in Southeast Asia.

missiles.t: Hanwha Systems developed Multi-Function Radar (MFR) and long-range missile interception systems
missiles.body: Hanwha Systems developed a Multi-Function Radar (MFR) and long-range missile interception systems, designed to detect and counter missile threats at various altitudes.
missiles.impact: This system enhances defense capabilities by providing early detection and interception of missile threats, crucial for modern air defense.

missiles.t: US Navy reveals AIM-424 LRAAM with range of at least 460 km
missiles.body: The US Navy revealed the AIM-424 LRAAM at the Tailhook symposium, a missile with a range of at least 460 km. It is powered by a solid-fuel rocket engine and is a two-stage missile.
missiles.impact: The AIM-424 LRAAM significantly enhances naval air superiority with its extended range and lethality, addressing the need for improved Beyond Visual Range (BVR) missile capabilities.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall demonstrated CML containerized missile launcher
missiles.body: Rheinmetall showcased the CML, a containerized missile launcher at Eurosatory, capable of carrying up to 18 FV-014 loitering munitions. The CML is designed for flexible deployment and seamless networking with existing systems.
missiles.impact: The CML enhances operational flexibility and firepower by integrating loitering munitions into a modular, networked system, advancing the digital battlefield.

missiles.t: Developing hypersonic versions of missiles
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing hypersonic versions of its missiles, following the successful induction of supersonic versions.
missiles.impact: This development aims to significantly enhance the speed and capabilities of BrahMos missiles, surpassing current supersonic speeds.

missiles.t: Umkhonto-IR missile developed in versions Block 1, 2 and 3
missiles.body: Denel Dynamics developed the Umkhonto-IR missile in versions Block 1, 2, and 3 with ranges of 12km, 15km, and 20km respectively. The missile has been deployed on 12 naval vessels and is being integrated into various naval combat systems.
missiles.impact: The development and deployment of the Umkhonto-IR missile variants enhance naval air defence capabilities, providing a flexible and adaptable solution for engaging a wide range of airborne threats.

missiles.t: LRPF missile replaces MGM-140 ATACMS
missiles.body: Raytheon is developing the LRPF missile to replace the 1980s-era MGM-140 ATACMS. The LRPF will double the number of missiles that can be carried by M270 MLRS and M142 HIMARS.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the responsiveness and lethality of existing launch systems, enabling them to engage naval targets more effectively.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile export talks advanced with multiple countries
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is in advanced export talks with UAE, Vietnam, South Africa, and Chile for the BRAHMOS missile. Ground tests for launching the missile from Su-30 Flanker C aircraft are complete.
missiles.impact: The potential export of BRAHMOS to multiple countries could enhance India's strategic partnerships and military exports, despite Chinese reservations.

missiles.t: KSAM-II missile assembly commenced
missiles.body: LIG Defense & Aerospace commenced assembly of the KSAM-II missile after unveiling a new production line. This marks a significant step in the development of the KSAM-II.
missiles.impact: The commencement of KSAM-II assembly indicates progress towards enhancing South Korea's missile defense capabilities, aligning with broader defense modernization efforts.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates FV-014 loitering munition system
missiles.body: Rheinmetall showcased the FV-014 loitering munition system at ILA Berlin 2026, featuring a 70-minute flight time and 100 km range. It is designed for reconnaissance and can operate safely from a distance.
missiles.impact: The FV-014 enhances the capability to observe and engage targets over extended periods, bridging the gap between reconnaissance and artillery.

missiles.t: Beam Control Fire Control system completed initial flight testing
missiles.body: The Beam Control Fire Control system for the Airborne Laser program completed initial flight testing, meeting all major requirements. Low-power passive capabilities were demonstrated at Edwards Air Force Base.
missiles.impact: This milestone advances the capability of directed energy weapons for missile defense, showcasing advanced optical system design.

missiles.t: Philippines unveiled BrahMos-ER shore-based missile battery
missiles.body: The Philippine Marine Corps unveiled its first BrahMos-ER shore-based missile battery, featuring four truck-mounted launchers with eight missiles. This export variant of BrahMos Block I was paraded in Zambales province, overlooking the contested Scarborough Shoal.
missiles.impact: The deployment of BrahMos-ER enhances the Philippines' maritime deterrence capabilities, providing a significant boost to its defense against potential threats in the South China Sea.

missiles.t: Block III BRAHMOS missile test-fired successfully
missiles.body: Block III of the BRAHMOS supersonic cruise missile was test-fired from Balasore. The Indian Defence Minister congratulated the team for the successful launch.
missiles.impact: The successful test firing of Block III indicates advancements in guidance technology, enhancing the missile's operational capabilities.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall and Destinus to start Rheinmetall Destinus Strike Systems in 2026
missiles.body: Rheinmetall and Destinus are forming Rheinmetall Destinus Strike Systems to develop and produce next-generation missiles and rockets in Europe, starting operations in 2026. The partnership aims to address Europe's need for expanded defense production capacity.
missiles.impact: This initiative will enhance Europe's strategic missile production capabilities, supporting NATO and European countries' defense needs.

missiles.t: MMP missile system integrated on Jaguar vehicle for first static target firing
missiles.body: MBDA demonstrated the first static target firing of the MMP missile system integrated on the Jaguar vehicle. The system will eventually provide the capability to destroy hardened, fixed, or mobile ground targets, including the latest generation tanks.
missiles.impact: This integration enhances the Jaguar vehicle's combat effectiveness by adding long-range precision strike capabilities against various ground targets.

missiles.t: Saab awarded contract for torpedo life-extension
missiles.body: Saab received a contract to develop subsystem prototypes for the Swedish Navy's Torpedo 62 system, enhancing its capabilities. The work will take place in Linköping and Motala, Sweden.
missiles.impact: This development aims to evolve one of the Swedish Navy’s key weapon systems, improving its operational effectiveness and longevity.

missiles.t: demonstrated mobile autonomous launcher and storage vehicle
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace demonstrated a mobile autonomous launcher and storage vehicle. The event showcased modern facilities for missile integration, testing, and quality control.
missiles.impact: The demonstration highlights BrahMos Aerospace's capability to integrate advanced autonomous systems, enhancing operational flexibility and efficiency in missile deployment.

missiles.t: MBDA unveiled CMI lower-cost SAM
missiles.body: MBDA unveiled its Counter Mass Interceptor (CMI) lower-cost surface-to-air missile (SAM) at Farnborough 2026. The CMI is part of a further developed Raven short-range air defence vehicle.
missiles.impact: The unveiling of the CMI SAM represents a significant step towards providing a cost-effective solution for short-range air defence systems.

missiles.t: DARPA and Lockheed Martin developing OpFires hypersonic missile
missiles.body: DARPA and Lockheed Martin are developing the OpFires hypersonic missile system for the U.S. Army. OpFires uses throttleable rocket motors to adjust range and trajectory.
missiles.impact: The ability to throttle rocket motors allows OpFires to hit targets within a range envelope without overshooting, providing tactical flexibility and precision.

missiles.t: Vorexon point defence counter-rocket artillery and anti-missile concept unveiled
missiles.body: Destinus unveiled the Vorexon system at Farnborough 2026, designed to defend against artillery rockets and selected missiles. It is set for full-scale testing in 2027 and production in 2028.
missiles.impact: Vorexon addresses a gap in European integrated air defence by providing rapid identification and interception of incoming threats.

missiles.t: Rafael demonstrates ICE BREAKER, a fifth-gen cruise missile
missiles.body: Rafael is showcasing ICE BREAKER, a fifth-generation cruise missile at Farnborough Airshow 2026. The missile features advanced AI and low radar cross-section for precision strikes.
missiles.impact: ICE BREAKER's multi-domain compatibility and advanced capabilities position it as a versatile and technologically superior weapon system in the global market.

missiles.t: MBDA developing STRATUS long-range missile system
missiles.body: MBDA is developing the STRATUS long-range missile system for the Royal Navy. First full-scale tests are scheduled for 2028.
missiles.impact: STRATUS will provide the Royal Navy with advanced anti-ship and land-attack capabilities for its frigates and hybrid fleet.

missiles.t: Raytheon demonstrated NGSRI missile system
missiles.body: Raytheon successfully demonstrated its Next Generation Short Range Interceptor (NGSRI) system, showing its capability to detect, track, and intercept aerial threats. The system outperformed the existing Stinger missile in terms of range and lethality.
missiles.impact: The NGSRI's superior performance and full interoperability with existing platforms will likely enhance the U.S. Army's air defense capabilities, providing a significant upgrade over current systems.

missiles.t: OTH-WS anti-surface warfare missile demonstrated
missiles.body: Raytheon demonstrated the OTH-WS, a long-range anti-surface warfare missile for USN. It is a stand-alone system with minimal integration requirements.
missiles.impact: The OTH-WS enhances USN's over-the-horizon capabilities, aligning with national strategy for maritime deterrence.

missiles.t: LOCAAS deployed wings and started engine in flight test
missiles.body: LOCAAS, a low-cost autonomous attack system, successfully completed a flight test where it deployed wings and started its engine. The test was conducted at Eglin Air Force Base.
missiles.impact: This milestone advances the development of an affordable precision strike capability, enhancing operational flexibility and effectiveness.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile integrated into Sukhoi jets
missiles.body: The government fast-tracked the integration of BRAHMOS missiles into Sukhoi jets to bolster IAF's combat capability. The air-launched variant was successfully test-fired in 2017.
missiles.impact: This integration enhances the IAF's ability to strike from large stand-off ranges, improving strategic deterrence and operational flexibility.

missiles.t: BrahMos NG missile development underway
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing BrahMos NG, a next-gen missile for air, sea, and land use. It is designed for Su-30MKI and Tejas aircraft and is currently in the design phase.
missiles.impact: BrahMos NG's improved characteristics and stealth capabilities are expected to revolutionize future battlefields, offering wide application and high Indian component content.

missiles.t: First flight test of NGSRI missile
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin conducted the first flight test of the NGSRI missile, moving it from concept to flight testing in 26 months. The test data will inform the missile's performance in complex threat environments.
missiles.impact: The successful test marks a significant milestone in developing a replacement for the Stinger, enhancing allied forces' air defense capabilities with advanced sensor technology.

missiles.t: U.S. Army successfully flight tested ER GMLRS
missiles.body: The U.S. Army conducted a successful flight test of ER GMLRS, demonstrating its readiness and capability. ER GMLRS extends the range of GMLRS to 150 km while maintaining accuracy and flexibility.
missiles.impact: This test confirms ER GMLRS's readiness for operational use, enhancing the U.S. Army's long-range precision strike capabilities and supporting multi-domain operations.

missiles.t: Saab developed Nimbrix, a low-cost C-UAS missile
missiles.body: Saab announced the development of Nimbrix, a low-cost missile designed to counter unmanned aerial systems. It is expected to be unveiled at DSEI 2025 and will be ready for delivery by next year.
missiles.impact: Nimbrix addresses the growing threat of unmanned aerial vehicles with a cost-effective solution, filling the gap between guns and very short-range air defence systems.

missiles.t: LRASM achieved Early Operational Capability for B1-B bomber
missiles.body: BAE Systems and Lockheed Martin achieved Early Operational Capability for the LRASM missile on the B1-B bomber. The Air Force accepted delivery of production LRASM units following successful tests.
