missiles.impact: This milestone enhances the U.S. Air Force's capability to engage high-value maritime targets from safe distances, leveraging advanced sensor technology.

missiles.t: Dhanush missile successfully destroyed a target
missiles.body: The Indian Army conducted an operational test of the Dhanush missile, which successfully destroyed a target. The initial statement mistakenly referred to the test as a BrahMos Block III test.
missiles.impact: The successful test of the Dhanush missile highlights the Indian Army's capability in tactical ballistic missile systems, enhancing its strategic deterrence.

missiles.t: AI-enabled battle management prototype demonstrated
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated an AI-enabled battle management prototype for Guam's missile defence system, integrating Aegis Guam and IBCS. The system was developed and integrated within 24 hours, meeting demonstration criteria.
missiles.impact: This rapid integration and demonstration of AI in missile defence highlights the evolving importance of speed and decision-making in modern defence strategies.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin delivers PAC-3 MSE missiles to Sweden
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin delivered PAC-3 MSE missiles to Sweden as part of a 2018 agreement. The PAC-3 MSE builds on the PAC-3 Cost Reduction Initiative with enhanced range and manoeuvrability.
missiles.impact: The delivery of PAC-3 MSE to Sweden enhances its missile defence capabilities against a range of threats, including tactical ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and aircraft.

missiles.t: BrahMos Integration and Testing Facility inaugurated
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace inaugurated a 200-acre integration and testing facility in Lucknow. The facility will integrate booster subassemblies, avionics, propellant, and ramjet engines.
missiles.impact: The facility will enhance BrahMos missile production capabilities and support skill development for the defense industry.

missiles.t: Hanwha develops HPRS with CTM-MR ASBM
missiles.body: Hanwha is developing the HPRS system, which mounts a single pod containing four CTM-MR ballistic missiles. The CTM-MR has a range of 50-160 km and is expected to be completed by 2027.
missiles.impact: The HPRS provides an ASBM capability with enhanced transportability and compatibility with naval platforms, offering a cost-effective alternative to cruise missiles for coastal defense.

missiles.t: Golden Dome to deploy interceptor missiles by end of next year
missiles.body: Golden Dome is a layered defense shield to intercept incoming projectiles. Lockheed Martin aims to deliver the first Golden Dome defenses by the end of next year.
missiles.impact: This development aims to enhance homeland security by intercepting threats mid-flight, demonstrating advanced missile defense capabilities.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile validated deep penetration capability
missiles.body: The Indian Army successfully tested the BRAHMOS missile, validating its deep penetration capability against hardened targets. The missile, developed by India and Russia, has been inducted into the Army and Navy, with the air version scheduled for testing.
missiles.impact: This test confirms the BRAHMOS missile's effectiveness in challenging terrains, enhancing India's strategic deterrence capabilities.

missiles.t: FP-7.X interceptor system to intercept ballistic missiles
missiles.body: Fire Point is developing the FP-7.X interceptor system, a joint German-Ukrainian project, to intercept ballistic missiles at 15 miles altitude.
missiles.impact: The FP-7.X system aims to provide a cost-effective solution, costing $700,000 per shot, compared to $3.8 million for a Patriot PAC-3 missile.

missiles.t: Skyranger 30 turret with DefendAir missile showcased
missiles.body: Rheinmetall showcased the Skyranger 30 turret with MBDA’s DefendAir guided missile at ILA 2026. The Skyranger combines high-precision gun and missile defense to protect mobile units.
missiles.impact: The Skyranger 30 addresses the urgent need for mobile and resilient close-range air defense, particularly against drones and loitering munitions, closing a critical capability gap for Western armed forces.

missiles.t: Kalashnikov Concern will demonstrate KUB-2-E and KUB-SM loitering munitions
missiles.body: Kalashnikov Concern will showcase KUB-2-E and KUB-SM loitering munitions at IDEX. The KUB-2-E is equipped with advanced electro-optical systems for precise guidance.
missiles.impact: The advanced guidance systems enhance the precision and effectiveness of the loitering munitions, providing a significant tactical advantage.

missiles.t: Raytheon developing Peregrine air-to-air missile
missiles.body: Raytheon is developing the Peregrine, a medium-range air-to-air missile that is smaller but offers greater speed and longer range than current missiles. It is designed to be more affordable and faster to develop, with features like a multi-mode seeker and high-performance propulsion.
missiles.impact: Peregrine could significantly enhance fighter jets' combat effectiveness by doubling or tripling their munitions loads, providing greater flexibility and lethality in aerial engagements.

missiles.t: PrSM missile flew accurately to target
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's PrSM missile successfully flew accurately to the target area during tests. The tests confirmed the missile's trajectory, range, accuracy, and lethality.
missiles.impact: The successful test enhances the missile's capability to attack, neutralize, suppress, and destroy battlefield targets, improving the US Army's precision strike capabilities.

missiles.t: K-MLRS M239 Cheonmoo completed development in 2013
missiles.body: The K-MLRS M239 Cheonmoo completed development in 2013 and is in service with the ROK Army. It uses an 8x8 tactical truck chassis with an armoured crew cab and fires 130mm and 230mm projectiles.
missiles.impact: The Cheonmoo's capability to fire various projectiles with ranges up to 80 km and its rapid deployment and fire capabilities make it a significant asset for artillery support.

missiles.t: Foxhound 4x4 hosts RIwP turret with HVM/LMM missiles
missiles.body: Moog Inc. and General Dynamics Land Systems UK are demonstrating a Foxhound 4x4 vehicle with Moog’s Reconfigurable Integrated-weapons Platform (RIwP) turret featuring HVM/LMM missiles. This SHORAD variant will be showcased at DSEI 2025.
missiles.impact: The integration of RIwP with Foxhound provides British Armed Forces with advanced SHORAD and counter-UAS capabilities, leveraging the modularity and flexibility of both systems.

missiles.t: Block V Tomahawk missiles with NAV/COMMs upgrade
missiles.body: Raytheon has delivered the first batch of Block V Tomahawk missiles to the US Navy, featuring a NAV/COMMs upgrade for improved navigation and target updates. Future variants include the Maritime Strike Tomahawk and Joint Multiple Effects Warhead System.
missiles.impact: The NAV/COMMs upgrade enhances the missile's operational flexibility and precision, providing the US Navy with advanced targeting capabilities.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS-A completed first captive carriage test
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace completed the first captive carriage test of the BRAHMOS-A supersonic cruise missile aboard a modified Su-30MKI fighter. The missile is undergoing further flight tests.
missiles.impact: This test advances the air-launched capability of BRAHMOS, meeting IAF requirements and potentially expanding export opportunities to countries with Su-30MKI fighters.

missiles.t: IAI to supply LRSAM systems for Indian Navy ships
missiles.body: IAI has secured a $93 million contract to supply long-range surface-to-air missile defense systems (LRSAM) for seven Indian Navy ships. The LRSAM systems are part of the Barak-8 family, developed in collaboration with DRDO.
missiles.impact: This contract strengthens India's naval defense capabilities by integrating advanced missile systems, enhancing its air and missile defense.

missiles.t: SuperSonic Strike Missile (3SM) Tyrfing in initial design phase
missiles.body: Norway’s Ministry of Defence, in collaboration with Germany and Kongsberg, is developing the SuperSonic Strike Missile (3SM) Tyrfing. The project is in its initial design phase and aims to complement the existing NSM missile.
missiles.impact: The 3SM Tyrfing project positions Norway as a leader in missile production and represents a significant step in international defence cooperation, addressing evolving global threats.

missiles.t: collaboration to serve as European center of excellence for manufacturing and distribution of rockets and missiles
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin and Rheinmetall extended their MoU to serve as a European center of excellence for manufacturing and distributing rockets and missiles, based in Germany. They are working together to meet the growing demand in the military market.
missiles.impact: This collaboration aims to enhance transatlantic security by delivering advanced missile and rocket systems to European allies, leveraging the strengths of both companies.

missiles.t: Raytheon begins low-rate initial production of SM-6 missiles
missiles.body: Raytheon has commenced low-rate initial production of the SM-6 missile under a US Navy contract. The first set of missiles is expected to be delivered in early 2011.
missiles.impact: This marks a significant step towards delivering the SM-6 missile to the US Navy, enhancing its over-the-horizon air defence capabilities.

missiles.t: NGI program supported by new Missile Assembly Building
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin opened MAB-5 in June 2026 to support NGI developments. NGI is designed to defend against advanced long-range missile threats.
missiles.impact: MAB-5's digital-first approach enhances NGI's reliability and accuracy, strengthening missile defense and positioning North Alabama as a critical technology hub.

missiles.t: L-SAM II missile system integration and validation
missiles.body: Hanwha Aerospace was awarded a contract to support the development of the L-SAM II missile system, including system integration and validation. The contract is worth US$146 million and is expected to be completed by 2028.
missiles.impact: This development enhances South Korea's missile defense capabilities by enabling interception of missiles at higher altitudes and longer ranges compared to the original L-SAM system.

missiles.t: Zone 5 delivers Rusty Dagger modular ship-launched cruise missile
missiles.body: Zone 5 Technologies has been contracted by the US Navy to produce and deliver the Rusty Dagger modular ship-launched cruise missile. The Rusty Dagger has demonstrated outstanding performance in the Ukrainian conflict with extreme precision and high survival rates.
missiles.impact: The Rusty Dagger's proven effectiveness in contested environments enhances the US Navy's and allied forces' ability to counter area denial systems.

missiles.t: Luftwaffe conducting extensive testing on Taurus missiles
missiles.body: Luftwaffe is conducting extensive testing on Taurus missiles at Denel OTR in South Africa, including live firing and quality assurance. The tests involve close air support and low flying manoeuvres.
missiles.impact: The extensive testing ensures the Taurus missile's operational readiness and effectiveness, crucial for future missions and interoperability with allied forces.

missiles.t: THAAD Block '04 missile completed developmental flight test
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin conducted a developmental flight test of THAAD Block '04 missile at White Sands Missile Range. The test evaluated missile control and separation without a target.
missiles.impact: The successful test advances THAAD's developmental phase, ensuring the missile meets critical performance criteria before full integration.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin fields HELLFIRE II missile
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin fields the HELLFIRE II missile, a combat-proven tactical missile system. It can be launched from multiple air, sea, and ground platforms.
missiles.impact: The HELLFIRE II missile's multi-mission, multi-target capability and precision-strike lethality significantly enhances the United States' air-to-ground precision weapon arsenal.

missiles.t: Raytheon unveiled GhostEye radar progress
missiles.body: Raytheon Missiles & Defense demonstrated progress in its GhostEye radar family, highlighting advancements in threat detection. The GhostEye radar is designed to counter escalating threats.
missiles.impact: The GhostEye radar's progress underscores Raytheon's capability to address a wide range of threats, enhancing air and missile defense systems.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall developed retractable ATGM launcher for Boxer Block II
missiles.body: Rheinmetall developed a retractable ATGM launcher for Australia's Boxer Block II vehicle, designed to carry two Spike LR II missiles. The launcher was first seen fitted to a Boxer Block II vehicle in footage published by the German embassy in Australia.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the Boxer Block II's combat capabilities by providing a flexible and retractable ATGM system, improving its survivability and operational flexibility.

missiles.t: DRDO tested liquid ramjet fuel for BrahMos
missiles.body: DRDO successfully tested a domestically developed liquid ramjet fuel for BrahMos, a joint venture with Russia. This fuel is intended for the 350 mm diameter liquid fuel ramjet engine under development.
missiles.impact: The successful testing of the liquid ramjet fuel marks a significant step towards India's self-reliance in missile technology, enhancing the capabilities of the BrahMos and BrahMos-NG missiles.

missiles.t: Leonardo building first component of Michelangelo missile defence dome for Ukraine
missiles.body: Leonardo is constructing the first component of the Michelangelo missile defence system for Ukraine. The system aims to integrate advanced capabilities against various aerial threats including drones, ballistic missiles, and hypersonic weapons.
missiles.impact: The development of Michelangelo signifies a significant step in enhancing Ukraine's missile defence capabilities, offering comprehensive protection against a wide range of aerial threats.

missiles.t: A-Darter passed in-flight guided tests
missiles.body: Denel Dynamics' A-Darter missile recently passed critical in-flight guided tests. It is being integrated into the Gripen fighter planes used by the SA Air Force.
missiles.impact: The successful tests and integration of A-Darter enhance South Africa's air-to-air missile capabilities, aligning with global standards.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin delivered the Mid-Range Capability weapon system to the U.S. Army
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin delivered the Mid-Range Capability (MRC) weapon system to the U.S. Army, which progressed from concept to fielded in just over two years. The system leverages existing and evolving technologies to meet the Army's long-range fires needs.
missiles.impact: The rapid development and delivery of the MRC demonstrate Lockheed Martin's capability to integrate and scale technologies efficiently, enhancing the U.S. Army's multi-domain operational agility.

missiles.t: Raytheon UK unveiled Red Kite glide bomb
missiles.body: Raytheon UK unveiled the Red Kite glide bomb, a domestically developed weapon with 95% UK content, including seeker, warhead, and mission system. It uses the same airframe as the U.S.-made StormBreaker but is simpler and less expensive.
missiles.impact: Red Kite addresses a potential gap in the Royal Air Force's arsenal and aligns with the UK government's Defense Investment Plan for a high-low mix of weapons.

missiles.t: DRDO test-fired BrahMos supersonic missile
missiles.body: DRDO conducted an experimental trial of the BrahMos supersonic missile, which did not achieve 100% success. BrahMos is a 290km range stealth missile developed by BrahMos Aerospace.
missiles.impact: The test highlights ongoing efforts to validate and improve the operational readiness of BrahMos, crucial for India's coastal and border defense.

missiles.t: Establishing South Asia's largest private-sector missile ecosystem
missiles.body: Adani Defence & Aerospace is establishing a ₹2,500 crore missile ecosystem in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, which will integrate missile system production and materials manufacturing. The project aims to accelerate the transition of DRDO-developed missile systems to serial production.
missiles.impact: This initiative will significantly bolster India's indigenous missile capabilities, supporting the operational needs of the Indian Armed Forces and contributing to the country's self-reliance in defence.

missiles.t: Yugoimport unveiled RALAS, a new antitank missile
missiles.body: Yugoimport unveiled RALAS, a new antitank missile at IDEX 2019. RALAS differs from its predecessor ALAS by using all-rocket propulsion instead of turbojet-rocket.
missiles.impact: The development of RALAS represents a significant advancement in antitank missile technology, offering improved performance and reliability over its predecessor ALAS.

missiles.t: China conducted first SLBM test from nuclear sub
missiles.body: China's navy conducted its first acknowledged SLBM test on July 6, 2026, demonstrating long-range nuclear deterrence capabilities. The test involved a dummy warhead and was aimed at verifying operational procedures.
missiles.impact: This test signifies China's advancement in strategic nuclear deterrence, showcasing its ability to execute SLBM launches from a submerged nuclear-powered submarine.

missiles.t: new BrahMos missile testing and integration facility opened
missiles.body: India's MoD has inaugurated a new BrahMos missile facility in Lucknow, designed to integrate missile components and support ancillary development. The facility, worth USD35 million, is still under construction and will include design and administrative blocks.
missiles.impact: This facility will enhance BrahMos missile production and integration capabilities, supporting India's strategic missile requirements across land, sea, and air platforms.

missiles.t: APKWS guidance kits demonstrated against drones
missiles.body: BAE Systems demonstrated the effectiveness of APKWS guidance kits against military drones. The kits enable 70mm rockets to destroy Class-2 aerial drones.
missiles.impact: This capability provides an efficient and cost-effective solution for countering militarized drones, reducing the need for expensive missiles.

missiles.t: teaming to develop hypersonic tactical missiles
missiles.body: Raytheon and Northrop Grumman signed a teaming agreement to develop hypersonic tactical missiles using scramjet combustors, aiming to accelerate development.
missiles.impact: This partnership leverages both companies' expertise to produce advanced hypersonic missiles, enhancing weapon survivability, effectiveness, and flexibility.

missiles.t: India and Russia to co-develop BrahMos-II hypersonic missile
missiles.body: India and Russia plan to resume discussions for the co-development of BrahMos-II, a hypersonic cruise missile aiming for Mach 6-8 speeds and a 1,500 km range. The missile draws inspiration from Russia’s 3M22 Zircon.
missiles.impact: BrahMos-II will enhance India’s strategic capabilities by providing a high-speed, long-range missile option, potentially setting a new standard in hypersonic weaponry.

missiles.t: Unmanned MLRS concept unveiled
missiles.body: Hanwha Aerospace unveiled an unmanned MLRS concept at KADEX, weighing 17 tons and deployable on amphibious ships. It promises accuracy in rough seas and will include an ASBM payload by 2027.
missiles.impact: This unmanned MLRS concept enhances South Korea's operational flexibility and offers a cost-effective ASBM solution, strengthening its naval defense capabilities.

missiles.t: Feasibility study completed for BrahMos aircraft version
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace completed a feasibility study for integrating the BrahMos missile with Sukhoi-30 aircraft. The IAF plans to integrate the missile by 2007.
missiles.impact: This development enhances India's air-launched missile capabilities, providing a supersonic strike option for the Sukhoi-30 fleet.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall and Destinus form JV to develop cruise missiles and ballistic rocket artillery
missiles.body: Rheinmetall and Destinus plan to form a joint venture to develop cruise missiles and ballistic rocket artillery, aiming for large-scale serial production.
missiles.impact: This joint venture leverages Rheinmetall's production experience and Destinus's technology, tailored to meet current European and allied armed forces requirements.

missiles.t: IAI unveiled Wind Demon air-to-surface cruise missile
missiles.body: IAI unveiled the Wind Demon, an air-to-surface cruise missile with a range over 124 miles. It features an electro-optical seeker with thermal imaging and laser-designation compatibility.
missiles.impact: The Wind Demon addresses the need for cost-effective, long-range precision strike capabilities, enhancing survivability and accuracy.

missiles.t: ASTRA MK-I BVR AAM successfully trialed
missiles.body: ASTRA MK-I Beyond Visual Range Air-to-Air Missile has undergone successful trials and is being integrated with Su 30 MK-I and other fighter aircraft. DRDO has completed technology transfer to Bharat Dynamics Limited for production.
missiles.impact: The successful trials and integration of ASTRA MK-I reduce India's reliance on foreign missile systems, enhancing its air defense capabilities.

missiles.t: BrahMos missile tested with indigenous seeker
missiles.body: India flight tested the BrahMos cruise missile with an Indian-made seeker. The BrahMos is a supersonic medium-range missile manufactured by BrahMos Aerospace.
missiles.impact: The successful test demonstrates India's capability to integrate indigenous technology into advanced missile systems, enhancing its self-reliance in defence.

missiles.t: BrahMos Block-2 missile demonstrated with speed over Mach 5
missiles.body: The BrahMos Block-2 missile was demonstrated with a speed exceeding Mach 5, making it difficult to intercept. Army officials approved its service following successful ground trials.
missiles.impact: The high-speed capability of the BrahMos Block-2 enhances its effectiveness in engaging targets and solidifies its role in India's missile arsenal.

missiles.t: Raytheon develops Glide Phase Interceptor (GPI) to counter hypersonic missiles
missiles.body: Raytheon is developing the Glide Phase Interceptor (GPI) to intercept hypersonic missiles during the glide phase. GPI will be integrated into the U.S. Navy’s Aegis Weapon System.
missiles.impact: The GPI represents a significant advancement in missile defense technology, specifically targeting hypersonic threats which are challenging to intercept due to their speed and maneuverability.

missiles.t: MARSS Interceptor MR displayed for C-UAV use
missiles.body: MARSS, now an independent subsidiary of EOS, displayed its Interceptor MR at Eurosatory 2026 for countering unmanned aerial vehicles. The system is part of a larger effort to develop AI and command and control capabilities.
missiles.impact: The display of Interceptor MR and the focus on AI and C2 development signifies EOS's strategic move to enhance its air defence capabilities against UAV threats.

missiles.t: BrahMos missile test-fired with improved performance
missiles.body: DRDO successfully test-fired an enhanced version of the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile from Chandipur. The missile demonstrated improved performance and indigenous content.
missiles.impact: This test marks a significant milestone for the BrahMos program, showcasing advancements in indigenous technology and enhanced missile efficiency.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall presented AMMR radar for C-UAS, SHORAD, VSHORAD
missiles.body: Rheinmetall presented the AMMR radar, developed in Rome, for countering unmanned aerial systems and short/very short range air defence. It is designed for harsh environmental conditions and features advanced ECCM.
missiles.impact: The AMMR radar addresses modern and complex threats with superior performance and ease of integration into various platforms, enhancing air defence capabilities.

missiles.t: Developing smaller versions of BRAHMOS-NG and hypersonic BRAHMOS-2
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing smaller versions of the BRAHMOS-NG and plans to develop the hypersonic BRAHMOS-2 over the next 5-10 years. This includes testing an aviation-compatible version of the BRAHMOS-A.
missiles.impact: The development of smaller and hypersonic versions of BRAHMOS missiles will enhance India's military capabilities by providing more flexible and faster strike options.

missiles.t: Beam Control/Fire Control system successfully aimed laser
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's Beam Control/Fire Control system successfully aimed a laser to destroy a ballistic missile target in a test. This marks a significant milestone in directed energy technology.
missiles.impact: The successful demonstration validates the effectiveness of the system, making it the most advanced directed energy system globally and opening avenues for future applications in missile defense.

missiles.t: Raytheon mounted Stinger missiles on Stryker
missiles.body: Raytheon mounted its Stinger missiles on a Stryker vehicle, demonstrating a short-range air defense system. The system successfully hit a target during a test at White Sands Missile Range.
missiles.impact: This demonstration addresses the Army's identified need for mobile short-range air defense capabilities to counter evolving air threats.

missiles.t: LRASM demonstrated high lethality in mission planning to target impact
missiles.body: LRASM was tested by the U.S. Navy with four missiles in flight, achieving all mission objectives. The cost of a rocket is currently around $3.24-3.25 million, expected to decrease to $3.22 million.
missiles.impact: The successful demonstration of LRASM's lethality and mission integration capabilities reinforces its effectiveness in naval warfare, likely increasing production.

missiles.t: Gaurav glide bomb accurately hit target over 100 km
missiles.body: DRDO and Adani Defence completed trials of the 1000 Kg Gaurav glide bomb, which accurately hit a target over 100 km. The bomb offers enhanced precision and range.
missiles.impact: The successful trials mark a significant step in India’s military modernization, enhancing its defense capabilities with an indigenous precision weapon.

missiles.t: Raytheon tested a new propulsion system for TOW missile
missiles.body: Raytheon tested a new propulsion system for the TOW missile, doubling its range and reducing flight time. The system incorporates IM features for added safety.
missiles.impact: The new propulsion system enhances TOW's operational range and survivability, allowing engagement of targets beyond direct threat ranges.

missiles.t: Hanwha Aerospace developing LRAAM to replace Meteor
missiles.body: Hanwha Aerospace is developing a long-range air-to-air missile (LRAAM) to replace the Meteor. A concept model was displayed at ADEX in 2025.
missiles.impact: The LRAAM aims to match the performance of the Meteor, enhancing South Korea's air defense capabilities.

missiles.t: Developed advanced man-portable air defence system (AMADS) battle management software
missiles.body: Rheinmetall Canada developed the Battle Management Software (BMS) for AMADS, which integrates real-time data and control orders for MANPAD teams. The BMS optimizes placements and weapon assignments, and supports silent operation.
missiles.impact: The BMS enhances situational awareness and operational efficiency for MANPAD teams, providing a critical component for integrated air defence solutions.

missiles.t: India plans to develop a smaller missile with same characteristics
missiles.body: India plans to develop a smaller missile under the Vision 2050 Programme, which will have the same characteristics as larger missiles. BrahMos Aerospace is leading this initiative.
missiles.impact: This development aims to enhance India's missile capabilities by miniaturizing existing technology while maintaining performance, potentially improving tactical flexibility and operational effectiveness.

missiles.t: RIG-360 demonstrated as uplink for in-flight PAC-3 missile
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's RIG-360 was successfully tested in a live engagement, serving as an uplink to an in-flight PAC-3 missile to intercept a target. The test was conducted at White Sands Missile Range, leveraging Northrop Grumman’s IBCS system.
missiles.impact: The demonstration of RIG-360 enhances the PAC-3 missile's engagement capabilities by providing a 360° communication link, reducing dependency on the Patriot radar and improving flexibility in the battlespace.

missiles.t: SAAB Defence exhibits RBS 70 NG air defence missile system
missiles.body: SAAB Defence showcased the RBS 70 NG at IDEB 2012, an advanced air defence missile system designed for demanding combat situations. It features 24/7 all-target capability and enhanced operator aids.
missiles.impact: The RBS 70 NG's integrated sighting solution and unjammable laser guidance provide significant improvements in air defence, making it suitable for various complex environments and long-term static deployments.

missiles.t: BAE Systems upgraded APKWS guidance kit
missiles.body: BAE Systems upgraded its APKWS guidance kit to enhance the range of 2.75in laser-guided rockets by up to 30%, enabling warfighters to engage distant targets more effectively.
missiles.impact: This upgrade significantly extends the operational range of APKWS guided rockets, providing warfighters with enhanced precision and extended engagement capabilities.

missiles.t: Italy developed and tested Alfa ballistic missile
missiles.body: Italy successfully developed and tested the Alfa ballistic missile system in the 1970s, which had a range of up to 1600 kilometers. The program was later halted due to US pressure and other factors.
missiles.impact: The Alfa program demonstrated Italy's capability to develop long-range missile systems, influencing subsequent European missile development.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile tested from land and air platforms
missiles.body: India successfully tested the BRAHMOS missile from both land and air platforms, showcasing its capability to hit targets with precision. The tests included a land-attack version from a mobile launcher and an air-launched variant from an SU-30MKI fighter jet.
missiles.impact: These trials revalidate the missile's ship attack capability and bolster the IAF's combat capability from stand-off ranges, establishing BRAHMOS as a significant force multiplier.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall tested a laser weapon station against drones and mortar rounds
missiles.body: Rheinmetall successfully tested a laser weapon station in Switzerland, demonstrating its speed and precision against drones and mortar rounds. The station, consisting of four main components, is designed to be integrated with high-performance lasers and interfaces with the MANTIS air defence system.
missiles.impact: This development marks a significant step in transforming laser weapon technology into a practical defence system, enhancing capabilities against aerial and mortar threats.

missiles.t: LRASM demonstrated egress and flight with Mk-114 booster
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated the egress and flight of the LRASM missile using the Mk-114 ASROCK booster. The test vehicle successfully flew, showcasing the missile's capability with existing booster technology.
missiles.impact: This milestone advances the development of LRASM for surface launch configurations, aligning it with Mk-41 VLS systems and enhancing its operational flexibility.

missiles.t: RBS 70 NG Mobile Firing Unit demonstrated
missiles.body: Saab demonstrated the RBS 70 NG Mobile Firing Unit at DSEI, showcasing its tactical electronics and camouflage system. The system is integrated onto the Joint Light Tactical Vehicle (JLTV).
missiles.impact: The unveiling highlights advancements in mobile air defence, providing enhanced situational awareness and rapid deployment against air threats.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin tested Stinger replacement missile
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin has tested a missile to replace the FIM-92 Stinger. The company plans to conduct more flight tests in 2024.
missiles.impact: This development advances the capability to replace aging Stinger missiles with a new, potentially more advanced system.

missiles.t: Aegis Weapon System-32 intercepted a medium-range ballistic missile
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin successfully conducted a flight test of the Aegis Weapon System-32, which intercepted a medium-range ballistic missile using the Standard Missile-6 Dual II. The test demonstrated the system's capability to handle real-world scenarios.
missiles.impact: This test highlights the Aegis Combat System's enhanced versatility and strength, particularly in defending against medium-range ballistic missile threats, showcasing significant advancements in missile defense technology.

missiles.t: Indonesia procures BrahMos anti-ship missiles from India
missiles.body: Indonesia has concluded an agreement to acquire BrahMos anti-ship cruise missiles from India, including launchers, radar, and missiles. The procurement is for the truck-launched version suitable for mobile operations.
missiles.impact: This procurement enhances Indonesia's maritime defence capabilities with a high-speed, long-range missile system, strengthening its naval deterrence.

missiles.t: Saab revealed Nimbrix, a dedicated C-UAS missile
missiles.body: Saab revealed Nimbrix, a dedicated Counter-UAS missile designed to counter small drones. It features a target seeker and hard-kill warhead, and can be deployed independently or integrated into larger air defence systems.
missiles.impact: Nimbrix addresses the growing threat of small drones on the battlefield and in civilian areas, offering a flexible and cost-effective solution for air defence.

missiles.t: BrahMos missile approved for Indian Navy Ships
missiles.body: The DAC approved the BrahMos missile for use on Indian Navy Ships, a proven supersonic cruise missile.
missiles.impact: This approval enhances the Indian Navy's offensive capabilities with a reliable indigenous missile system.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall and Lockheed-Martin signed to create a missile excellence center in Germany
missiles.body: Rheinmetall and Lockheed-Martin signed an agreement to establish a missile excellence center in Germany, combining their expertise in missile technology and production.
missiles.impact: This collaboration aims to secure key technologies and enhance Germany's long-range strike capabilities, positioning the companies to meet future security requirements.

missiles.t: Roadmap for German Patriot GEM-T production
missiles.body: Raytheon Missiles & Defense and MBDA Deutschland developed a roadmap to produce Patriot GEM-T missiles in Germany, supporting German Armed Forces deployment until 2048.
missiles.impact: This roadmap enhances Germany's and NATO's air defence capabilities by ensuring local production and logistics support for the Patriot system.

missiles.t: RBS15 Mk3 anti-ship missile integrated on truck launcher
missiles.body: Saab has integrated its RBS15 Mk3 anti-ship missile on a launcher module installed on a truck. The system will replace the RBS15 Mk2 and enhance Sweden's coastal defence.
missiles.impact: The RBS15 Mk3, with its advanced target seeker, increased range, and larger warhead, significantly boosts Sweden's anti-ship missile capability, especially in the Baltic Sea's challenging conditions.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin achieves first light in DEIMOS laser weapon system
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin achieved first light in the DEIMOS laser weapon system, demonstrating its beam quality and end-to-end performance. The system is tailored from previous successes to meet the US Army's modernization strategy for air and missile defense.
missiles.impact: DEIMOS represents a significant step towards robust directed energy capability, improving mission success and potentially enhancing layered air defense systems.

missiles.t: KNDS unveiled AIMC2, a command-and-control station
missiles.body: KNDS unveiled the AIMC2 at Eurosatory 2026, a command-and-control station for managing multiple loitering munitions. It is designed to enhance operational capabilities by integrating with various systems.
missiles.impact: The AIMC2 significantly enhances the operational flexibility and effectiveness of loitering munitions, enabling simultaneous management and integration with multiple systems.

missiles.t: India test-fired BRAHMOS missile with new features
missiles.body: India successfully test-fired the BRAHMOS supersonic cruise missile from a mobile launcher to validate new features. The missile, already in service with the Army and Navy, has variants for land, sea, air, and underwater launch.
missiles.impact: This test demonstrates ongoing improvements to the BRAHMOS missile, potentially extending its operational life and reducing replacement costs for the Indian Armed Forces.

missiles.t: KONGSBERG and MESKO S.A. demonstrated PROTECTOR RS6 with dual-PIORUN integration
missiles.body: KONGSBERG and MESKO S.A. demonstrated the PROTECTOR RS6 with integrated dual-PIORUN, a combination of a remote weapon station and a surface-to-air missile system. This system is designed to provide a flexible and mobile kinetic CUAS or air defence capability.
missiles.impact: The integration of PIORUN MANPADS with PROTECTOR RS6 enhances the system's ability to self-protect and engage a range of aerial threats, including mini through Class III drones, making it a robust solution for modern air defence needs.

missiles.t: U.S. Navy conducted LRASM flight test with four missiles
missiles.body: The U.S. Navy, in partnership with Lockheed Martin, conducted a historic LRASM flight test with four missiles, meeting all mission objectives and demonstrating the weapon's high-end lethality.
missiles.impact: This test reinforces confidence in LRASM's superior firepower and capability against highly defended surface combatants, marking a significant step in the missile's evolution.

missiles.t: Raytheon demonstrated NGSRI's ability to detect and intercept aerial threats
missiles.body: Raytheon successfully demonstrated the NGSRI system, showing its capability to detect, track, and intercept simulated aerial threats with direct hits. The system uses advanced precision optics and a solid rocket motor.
missiles.impact: The demonstration highlights NGSRI's superior performance and extended engagement range, positioning it to replace the Stinger system for the U.S. Army.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall develops containerised missile launcher system
missiles.body: Rheinmetall is developing a containerised missile launcher system that integrates advanced missile systems. The system is designed to be modular, flexible, and cost-effective, supporting various operational requirements.
missiles.impact: The CML platform enhances operational flexibility and logistical efficiency, enabling rapid deployment and integration into existing military infrastructures.

missiles.t: AIM-120D3 missile achieved extended range
missiles.body: Raytheon demonstrated an extended range for the AIM-120D3 missile through new circuit cards and software. The upgrade will also be tested on the AIM-120C8 export version.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the operational range of the AIM-120D3, providing a significant tactical advantage in air-to-air combat scenarios.

missiles.t: Developing Europe’s first sovereign exo-atmospheric upper-layer interceptor
missiles.body: The Bliksem EXO Consortium aims to develop Europe’s first sovereign exo-atmospheric upper-layer interceptor, with joint engineering work set to begin in August 2026 and an EKV test planned for 2027.
missiles.impact: This initiative will enhance Europe’s air and missile defence capabilities, ensuring sovereignty and interoperability with NATO IAMD and the European Sky Shield Initiative.

missiles.t: JAGM completed F/A-18 wind tunnel tests
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's JAGM missile completed wind tunnel tests simulating F/A-18 E/F flight environments, advancing towards flight testing.
missiles.impact: These tests refine structural requirements and prepare JAGM for integration with the F/A-18 E/F, enhancing its operational readiness.

missiles.t: BAE Systems improved APKWS missile accuracy and range
missiles.body: BAE Systems has enhanced the APKWS missile, improving its accuracy and range by up to 30%. The system also optimizes the trajectory for more efficient first strikes on both stationary and mobile targets.
missiles.impact: The improved APKWS offers enhanced precision and efficiency, making it a cost-effective alternative for targeting unarmored and lightly armored vehicles.

missiles.t: Kodiak Launcher fired Reduced-Range Practice Rocket
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin conducted the first live-fire test of its Kodiak Launcher, firing a Reduced-Range Practice Rocket to demonstrate offensive fire capability. The test met all mission requirements on the first attempt.
missiles.impact: This successful test validates Kodiak’s capability as a remote GMLRS launcher, offering a modular and efficient solution for firing MLRS-family rockets without needing a HIMARS vehicle.

missiles.t: HERO loitering munitions system fielded
missiles.body: Rheinmetall, in partnership with UVision, has fielded the HERO series of loitering munition systems, designed for operational flexibility and independent fire capabilities. The HERO series operates in challenging conditions and is widely deployed by NATO and other forces.
missiles.impact: The HERO series significantly enhances battlefield flexibility and effectiveness, providing forces with advanced ISR and engagement capabilities in GPS-denied environments.

missiles.t: POINT BLANK hybrid electro-optically-guided missile unveiled
missiles.body: IAI unveiled the POINT BLANK missile, a hybrid electro-optically-guided system designed for precision strikes. The missile weighs 15 lbs, is 3 ft long, and can fly at altitudes above 1,500 ft with a maximum speed of 178 mph.
missiles.impact: POINT BLANK enhances the precision strike capabilities of small tactical teams, providing them with increased lethality and survivability.

missiles.t: Raytheon flight-tested upgraded AMRAAM-ER from NASAMS
missiles.body: Raytheon conducted the maiden flight test of the AMRAAM-ER variant from a NASAMS launcher, integrating new propulsion and guidance systems. The test was supported by the Norwegian Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces.
missiles.impact: The AMRAAM-ER's extended range and altitude capabilities enhance the NASAMS system's effectiveness against evolving aerial threats.

missiles.t: Increment 2 seeker package flown 350km
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin flew the Increment 2 seeker package for the Precision Strike Missile, covering 350km. The flight gathered performance data but did not include an intercept.
missiles.impact: This flight test advances the development of the Precision Strike Missile, providing critical performance data for further refinement.

missiles.t: Tomahawk Block V missile successfully completed flight tests
missiles.body: Raytheon Missiles & Defense and the U.S. Navy conducted the first flight tests of the Tomahawk Block V missile, which successfully impacted targets at various ranges. The missile is highly accurate and GPS-enabled, capable of conducting precise strikes in heavily defended airspace.
missiles.impact: The successful tests of the Tomahawk Block V enhance the U.S. Navy's long-range strike capabilities, ensuring minimal collateral damage and reinforcing the missile's role in modern warfare.

missiles.t: Hanwha plans to produce precision-guided missiles in Germany
missiles.body: Hanwha Aerospace aims to establish a manufacturing facility in eastern Germany to produce precision-guided missiles and ammunition, aligning with NATO standards and Bundeswehr priorities.
missiles.impact: This development could enhance Germany's and NATO's strategic autonomy by localizing advanced defense capabilities and reducing reliance on foreign supply chains.

missiles.t: Raytheon completed active seeker test for Tomahawk missile
missiles.body: Raytheon successfully demonstrated an active seeker test for the Tomahawk missile, achieving Technology Readiness Level 6 in December 2015. This test showcased the seeker's capability and maturity.
missiles.impact: The superior capability of the seeker enhances the Tomahawk's role in long-range precision strike missions, improving its offensive punch and targeting accuracy.

missiles.t: BrahMos-ER missile tested in various trials
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace has tested the BrahMos-ER missile in various trials, demonstrating its reliability in anti-ship and land-attack roles. The Indian Navy aims to integrate BrahMos across its fleet, including Project 17A frigates and Project 15B destroyers.
missiles.impact: The integration of BrahMos-ER across the Indian Navy's fleet enhances its saturation strike capability, providing a versatile and reliable weapon system for multiple platforms.

missiles.t: Umkhonto surface-to-air missile system for sale to Iran
missiles.body: Denel seeks to sell its Umkhonto surface-to-air missile system to Iran, a system already in service with South Africa's navy since 2001.
missiles.impact: This deal, if successful, would be the largest for Denel's Umkhonto missile system, indicating growing international interest in South African defense technology.

missiles.t: ER GMLRS entered production, doubling rocket range
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin has entered ER GMLRS into production, doubling the range of the current rocket from 70km to 150km. ER GMLRS is deployable by HIMARS and the MLRS M270 family of launchers.
missiles.impact: This advancement enhances the flexibility and range of artillery systems, providing significant tactical advantages on the battlefield.

missiles.t: Raytheon to develop next-gen nuclear cruise missiles
missiles.body: The US Air Force signed an agreement with Raytheon to develop next-generation nuclear cruise missiles. The program, initially involving Lockheed Martin, now focuses solely on Raytheon's design.
missiles.impact: This development aims to restore the US's tactical nuclear capability after retiring the AGM-86 ALCM systems, addressing a critical gap in cruise missile capabilities.

missiles.t: BrahMos missile system tested on naval vessels
missiles.body: The BrahMos missile system was tested on various naval vessels, demonstrating its capability to engage both maritime and land targets with high precision and lethality. The system can conduct salvo launches targeting single or multiple diverse targets along different trajectories.
missiles.impact: The successful tests affirm BrahMos's role as a primary offensive weapon for the Indian Navy, enhancing its maritime strike capabilities and strategic deterrence.

missiles.t: SM-3 Block IB with enhanced seeker and propulsion
missiles.body: Raytheon's SM-3 Block IB missile demonstrated enhanced capabilities during NATO exercises, featuring an improved infrared seeker and advanced propulsion system. It has been deployed on U.S. Navy ships and Aegis Ashore sites since 2014.
missiles.impact: The SM-3 Block IB's advanced features significantly enhance missile defense capabilities, providing a robust shield against ballistic missile threats for the U.S. and its allies.

missiles.t: SLAMRAAM system completed first FMTV launcher test firing
missiles.body: Raytheon's SLAMRAAM system successfully completed its first test firing from the FMTV launcher, designed to increase survivability and provide additional armored capability. Initial launch condition data was collected to reduce risk in future integration efforts.
missiles.impact: This test firing marks a significant step in transitioning the SLAMRAAM system to a more survivable and ruggedized platform, enhancing its operational readiness and effectiveness.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall unveiled GBAD system with 35mm gun
missiles.body: Rheinmetall Air Defence unveiled a GBAD system at EDEX with a 35mm Oerlikon Revolver Gun Mk3 HLP, featuring X-band radar and electro-optical sensors for autonomous tracking.
missiles.impact: The system's autonomous capabilities and high rate of fire make it a competitive offering for short-range air defence, potentially enhancing rapid deployment and effectiveness.

missiles.t: BrahMos conducted test firings of extended range version
missiles.body: BrahMos has conducted test firings of an extended range version of its supersonic cruise missile. The Indian Navy plans to equip its warships with BrahMos missiles.
missiles.impact: The extended range version enhances the strike capability of the Indian Navy and Air Force, solidifying BrahMos's role in India's defence modernization.

missiles.t: Thales and ArianeGroup flew the ground-launched FLP-T 150 missile
missiles.body: Thales and ArianeGroup successfully flew the ground-launched FLP-T 150 missile, a weapon designed for rapid deployment of conventional warheads. This test supports France's objective to field such a weapon.
missiles.impact: The successful flight test of the FLP-T 150 missile marks a significant step towards operational readiness, enhancing rapid response capabilities for conventional warfare.

missiles.t: Raytheon UK unveiled Red Kite, a precision munition
missiles.body: Raytheon UK unveiled Red Kite, a precision munition developed through digital engineering. It is designed to bolster the RAF's munitions stockpiles and offers a low-cost, high-volume capability.
missiles.impact: Red Kite represents a significant step towards a more resilient and sovereign UK defence industrial base, enhancing the RAF's operational flexibility and capability.

missiles.t: Israel develops Arrow missile with advanced interception technology
missiles.body: Israel Aerospace Industries is developing the Arrow missile, which features advanced high-altitude anti-ballistic capabilities. The missile is designed to intercept incoming ballistic missiles at high altitudes.
missiles.impact: The development of the Arrow missile represents a significant advancement in anti-ballistic missile defense technology, enhancing Israel's capability to defend against long-range threats.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin and Thales produce GMLRS at Bourges facility
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin and Thales are producing GMLRS at the Bourges facility in France. This partnership aims to enhance the production of SRMs and aligns with Australia's 2024 Defence Industry Development Strategy.
missiles.impact: This collaboration strengthens Australia's missile technology capabilities and supports domestic manufacturing of weapon components, crucial for addressing Pacific security challenges.

missiles.t: First stage solid rocket motor met performance parameters
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin successfully tested the first stage solid rocket motor for the U.S. Navy’s hypersonic strike system. The motor met all performance objectives during a live fire ground test.
missiles.impact: This milestone advances the development of hypersonic strike capability for both the U.S. Navy and Army, enhancing their strategic strike options.

missiles.t: Renault and Thales develop short-range tactical missile Toutatis
missiles.body: Renault and Thales have developed the Toutatis short-range tactical missile system, which is teleoperated and has a range of 10 to 30 km. The system is designed to be low-cost and deployable by infantry in five minutes.
missiles.impact: Toutatis is significant for its rapid deployment capability and cost-effectiveness, addressing the demand for short-range tactical missile systems in the French armed forces.

missiles.t: Northrop Grumman unveiled Raid Hunter, a gun-based short-range air defense system
missiles.body: Northrop Grumman unveiled Raid Hunter, a short-range air defense system that combines a 50mm XM913 Bushmaster III chain gun with guided ammunition and a networked controller. It is designed to engage high-priority cruise missiles, unmanned aerial systems, and other advanced threats.
missiles.impact: Raid Hunter provides a cost-effective and flexible solution for rapid, high-capacity protection against complex aerial threats, enhancing the security of vital bases and infrastructure.

missiles.t: Solar Defence increased BrahMos booster production to 12/month
missiles.body: Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited has increased the production rate of BrahMos missile boosters to 12 per month, a tenfold increase over the long-term average. This expansion aligns with India's growing demand for BrahMos missiles across all three services.
missiles.impact: This production boost ensures a steady supply of BrahMos boosters, supporting the rapid deployment and integration of the missile across various Indian military platforms.

missiles.t: Stinger missile fired from Javelin launcher
missiles.body: Raytheon demonstrated firing a Stinger missile from a Javelin Lightweight Command Launch Unit (LWCLU) in a test. The test showed the missile engaging and defeating an uncrewed aerial threat.
missiles.impact: This capability allows soldiers to use a single launcher to defeat both land and aerial threats, reducing the burden of carrying additional gear.

missiles.t: NOMADS is a SHORAD system for on-the-move air defence
missiles.body: NOMADS is a short-range air defence system designed for on-the-move protection. It is fielded with the Norwegian Army and can operate autonomously.
missiles.impact: NOMADS provides dynamic and efficient air defence coverage for mobile forces, enhancing their ability to counter a wide range of aerial threats.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS-M (Mini) missile planned for Navy and Air Force
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing a lighter version of the BRAHMOS missile, called BRAHMOS-M (Mini), for use by the Navy and Air Force. The Mini can be launched from submarines' torpedo tubes and is compatible with future platforms.
missiles.impact: The BRAHMOS-M (Mini) missile enhances the versatility and firepower of naval and air platforms, providing a more compact and flexible solution for long-range strikes.

missiles.t: Nammo completed ramjet missile test
missiles.body: Nammo successfully tested a ramjet missile, accelerating it to above Mach 2. The test demonstrated the viability of ramjet propulsion technology.
missiles.impact: This milestone marks significant progress in range, time to target, and agility for future missile systems, enhancing capabilities in air-to-air, ground-launched air defense, and naval applications.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin test-fired PrSM missile
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin conducted a second test of the Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) from a HIMARS launcher, achieving all objectives. The test demonstrated the missile's reliability and precision over a 180km range.
missiles.impact: This successful test validates the PrSM's advanced capabilities and positions Lockheed Martin to deliver a next-generation precision-strike weapon system to various military units.

missiles.t: Diehl Defence unveiled IRIS-T SLS MK4 at ILA Berlin air show
missiles.body: Diehl Defence unveiled the IRIS-T SLS MK4 at the ILA Berlin air show, featuring automated relocation and missile storage in armored canisters.
missiles.impact: The system's automation and protection features enhance mobility and readiness for close-in air defense, improving the defense capabilities of maneuver units and critical sites.

missiles.t: Boeing tested a modular radar seeker on a Beechcraft 1900
missiles.body: Boeing tested a modular radar seeker on a Beechcraft 1900, tracking a drone and surviving tests. The seeker is designed for reuse across various weapons.
missiles.impact: This modular seeker could reduce development costs and accelerate deployment of new missile systems.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin completed two successful LADAR seeker tests
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin completed two successful tests of a new LADAR seeker for the LOCAAS missile system. The tests were conducted at Ft. Bliss and Redstone Arsenal to characterize the seeker's performance.
missiles.impact: The successful tests indicate progress towards a low-cost, high-resolution LADAR seeker for LOCAAS, enhancing its capability for theater missile defense and suppression of enemy air defenses.

missiles.t: Dynauton Systems developed jet-powered loitering munition KAATIL
missiles.body: Dynauton Systems developed the KAATIL, a jet-powered loitering munition with a mini-jet turbo engine, enabling high speeds and modular warheads. It is designed for fast precision strikes and contested GPS environments.
missiles.impact: KAATIL's unique propulsion and modular payload capabilities position it as a significant advancement in India's strike doctrine, offering enhanced flexibility and effectiveness in modern warfare scenarios.

missiles.t: Raytheon developed StormBreaker smart weapon
missiles.body: Raytheon Missiles & Defense has developed the StormBreaker smart weapon, which will be procured by Norway for its F-35 fleet. The weapon features a tri-mode seeker and can be launched from one platform and controlled from another.
missiles.impact: StormBreaker significantly enhances the Norwegian Air Force's capability to engage stationary and moving targets at stand-off ranges, providing a tactical advantage in combat scenarios.

missiles.t: naval variant of BRAHMOS missile tested
missiles.body: India successfully test-fired a naval variant of the advanced supersonic BRAHMOS cruise missile from INS Visakhapatnam. The missile has an extended range of 350 to 400 km.
missiles.impact: The extended range and successful test firing demonstrate the missile's enhanced capability and reliability, reinforcing the Indian Navy's mission readiness.

missiles.t: BrahMos validated consecutive launches from Land & Air
missiles.body: BrahMos conducted consecutive launches from both land and air platforms, demonstrating its versatility. This validation includes launches from different platforms, showcasing its operational flexibility.
missiles.impact: The successful consecutive launches from multiple platforms enhance BrahMos's strategic value by ensuring it can be deployed flexibly across various combat scenarios.

missiles.t: MELLS missile integrated into Marder vehicle
missiles.body: Rheinmetall evaluated the MELLS antitank missile on the Marder 1A5 vehicle, developing a modified storage concept to integrate the missile system.
missiles.impact: This integration enhances the Marder's capability to carry and deploy MELLS missiles effectively, improving its anti-tank warfare potential.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS Mobile Autonomous Launcher (MAL) inducted
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace demonstrated the BRAHMOS Mobile Autonomous Launcher (MAL) to the Russian Defence Minister, which has been inducted into both the Indian Army and Air Force.
missiles.impact: The induction of the MAL enhances the mobility and operational flexibility of the BRAHMOS missile system, providing rapid deployment capabilities for land-based weapon complexes.

missiles.t: Hanwha developing L-PGW100 loitering munition missile for Chunmoo MRL
missiles.body: Hanwha Aerospace is developing the L-PGW100, a loitering munition missile for the Chunmoo multiple rocket launcher system. The project began in 2024 with a goal to complete it by 2029.
missiles.impact: The L-PGW100 enhances the Chunmoo system's capabilities by enabling various strike roles, marking a significant advancement in loitering munition technology.

missiles.t: Saab develops Lightweight Air-launched Decoy Missile
missiles.body: Saab has developed a new Lightweight Air-launched Decoy Missile designed to act as a stand-in jammer for demanding missions. It reduces the number of missiles and aircraft needed and can jam or create false targets for various radars.
missiles.impact: The decoy missile enhances Gripen E/F’s electronic attack capabilities, acting as a force multiplier and strengthening Saab’s offer to Finland in the HX fighter procurement.

missiles.t: demonstrated multi-target warhead fuze for JCM
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin and PerkinElmer Optoelectronics demonstrated a multi-target warhead fuze for the Joint Common Missile. The fuze is capable of detonating the precursor.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the missile's capability to engage multiple targets, improving its effectiveness in combat scenarios.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall tested 50kW high-energy laser weapon demonstrator
missiles.body: Rheinmetall tested a 50kW high-energy laser weapon demonstrator, showing its effectiveness in various scenarios including air defence and asymmetric warfare. The test demonstrated a five-fold increase in laser power compared to a 10kW version.
missiles.impact: The successful test highlights Rheinmetall's capability to integrate high-energy lasers into existing defence systems, potentially enhancing air defence and counter-UAV capabilities.

missiles.t: Anduril supplies new solid-fuel engines to GLSDB
missiles.body: Anduril Rocket Motor Systems is developing and qualifying new solid-fuel engines for the GLSDB missile, set to begin production in 2026. These engines are reportedly cheaper and faster than those used in the M26 MLRS.
missiles.impact: The cheaper and faster engines could enhance the cost-effectiveness and operational readiness of GLSDB systems for military customers.

missiles.t: BrahMos Aerospace developing BrahMos-NG
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing a lighter variant of the BrahMos missile, known as BrahMos-NG, which will not require fuselage modifications for the Su-30MKI.
missiles.impact: The BrahMos-NG will provide a more streamlined and cost-effective solution for integrating with other fighter types in the IAF fleet, enhancing the IAF's long-range strike capabilities.

missiles.t: North Korea tested a missile capable of carrying a 4.5 ton-class warhead
missiles.body: North Korea claims to have tested a new tactical ballistic missile capable of carrying a 4.5 ton-class warhead. The test was aimed at verifying flight stability and hit accuracy.
missiles.impact: The successful demonstration of a missile with a large warhead capability could enhance North Korea's strategic deterrence and long-range strike capabilities.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin developing LRMF missile for US Army
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin is developing the Long Range Maneuverable Fires (LRMF) missile for the US Army, integrating advanced propulsion systems.
missiles.impact: The LRMF program aims to extend the range of the existing Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) and enhance maneuverability, providing the US Army with advanced strategic and operational capabilities.

missiles.t: Thales unveils Lightweight Multi-role Missile (LMM)
missiles.body: Thales unveiled the Lightweight Multi-role Missile (LMM) at Aero India 2025, showcasing its versatility and advanced capabilities. The LMM is part of an impressive lineup of missile systems designed to meet evolving operational needs.
missiles.impact: The LMM's unveiling highlights Thales's commitment to providing advanced missile solutions, potentially enhancing the air defence and multi-role capabilities of the Indian armed forces.

missiles.t: NGI program achieved communications testing milestone
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's NGI program completed a communications testing milestone, using digital tools and Agile development to rapidly prototype and test the system.
missiles.impact: This milestone supports the maturation of the NGI system, ensuring timely delivery and validation of critical performance parameters.

missiles.t: Elbit unveiled PAWS-2 missile approach warning system
missiles.body: Elbit Systems unveiled PAWS-2, a new missile approach warning system for aircraft at the Paris Air Show 2025. PAWS-2 uses a new-generation mid-wave IR sensor for long-range detection and low false alarm rates.
missiles.impact: PAWS-2 enhances aircraft survivability by providing early warning and precise geolocation of missile launches, enabling timely countermeasures.

missiles.t: Nammo unveiled a ramjet-powered missile engine
missiles.body: Nammo unveiled a ramjet-powered missile engine at DSEI, transforming a traditional solid-fueled rocket motor into an air breather to boost range.
missiles.impact: This development significantly extends the range of missiles, potentially reaching over 400 kilometers, far surpassing current models like the ESSM.

missiles.t: Kongsberg delivers new batch of Naval Strike Missile
missiles.body: Kongsberg has delivered a new batch of Naval Strike Missiles to the Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency. The NSM is a fifth-generation missile with advanced capabilities for sea-to-sea or sea-to-land defence.
missiles.impact: The delivery of the NSM enhances Norway's naval defence capabilities against well-defended targets, demonstrating the missile's superior performance and advanced air defence penetration.

missiles.t: IAI presents RAM Mk3 AT NIMROD anti-tank missile combat vehicle
missiles.body: IAI has developed the RAM Mk3 AT NIMROD combat vehicle, featuring the NIMROD SR missile with a range of up to 8 km. The RAM Mk3 is based on recent battlefield requirements and is designed for high maneuverability.
missiles.impact: The RAM Mk3 AT NIMROD provides enhanced anti-tank capabilities with its agile all-terrain vehicle and modern laser-guided missiles, offering tactical advantages in extreme terrain.

missiles.t: L-SAM launchers and ABMs for high-altitude interception
missiles.body: Hanwha Aerospace signed a contract to produce and deliver L-SAM launchers and ABMs by 2030, adding a high-altitude interception layer to South Korea’s defense.
missiles.impact: The L-SAM system enhances South Korea’s missile defense capabilities by providing an additional layer of protection against ballistic missiles at high altitudes.

missiles.t: Saab unveils Bolide 2 missile with improved warhead and components
missiles.body: Saab has unveiled the Bolide 2 missile for the RBS 70 SHORAD system, featuring a larger warhead with 50% more explosives and 40% more tungsten pellets, enhancing terminal flight performance and damage capability.
missiles.impact: The enhanced warhead and improved components of Bolide 2 significantly increase its destructive power and effectiveness against aerial threats, setting a new standard for SHORAD systems.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS demonstrated salvo launch capability
missiles.body: BRAHMOS has demonstrated its ability to launch multiple missiles simultaneously from naval platforms, targeting different directions. This capability was showcased during successful test firings.
missiles.impact: The salvo launch capability enhances BRAHMOS's effectiveness against multiple or dispersed targets, providing a significant tactical advantage in naval engagements.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall unveiled KF41 Lynx Skyranger 35 air-defence system
missiles.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the KF41 Lynx Skyranger 35 (SR35) air-defence system in a video, featuring a 35 mm×228 calibre revolver cannon and advanced radar capabilities. The SR35 is designed to operate on the move and fires airburst munition.
missiles.impact: The SR35's advanced radar and cannon capabilities enhance its effectiveness in mobile ground-based air-defence roles, providing a significant upgrade over previous models.

missiles.t: Raytheon awarded contract for Maritime Strike Tomahawk Block Va
missiles.body: Raytheon received a contract to produce the Maritime Strike Tomahawk Block Va, ensuring advanced long-range weapons for the U.S. Navy.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the Navy's capability to counter moving maritime threats with precision strikes from extended ranges.

missiles.t: Saab developed Nimbrix, a small drone-intercepting rocket
missiles.body: Saab has developed the Nimbrix, a small drone-intercepting rocket designed to be cost-effective and integrate with existing systems. It is scheduled to be presented at DSEI in London in September 2026.
missiles.impact: Nimbrix represents a cost-effective solution for countering small drones, aligning with the trend towards developing affordable and efficient anti-drone systems.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall delivers MANTIS ADS SHORAD system
missiles.body: Rheinmetall delivered a MANTIS ADS SHORAD system to an unnamed export customer. The system is designed to intercept various aerial threats and is based on Oerlikon Skyshield technology.
missiles.impact: The delivery of MANTIS ADS underscores Rheinmetall's capability in short-range air defense systems, enhancing the customer's ability to counter aerial threats effectively.

missiles.t: static fire test of advanced solid rocket motor
missiles.body: Raytheon, an RTX business, completed a static fire test of an advanced solid rocket motor in collaboration with Anduril. The test was part of a contract with the Air Force Research Laboratory Munitions Directorate to enhance U.S.-based rocket motor manufacturing capacity.
missiles.impact: This test demonstrates a significant step in collaborative innovation for advanced rocket motor development, addressing critical limitations in the supply base.

missiles.t: Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) tested successfully
missiles.body: Raytheon Missiles and Defense successfully tested the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) with Northrop Grumman's scramjet propulsion. The test demonstrated the missile's capability to travel over five times the speed of sound.
missiles.impact: The successful test of HACM marks a significant milestone in the development of hypersonic weapons for the U.S. Air Force, providing a strategic advantage with its speed and range.

missiles.t: Spike NLOS missile fired from Apache helicopter
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin successfully fired two Spike NLOS missiles from an Apache helicopter platform. The system is undergoing testing to qualify for airworthiness release.
missiles.impact: This integration enhances the Apache's long-range precision strike capability, providing the U.S. Army with advanced anti-armor and anti-fortification capabilities.

missiles.t: IAF test-fired extended range BrahMos AL missile
missiles.body: The Indian Air Force successfully test-fired the extended range version of the BrahMos Air Launched missile from a Su-30MKI fighter, achieving its mission objectives. This test marks a significant enhancement in the IAF's operational capabilities.
missiles.impact: The extended range capability of the BrahMos AL missile, coupled with the Su-30MKI's performance, provides the IAF with strategic reach and precision strike capabilities against land and sea targets over long distances.

missiles.t: IAF test-fired aerial BRAHMOS missile from Su-30 MKI
missiles.body: The IAF successfully test-fired the aerial version of the supersonic BRAHMOS cruise missile from a Su-30 MKI fighter aircraft. The missile hit a land target accurately.
missiles.impact: This test demonstrates the IAF's enhanced combat capability with the integration of the 300 km range, Mach 2.8 speed missile, showcasing the nation's advanced missile integration capabilities.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS missile successfully test-fired from INS Ranvir
missiles.body: The BRAHMOS missile was successfully test-fired from INS Ranvir, demonstrating its capability to launch from a vertical launcher on a moving warship. The missile performed supersonic maneuvering and hit a decommissioned target ship.
missiles.impact: This test confirms BRAHMOS's operational readiness and versatility in naval warfare, enhancing India's maritime defense capabilities.

missiles.t: Thales Belgium develops new launchers for 70mm rockets
missiles.body: Thales Belgium is developing new launchers for 70mm rockets, inspired by their use in Ukraine. They are also exploring integration with drones and ground robots.
missiles.impact: This development could enhance the versatility and effectiveness of 70mm rockets in various combat scenarios, including unmanned systems.

missiles.t: PrSM missile exceeded range threshold in test
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin successfully tested the PrSM missile, achieving an extended range flight over the Pacific Ocean. This test moves the missile closer to early operating capability in 2023.
missiles.impact: The extended range and performance validation of the PrSM missile enhances the US Army's capability to engage targets at greater distances, providing strategic advantages on the battlefield.

missiles.t: wired end-burning technology for hypersonic applications tested
missiles.body: Raytheon and Northrop Grumman tested a wired end-burning technology for hypersonic applications, demonstrating extended range over conventional rocket motors. The test provided data to validate the design maturity and performance of the rocket motor.
missiles.impact: This test is significant for advancing hypersonic capabilities, providing critical data for digital modeling and simulations, and accelerating the development of advanced rocket motors.

missiles.t: SM-2 missile intercepted anti-ship missiles and drones
missiles.body: Raytheon and the U.S. Navy successfully tested the SM-2 missile in 2020. In early 2024, the U.S. Navy used SM-2 missiles to intercept anti-ship missiles and drones in the Red Sea.
missiles.impact: The successful interception demonstrates the SM-2 missile's capability to defend against high-speed, maneuverable threats, reinforcing its role as a primary anti-air warfare weapon for the U.S. Navy.

missiles.t: Raytheon tested a small-sized, precision-guided bomb
missiles.body: Raytheon tested a small-sized, precision-guided bomb called Small Tactical Munition (STM) in flight. The STM uses GPS-inertial navigation and semi-active laser guidance to hit targets.
missiles.impact: The STM addresses the need for precision-guided munitions suitable for remotely piloted aircraft, enhancing the effectiveness of drone-based combat operations.

missiles.t: LRASM operational on F/A-18E/F and B-1B
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's LRASM anti-ship missile is now operational on the U.S. Navy's F/A-18E/F and U.S. Air Force's B-1B. LRASM is designed to detect and destroy specific targets within groups of ships with advanced technologies.
missiles.impact: LRASM's operational status on these platforms significantly enhances the U.S. Navy and Air Force's offensive anti-surface warfare capabilities by reducing dependence on intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance.

missiles.t: BrahMos cruise missile tested from destroyer
missiles.body: DRDO tested the BrahMos cruise missile from the destroyer INS Visakhapatnam. The missile has a range of up to 290 km and operates at supersonic speed.
missiles.impact: This test enhances India's naval defense capability by demonstrating the missile's effectiveness in repelling threats and its non-interceptability by known weapon systems.

missiles.t: Luch proposed adapting aircraft rockets for 90mm and 105mm guided rocket launchers
missiles.body: Luch proposed adapting aircraft rockets for use with 90mm and 105mm guided rocket launchers, aiming to enhance the capabilities of Brazilian Gripen jets. The Ukrainian company's proposals have shown interest from the Brazilian side.
missiles.impact: This development could provide Brazilian Gripen jets with enhanced ground attack capabilities through the integration of advanced guided rockets.

missiles.t: IAI unveiled LAHAT ALPHA, an extended-range laser-homing missile
missiles.body: IAI unveiled LAHAT ALPHA, an extended-range laser-homing missile designed for engagements beyond 20 kilometers. It features a large warhead and can be launched from ground vehicles or helicopters.
missiles.impact: LAHAT ALPHA significantly extends engagement ranges and lethality for anti-tank operations, enhancing operational flexibility and effectiveness in GPS-denied environments.

missiles.t: L-SAM production contract awarded
missiles.driver: South Korea’s Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA)
missiles.body: DAPA awarded Hanwha Aerospace a KRW705.4 billion contract for L-SAM production through 2030, covering launchers and anti-ballistic missiles. L-SAM, incorporating DACS and dual-pulse propulsion, will engage enemy ballistic missiles at high altitudes.
missiles.impact: L-SAM's high-altitude interception capability enhances South Korea's air defense by providing an additional layer before existing systems like M-SAM and Patriot are activated.

missiles.t: BAE Systems contracted for SLCM-N development
missiles.body: BAE Systems received a contract for the development of the SLCM-N, a nuclear-tipped cruise missile to replace the Tomahawk. The project is in its early stages, with readiness expected by 2034.
missiles.impact: This marks a significant step in the US Navy's strategic missile development, focusing on a new nuclear-capable cruise missile system.

missiles.t: Falcon GBAD system unveiled with IRIS-T SLM interceptor
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin, Diehl, and Saab unveiled the Falcon GBAD system at IDEX 2019, featuring Diehl’s IRIS-T SLM interceptor and Saab’s Giraffe 4A radar. The system is designed to provide short and medium-range air defense against current and emerging threats.
missiles.impact: Falcon represents a significant advancement in air defense technology, offering enhanced protection against evolving threats and easily integrating into existing air operations centers.

missiles.t: Aegis Ashore successfully completes first intercept test
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin, in collaboration with the US Navy and MDA, successfully completed the first intercept test of Aegis Ashore, a land-based version of the Aegis Combat System. This test marks a significant milestone for the system's development and deployment.
missiles.impact: The successful intercept demonstrates the system's capability to protect deployed forces and allies from ballistic missile threats, enhancing regional security and defense capabilities.

missiles.t: BAE Systems and MBDA collaborate on weaponising Strix UAS
missiles.body: BAE Systems and MBDA are collaborating to weaponise the Strix UAS to meet the needs of the Australian Army, Navy, and Air Force. This collaboration aims to develop enduring Australian Industry Capability and deliver a range of GWEO capabilities.
missiles.impact: The weaponisation of the Strix UAS will enhance the Australian military's guided weapon capabilities, supporting the federal government's objective to expand these capabilities.

missiles.t: BrahMos missile test-flown in air-to-ground configuration
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace plans to test-fly the BrahMos missile in an air-to-ground configuration this year. The company has developed various versions of the missile for ship, submarine, and land launch.
missiles.impact: This test flight represents a significant step in expanding the operational flexibility of the BrahMos missile system, enhancing its multi-domain capabilities.

missiles.t: IAI developed BARAK MX naval missile defence system
missiles.body: IAI has developed the BARAK MX, an advanced naval missile defence system. It integrates radar, weapon control, and interceptors to handle multiple aerial threats.
missiles.impact: BARAK MX significantly enhances naval air defence capabilities, offering a flexible and comprehensive solution against modern threats like sea-skimming missiles and fighter jets.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin tested two CMMT modular missile versions
