missiles.body: Lockheed Martin tested two versions of the CMMT modular missile, CMMT-D and CMMT-X, in flight tests. CMMT-D was dropped from a helicopter and CMMT-X from a Piper Navajo test aircraft.
missiles.impact: These tests demonstrate the missile's versatility and potential for deployment from various platforms, advancing Lockheed Martin's modular missile capabilities.

missiles.t: Rafael tested upgraded Spyder with I-DERBY ER/LR missiles
missiles.body: Rafael tested an upgraded Spyder air-defense system in Israel, using I-DERBY ER and I-DERBY LR missiles to achieve direct hit-to-kill interceptions in complex scenarios.
missiles.impact: The successful test reflects operational improvements and technological advancements in air defense capabilities, enhancing protection against various aerial threats.

missiles.t: Raytheon demonstrated GhostEye MR radar system
missiles.body: Raytheon demonstrated the GhostEye MR radar system during a US Air Force exercise, showing its integration with NASAMS and its ability to detect and track live targets.
missiles.impact: The GhostEye MR enhances NASAMS' defended-area capabilities by providing increased range and altitude coverage, crucial for integrated air and missile defense.

missiles.t: Iron Dome receives upgrades to enhance performance against threats
missiles.body: Rafael and IMDO completed a test series for Iron Dome, integrating upgrades to enhance its performance against existing and future threats. The upgrades include operational integration of the Iron Beam high-power laser system as a complementary system to Iron Dome.
missiles.impact: The enhancements significantly improve Iron Dome's ability to counter a wide range of attack scenarios, providing Israel with a strategic advantage in missile defense.

missiles.t: C2BMC demonstrated engage on remote capability
missiles.body: C2BMC's engage on remote capability was demonstrated in a Missile Defense Agency flight test in December 2018. This capability enables the Aegis Weapon System to plan, launch, and engage a missile using remote sensor data without organic Aegis radar detection.
missiles.impact: This advance enhances the effectiveness and flexibility of ballistic missile defense operations by allowing remote sensor data integration, improving the system's operational range and response time.

missiles.t: Umkhonto air defence system demonstrated
missiles.body: Denel Dynamics demonstrated the Umkhonto air defence system at DSA, showcasing South Africa's capability in missile technology. The system is part of an integrated air defence solution.
missiles.impact: The demonstration highlights Denel's competitive edge in the international market, particularly in the Asia-Pacific region, by offering advanced air defence solutions.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall develops HIMARS-like missile systems
missiles.body: Rheinmetall is developing missile rockets and ammunition similar to HIMARS for multiple launch rocket systems. Rheinmetall Destinus Strike Systems aims to create new modern missile systems and improve existing ones for sale to Europe and NATO countries.
missiles.impact: This development could strengthen Europe's independence in providing arms and reduce reliance on external suppliers.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall accelerates production of Loitering Munitions
missiles.body: Rheinmetall has completed a modern production facility in Italy for Loitering Munitions (LM), where inert and electronic components are assembled and tested, and warheads are manufactured and integrated.
missiles.impact: This production acceleration enhances Rheinmetall's capability to deliver LM systems to multiple countries, bolstering their precision strike capabilities against various targets.

missiles.t: Rheinmetall Destinus JV to develop and mass produce advanced missile systems
missiles.body: Rheinmetall and Destinus are forming a joint venture to develop and mass produce advanced missile systems, focusing on high-precision munitions like cruise missiles and ballistic rocket artillery.
missiles.impact: This partnership aims to strengthen Europe's defense industrial base by expanding production capacity for critical missile systems.

missiles.t: LRASM achieved EOC with F/A-18E/F Super Hornet
missiles.body: BAE Systems achieved EOC for LRASM with the F/A-18E/F Super Hornet. LRASM is designed to detect and destroy specific targets within groups of ships.
missiles.impact: This milestone enhances the U.S. Navy's offensive anti-surface warfare capabilities in contested environments.

missiles.t: PrSM flew 400km in a test
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin's Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) successfully flew 400km in a test at White Sands Missile Range. The Army is exploring critical technologies to extend the missile's range to 1000km.
missiles.impact: This test demonstrates PrSM's capability to meet performance requirements, advancing it towards replacing the Army Tactical Missile System.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin conducted first live-fire test of containerized GMLRS launcher
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin conducted the first live-fire test of its new containerized GMLRS launcher, a system designed for the U.S. Army’s long-range surface-to-surface missile needs.
missiles.impact: This test represents a significant step towards enhancing the mobility and flexibility of the GMLRS system, potentially improving rapid deployment and tactical responsiveness.

missiles.t: Saab developed a new torpedo tube for lightweight torpedoes
missiles.body: Saab has developed a new torpedo tube for lightweight torpedoes, designed to enhance and future-proof Sweden's anti-submarine capabilities from surface ships. Deliveries are scheduled for 2023.
missiles.impact: This development will improve the operational flexibility and surveillance capabilities of Swedish surface ships, strengthening their anti-submarine warfare capacity.

missiles.t: Thrust Vector Controller for ESSM achieved global milestone
missiles.body: BAE Systems Australia developed and produced a Thrust Vector Controller for the Evolved Sea Sparrow Missile, achieving a global milestone. The technology has been in production since the late 1990s and is now entering full-rate production.
missiles.impact: This milestone underscores BAE Systems Australia's capability in advanced missile technology, contributing significantly to global defense programs.

missiles.t: Raytheon to integrate new guidance systems with Tomahawk missiles
missiles.body: Raytheon will integrate new guidance systems with Tomahawk missiles for low-rate production. This involves producing, qualifying, testing, and fielding 29 Lot Two Maritime Strike Tomahawk seeker suites.
missiles.impact: The new guidance systems will enhance the precision and flexibility of the Tomahawk missiles, potentially improving their effectiveness in deep land attack warfare.

missiles.t: DRDO developing liquid-fuelled ramjet engine for STAR missile
missiles.body: DRDO is developing a liquid-fuelled ramjet engine for the STAR missile. The first flight is expected by the end of 2025, with production to commence in 2026.
missiles.impact: This development enhances India's capability to produce advanced supersonic missiles, crucial for maintaining strategic deterrence.

missiles.t: BrahMos-NG missile carriage design enables multiple missile carriage
missiles.body: DRDO has developed BrahMos-NG, a lighter missile that enables the Su-30MKI to carry up to five missiles. This design change significantly enhances the aircraft's strike capabilities.
missiles.impact: The BrahMos-NG's reduced weight allows the Su-30MKI to engage multiple targets in a single sortie, increasing its operational flexibility and strike effectiveness.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin delivered a 300-kilowatt laser for Army high-energy laser demo
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin delivered a 300-kilowatt laser to the Defense Department for integration into an Army high-energy laser demonstration. The laser is part of the Indirect Fires Protection Capability-High Energy Laser (IFPC-HEL) program, a key modernization priority for air and missile defense.
missiles.impact: The delivery of the 300-kilowatt laser represents a significant step towards demonstrating advanced directed energy systems for missile defense, enhancing the Army's capability to protect against indirect fire threats.

missiles.t: Raytheon's NSM missile selected for U.S. Navy LCS and FFG(X)
missiles.body: Raytheon’s Naval Strike Missile (NSM) has been selected by the U.S. Navy for the Littoral Combat Ship (LCS) and the Frigate (FFG(X)). The NSM is a joint venture with Kongsberg.
missiles.impact: The selection of NSM for LCS and FFG(X) positions it to replace the existing Harpoon missiles in the U.S. Navy’s inventory, potentially securing billions in contracts for Raytheon.

missiles.t: A-Darter missile successfully fired from Gripen fighter jet
missiles.body: Denel Dynamics successfully demonstrated the A-Darter air-to-air missile system by firing it from the South African Air Force's Gripen fighter jet in February 2012. This system is being developed in collaboration with Brazil.
missiles.impact: The successful firing of the A-Darter from the Gripen jet marks a significant milestone in the development of this advanced air-to-air missile system, enhancing South Africa's and Brazil's air defense capabilities.

missiles.t: Kongsberg secures $473.5m contract for JSM supply
missiles.body: Kongsberg has secured a $473.5m contract to supply its Joint Strike Missile (JSM) to an undisclosed sixth country. The JSM is designed for integration with fighter aircraft and can engage land and maritime targets.
missiles.impact: The contract expands JSM's international presence, highlighting its capability to operate in challenging scenarios and its advanced navigation and targeting systems.

missiles.t: Rafael and Lockheed Martin developing 100kW-class HELWS
missiles.body: Rafael and Lockheed Martin are developing a 100kW-class High Energy Laser Weapon System (HELWS) for ground-based air defence. Tests in the last year have proven the system’s operational capability.
missiles.impact: Iron Beam is expected to be the first operational system for ground-based air defence against rockets, mortars, and UAVs, offering a significant technological leap in defensive capabilities.

missiles.t: Thales and BDL exploring LMM integration
missiles.body: Thales UK and Bharat Dynamics Limited are exploring the integration of the Lightweight Multi-role Missile (LMM) on Indian platforms. The LMM is a 13 kg, Mach 1.5 missile with a range over 6 km.
missiles.impact: The LMM's precision and versatility, optimized for urban and maritime environments, could enhance India's air defense and precision strike capabilities.

missiles.t: Arrow Weapon System successfully intercepted ballistic threats
missiles.body: The Arrow Weapon System, including Arrow 2 and Arrow 3, successfully intercepted ballistic threats in space during a test. This system forms the top layer of Israel’s multi-layered air and missile defence array.
missiles.impact: The successful test enhances Israel’s operational capability to defend against current and future threats, particularly in the exo-atmospheric interception of ballistic missiles.

missiles.t: Thales launches RAPIDFire, a mobile air defence gun system
missiles.body: Thales unveiled RAPIDFire, a mobile air defence gun system at Eurosatory 2012. RAPIDFire integrates advanced radar and command systems to counter various air threats.
missiles.impact: RAPIDFire enhances air defence capabilities by providing a versatile and mobile solution to counter low-cost, high-volume threats like swarming drones and missiles.

missiles.t: AIM-424 Malice LRAAM developed for next-gen fighters
missiles.body: The U.S. Navy developed the AIM-424 Malice, a long-range air-to-air missile for future fighters. It exceeds the range and speed of the AIM-174B and retains maneuverability.
missiles.impact: The AIM-424 Malice sustains the U.S. military's first look, first shot, first kill advantage, enhancing fleet defense and tactical flexibility.

missiles.t: SEA SERPENT missile with RF seeker and data analysis system
missiles.body: SEA SERPENT is a missile with an RF seeker and sophisticated data analysis system, designed to operate in contested environments and overcome sophisticated countermeasures.
missiles.impact: SEA SERPENT's advanced capabilities make it a potent anti-ship and land attack weapon, offering significant advantages in terms of cost and performance.

missiles.t: ORBUS 1A motor met all pre-test performance requirements
missiles.body: The ORBUS 1A motor, developed by ATK for Lockheed Martin's BV+ program, successfully completed initial qualification testing ahead of schedule. The motor met all pre-test performance requirements during static testing at ATK’s Elkton facility.
missiles.impact: This milestone ensures the ORBUS 1A motor is ready for integration into the BV+ booster, advancing the Ground-based Midcourse Defense system's capability to intercept long-range ballistic missiles.

missiles.t: Raytheon-Northrop Grumman developing air-breathing hypersonic weapon
missiles.body: Raytheon-Northrop Grumman is developing an air-breathing hypersonic weapon that has completed ground testing and is set for flight testing soon. The weapon is designed for easy integration of sensors and guidance systems.
missiles.impact: This development represents a significant advancement in hypersonic technology, offering faster and less expensive manufacturing through 3D printing of the combustor, and positioning the US ahead in the hypersonic arms race.

missiles.t: Indian MoD test-fired 34th naval BrahMos missile
missiles.body: The Indian MoD successfully test-fired the 34th naval BrahMos missile, a supersonic cruise missile developed by BrahMos Aerospace. The missile, based on Russian technology, has a range of 290km and can fly as low as 10m above the ground.
missiles.impact: This test firing demonstrates the continued reliability and operational readiness of the BrahMos missile system for the Indian Navy, enhancing its maritime strike capabilities.

missiles.t: Saab demonstrated RBS-70 NG RWS with new Bolide missiles
missiles.body: Saab demonstrated the RBS-70 NG Remote Weapon Station (RWS) with new Bolide missiles at Eurosatory 2018. The system includes a triple launcher for laser-guided missiles and has been tested on IVECO LMV vehicles.
missiles.impact: The integration of new Bolide missiles with an 8 km range and high kill probability enhances the RBS-70 NG's effectiveness in short-range air defense.

missiles.t: India flight-tested 290km-range Brahmos cruise missile
missiles.body: India successfully flight-tested the Brahmos cruise missile from the ITR at Chandipur. The missile has a range of 290km and can fly at 2.8 times the speed of sound.
missiles.impact: The flight test demonstrates Brahmos's precision strike capability and its ability to engage ground targets from low altitudes, enhancing India's multi-platform missile capabilities.

missiles.t: Developing advanced Joint Strike Missile software
missiles.body: Morten, a Software Architect at KONGSBERG, is developing software for the Joint Strike Missile, which can recognize targets and avoid unintended damage.
missiles.impact: The advanced software enhances the missile's precision and safety, reducing collateral damage and improving mission success.

missiles.t: Saab conducted first live firing test of MSHORAD system
missiles.body: Saab conducted the first live firing test of its MSHORAD system, demonstrating its capabilities against drone and helicopter targets. The system was reconfigured to function as a portable firing unit.
missiles.impact: The successful live firing tests highlight Saab's ability to deliver a fully operable mobile air defence solution, including radar and command and control systems.

missiles.t: Developing smaller, hypersonic BrahMos variants
missiles.body: India and Russia are developing smaller and hypersonic variants of the BrahMos missile, including BrahMos-NG and BrahMos-II. BrahMos-NG is a lighter, more compact version weighing 1.2 to 1.5 tonnes, allowing fighter aircraft to carry multiple missiles.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the tactical flexibility and combat capability of Indian Armed Forces by enabling faster and more efficient deployment of missiles.

missiles.t: Raytheon completed a ballistic test for NGSRI
missiles.body: Raytheon successfully completed a ballistic test for the Next Generation Short Range Interceptor (NGSRI), demonstrating its ability to track drone targets and be fired from a man-portable launcher. The test was funded to demonstrate technical maturity and collect critical data.
missiles.impact: This test is significant as it showcases the technical readiness of NGSRI, a replacement for the Stinger® missile, and its capability to engage drone targets effectively.

missiles.t: BRAHMOS ALCM successfully flight-tested from Su-30MKI
missiles.body: The BRAHMOS ALCM was successfully flight-tested from an IAF Su-30MKI, marking its maiden test. The missile was gravity dropped and propelled towards a target in the Bay of Bengal.
missiles.impact: This test enhances the IAF's air combat operations by adding a powerful standoff capability, bolstering India's multi-platform missile deployment.

missiles.t: Developing dual-layer SAMP/T NG with VL MICA and ASTER missiles
missiles.body: EUROSAM is developing a dual-layer version of the SAMP/T NG system, integrating VL MICA and ASTER missiles to enhance air defence capabilities. The system aims to optimise the use of effectors and provide short-range air defence.
missiles.impact: This development will significantly enhance France's air defence capabilities by integrating short-range and medium-range missile systems, addressing the growing diversity of aerial threats.

missiles.t: Japan debuted a ground-launched hypersonic strike missile
missiles.body: The Japanese Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF) showcased a new ground-launched hypersonic strike missile at Fuji Firepower 2025. This system is a key element in enhancing Japan's defense capabilities.
missiles.impact: The demonstration of a ground-launched hypersonic strike missile marks a significant advancement in Japan's ability to respond to threats with precision and speed, enhancing its strategic deterrence.

missiles.t: Israel tested upgraded Arrow missile defense system
missiles.body: Israel tested an upgraded Arrow missile defense system, incorporating lessons from recent conflicts. The system, developed with U.S. cooperation, successfully intercepted multiple ballistic missile threats.
missiles.impact: This test enhances Israel's defense against evolving missile threats, reinforcing its multi-layered air and missile defense architecture.

missiles.t: BrahMos showcased at Defexpo 2016
missiles.body: BrahMos, a supersonic cruise missile, was showcased at Defexpo India 2016. It can be fitted on various platforms and has advanced capabilities.
missiles.impact: The demonstration highlights BrahMos's versatility and superior performance, enhancing its strategic importance for multiple military branches.

missiles.t: APKWSTM laser-guided rocket fired from ARH
missiles.body: BAE Systems successfully demonstrated the APKWSTM laser-guided rocket from an Airbus Tiger ARH. The system hit all 10 targets within one meter of the laser spot in various conditions.
missiles.impact: The successful trials confirm APKWSTM as a fully functioning capability, enhancing precision and mission success for the Australian Defence Force.

missiles.t: India conducted flight tests of BrahMos missile to validate life extension technologies
missiles.body: India successfully conducted flight tests of the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile to validate life extension technologies. The tests were aimed at saving replacement costs for missiles in the Indian Armed Forces inventory.
missiles.impact: The successful validation of life extension technologies for the BrahMos missile will reduce replacement costs and extend the operational life of existing missiles in the Indian Armed Forces inventory.

missiles.t: BrahMos Aerospace developed and tested aircraft launcher for BrahMos cruise missile
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace developed and tested an aircraft launcher for the BrahMos cruise missile, confirming its capability to strike maritime and land targets accurately. The launcher and related subsystems were successfully implemented and patented by the company.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the BrahMos missile's operational flexibility by enabling air-launched precision strikes, expanding its strategic utility.

missiles.t: M270 MLRS upgraded to fire ER GMLRS and PrSM
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin is upgrading M270 MLRS systems to fire the latest munitions like ER GMLRS and PrSM, enhancing their capability.
missiles.impact: This upgrade significantly extends the range and precision of the M270 MLRS, providing a substantial tactical advantage.

missiles.t: Anti-ship BRAHMOS missile successfully test-fired
missiles.body: The anti-ship version of the BRAHMOS missile was successfully test-fired by the Indian Navy and Andaman and Nicobar Command. This test demonstrates the missile's capability to engage maritime targets.
missiles.impact: The successful test highlights the missile's extended range and supersonic speed, enhancing India's maritime defense capabilities.

missiles.t: BrahMos developing sleeker, lighter missile system
missiles.body: BrahMos Aerospace is developing a new missile system that is sleeker, lighter, and more precise. The system is expected to be ready for demonstration trials within three years.
missiles.impact: This new missile system represents a significant advancement in the BrahMos program, enhancing its capabilities and precision, and solidifying the Indo-Russian collaboration.

missiles.t: Lockheed Martin awarded contract for 18 Tranche 3 Tracking Layer satellites
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin received a $1 billion contract from the Space Development Agency for 18 satellites to track missiles. These satellites will provide global, persistent tracking for hypersonic and advanced missile threats.
missiles.impact: The award underscores Lockheed Martin's role in developing advanced missile tracking capabilities, enhancing the U.S. Space Force's ability to detect and track missile threats in multiple orbits.

missiles.t: Northrop Grumman developing Stand-in Attack Weapon (SiAW) for Air Force
missiles.body: Northrop Grumman is developing the Stand-in Attack Weapon (SiAW) for the U.S. Air Force. The company will further develop the weapon, integrate it with platforms, and complete flight tests over the next 36 months.
missiles.impact: SiAW represents a significant step in digital weapons development for the Air Force, aligning with its priorities for rapid prototyping and digital engineering.

missiles.t: QuadStar seeker completed flight test
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin completed a flight test of the QuadStar seeker, demonstrating its ability to capture imagery, process signals, and maintain target tracking in flight. The test confirmed the performance of the Command Launch Assembly and the broader interceptor system.
missiles.impact: The successful test advances QuadStar as a potential next-generation short-range interceptor for the U.S. Army, offering advanced seeker technology and affordability.

missiles.t: LRASM completed initial fit checks on F-35
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin has completed initial fit checks for LRASM on the F-35. Integration efforts will continue through 2021.
missiles.impact: This development enhances the F-35's offensive capabilities by integrating LRASM, offering a longer range compared to JSM.

missiles.t: Indian Army test-fired 290-km range BrahMos missile
missiles.body: The Indian Army successfully test-fired the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile with a range of 290 km. The test was conducted to operationalize the second regiment of the missile system.
missiles.impact: The successful test firing marks the operational deployment of the second BrahMos regiment, enhancing the Indian Army's strategic surface-to-surface missile capabilities.

missiles.t: LRASM successfully test-launched from surface platforms
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated the successful test-launch of LRASM from surface platforms. The missile is designed to replace ageing Harpoon anti-ship missiles on various classes of ships.
missiles.impact: This development enhances naval combat capabilities by providing advanced targeting and engagement technologies that reduce dependence on external intelligence and navigation systems.

missiles.t: Demonstrated in-flight target updates to GMLRS
missiles.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated real-time target updates to a Guided Multiple Launch Rocket System (GMLRS) during a captive carry test, enhancing missile performance and flexibility.
missiles.impact: This capability improves precision and agility in offensive strikes against moving targets in contested environments, advancing the U.S. Army's Joint Fires vision.

missiles.t: Raytheon integrates 3D gamer-style interface into Patriot PDB 8.1
missiles.body: Raytheon is developing a 3D-based gamer-style interface called WMI for the Patriot air and missile defence system's PDB 8.1 upgrade. This interface simplifies complex data with 3D visuals and easy-to-read status pages.
missiles.impact: The WMI interface improves reaction time and reduces errors, enhancing the operational effectiveness of the Patriot system for its users.

missiles.t: Co-development of new SHORAD missiles and capabilities
missiles.body: Rheinmetall and LIG D&A are co-developing new missiles and capabilities for short-range air defence to address current market gaps. This partnership aims to provide comprehensive air defence solutions.
missiles.impact: The collaboration enhances both companies' ability to offer advanced, interoperable SHORAD solutions, strengthening their competitive edge in the European and NATO markets.

missiles.t: Japan's Type 88 SSM conducted first live-fire deployment
missiles.body: Japan's Type 88 SSM was deployed in the Philippines for the first live-fire exercise since World War II, striking a target within six minutes of launch.
missiles.impact: This exercise marks a significant milestone in Japan's security policy, showcasing the Type 88's capability in rapid deployment and precision against maritime threats.

naval.t: Thales AAW system demonstrated in live firing
naval.body: Thales AAW system, used by the Netherlands and German navies, was demonstrated in live firing exercises. The system includes APAR radar with ICWI technology for guiding multiple missiles.
naval.impact: The system's capabilities in air defence, leveraging SM2 and ESSM missiles, enhance naval protection and interoperability between European and US forces.

naval.t: Seagull USV demonstrated ASW mission
naval.body: Seagull, a multi-mission USV by Elbit Systems, demonstrated a live ASW mission, performing real-time detection and classification of objects.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights Seagull's capability to deter and dissuade hostile subsurface activity, enhancing maritime security and surveillance.

naval.t: Larsen & Toubro launches lead OPV for Indian Coast Guard
naval.body: Larsen & Toubro launched the lead Offshore Patrol Vessel (OPV) named Vikram for the Indian Coast Guard. The OPV is part of a series of seven vessels entirely designed in-house and built in a record time frame.
naval.impact: The launch of Vikram marks a significant milestone for Larsen & Toubro, showcasing its capability to design and build complex naval vessels for the Indian Coast Guard efficiently.

naval.t: Lockheed Martin delivered HELIOS laser weapon system
naval.body: Lockheed Martin delivered the HELIOS laser weapon system to the U.S. Navy, marking the first operational deployment of a laser weapon system. The system met the 60 kW power requirement and completed critical design and factory qualification tests.
naval.impact: The HELIOS system represents a significant advancement in naval defense technology, providing a new capability for directed energy weapons to counter asymmetric threats.

naval.t: Bluefin-9 AUV unveiled for subsurface data collection
naval.body: General Dynamics unveiled the Bluefin-9 AUV at Oceans 2018 for detailed subsurface data collection. It is portable and can be deployed from various platforms.
naval.impact: The Bluefin-9 enhances naval capabilities for inshore surveys, hydrographic mapping, and mine countermeasures, providing versatile and detailed subsurface data.

naval.t: New L-Band active phased array radar installed on HMAS Anzac
naval.body: BAE Systems Australia installed a new L-Band active phased array radar on HMAS Anzac as part of its mid-life upgrade. The new radar system replaces the previous AN/SPS-49(V)8 radar system.
naval.impact: The installation of the new radar system enhances HMAS Anzac's operational capabilities, providing world-leading performance that supports future naval requirements.

naval.t: Naval Laser Demonstrator completed sea trials
naval.body: The Naval Laser Demonstrator completed over a year of sea trials, traveling 28,000 nautical miles and firing over 1,000 shots at various targets. It has been tested in adverse weather conditions and is set to complement existing naval defense systems.
naval.impact: The successful trials of the Naval Laser Demonstrator indicate a significant advancement in naval defense technology, providing enhanced protection against drones and other threats. This system is expected to strengthen the German Navy's defense capabilities.

naval.t: contract for naval laser weapon demonstrator
naval.body: Rheinmetall and MBDA won a contract to develop a naval laser weapon demonstrator for the German Navy. The demonstrator will test the interaction of sensors, combat management systems, and effectors under realistic conditions.
naval.impact: This project represents a significant advancement in European laser weapon development, leveraging experience from previous prototype tests to enhance naval defense capabilities.

naval.t: MBDA Deutschland tested high energy laser weapon
naval.body: MBDA Deutschland has developed and tested a high energy laser weapon demonstrator since 2008, targeting various threats including maneuvering mini drones. Trials are planned for the German Navy frigate F-124 Sachsen in 2022.
naval.impact: This development addresses the emerging threat of mini drones disrupting high-profile events and critical infrastructure, providing a precise and scalable solution.

naval.t: Saab successfully fired SLWT from surface and submarine
naval.body: Saab conducted successful firings of the Saab Lightweight Torpedo (SLWT) from a corvette and submarine, verifying safe launch and integration on the vessels.
naval.impact: This milestone ensures the SLWT can effectively deter and destroy threats, enhancing naval capabilities for Sweden and Finland.

naval.t: Squire Seaglider drone demonstrated operational readiness
naval.body: REGENT demonstrated the Squire Seaglider drone's operational readiness at Silent Swarm, showcasing its autonomous capabilities and performance in a relevant setting.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights the rapid development and deployment of critical naval surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities, aligning with urgent warfighter needs.

naval.t: Leonardo showcases CMS ATHENA MK2 at IMDEX Asia
naval.body: Leonardo is showcasing the Combat Management System (CMS) ATHENA MK2 at IMDEX Asia, which is already fielded in the Italian Navy’s new offshore multi-purpose patrol vessels. The CMS provides comprehensive situational awareness and mission planning capabilities.
naval.impact: The CMS ATHENA MK2 enhances naval operational effectiveness by providing advanced situational awareness and mission execution capabilities, critical for modern naval warfare.

naval.t: Thales UK to develop sonar and periscope for Dreadnought SSBNs
naval.body: Thales UK is developing sonar and periscope systems for the Royal Navy's Dreadnought submarines. The sonar and periscope will enhance the submarines' stealth and detection capabilities.
naval.impact: The advanced sonar and periscope systems will ensure the Dreadnought submarines maintain a strategic advantage, crucial for the UK's nuclear deterrent.

naval.t: Thales developed AirMaster C radar
naval.body: Thales has developed the AirMaster C, an ultra-compact radar with enhanced target detection capabilities. It is designed for fixed-wing aircraft, helicopters, and UAVs, and is currently undergoing preliminary integration studies for the Guépard helicopter.
naval.impact: The AirMaster C radar's compact design and advanced capabilities make it suitable for a wide range of surveillance missions, enhancing situational awareness for naval and military operations.

naval.t: Greyshark AUV integrated into Rheinmetall's Battlesuite
naval.body: Euroatlas' Greyshark AUV, a large, long-endurance multimission vehicle, is being integrated into Rheinmetall's Battlesuite platform. Greyshark is equipped with 17 sensors and AI software, and two prototypes are under development.
naval.impact: This integration enhances Greyshark's operational flexibility and interoperability within networked military systems, advancing naval surveillance and warfare capabilities.

naval.t: 40mm RapidFire naval air defense system final design released
naval.body: Nexter Systems and Thales have finalized the design of the 40mm RapidFire naval air defense system, which is designed to protect ships, land units, and bases against a wide range of threats, including drones. The system is expected to be delivered to the French Navy in the coming months.
naval.impact: The RapidFire system represents a significant advancement in anti-drone and low-layer ground-to-air defense capabilities for naval vessels, enhancing the French Navy's ability to protect against modern threats.

naval.t: Thales and MHI developed a dual frequency sonar demonstrator
naval.body: Thales and MHI developed a dual frequency sonar demonstrator for mine countermeasures aboard an Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV). The demonstrator integrates Thales's High Frequency synthetic aperture sonar (SAMDIS) and MHI's Low Frequency synthetic aperture sonar.
naval.impact: The dual frequency sonar technology enhances the detection, classification, and localization of various types of mines, providing a unique autonomous mine countermeasure system for naval operations.

naval.t: KONGSBERG unveils Aegir SSA sonar system
naval.body: KONGSBERG unveiled the Aegir SSA sonar system at ONS 2026, featuring high-performance acoustic technology and AI-powered virtual operator service. The system is designed for port and coastal security, offering scalable deployment and simplified integration.
naval.impact: The Aegir SSA enhances situational awareness in critical maritime environments, reducing risks associated with conventional monitoring systems and enabling autonomous operation.

naval.t: naval laser weapon system demonstrated operational capabilities
naval.body: ARGE HEL demonstrated a naval laser weapon system's operational capabilities across various sea conditions and target types. The system is set to be operational by 2029.
naval.impact: This development showcases advanced technological maturity and effectiveness in maritime defense, securing national sovereignty in critical defense technology.

naval.t: GRSE expands shipbuilding and repair capabilities
naval.body: GRSE is expanding its shipbuilding and repair capabilities with new facilities and agreements, including a major shipbuilding hub at Raichak and rejuvenation of the Timber Pond facility.
naval.impact: The expansion will enhance GRSE's capacity to construct and repair warships and commercial vessels, contributing to India's naval defense and maritime industry.

naval.t: Developed Maritime C5ISR Suite
naval.body: Elbit Systems developed the Maritime C5ISR Suite, integrating secure communications, command-and-control, and autonomous systems to enhance maritime security. The suite includes the TORCH-X command-and-control platform and E-LynX software-defined radio, designed to operate under cyberattacks.
naval.impact: The suite significantly enhances naval vessels' ability to detect and respond to cyber threats, ensuring continuous operation of critical systems and improving situational awareness against illicit activities.

naval.t: BAE Systems unveiled a shiplift and land-level repair complex
naval.body: BAE Systems unveiled a shiplift and land-level repair complex in Jacksonville, capable of lifting ships displacing up to 25,000 tons. The facility supports maintenance and repair of Mayport-based Navy vessels and commercial ships.
naval.impact: The new complex significantly enhances BAE Systems' ship repair capabilities, supporting the U.S. Navy and commercial maritime operations in the region.

naval.t: NCSIST develops radar for new frigates
naval.body: NCSIST is developing radar for new frigates in Taiwan's naval modernization plan. The plan includes constructing various naval vessels and allocating significant funds.
naval.impact: This development is crucial for enhancing Taiwan's naval capabilities, addressing the need for modern radar systems in its fleet.

naval.t: Thales develops modular sonar for uncrewed ASW
naval.body: Thales has developed a modular sonar system for uncrewed anti-submarine warfare. The Sonar 76Nano prototype is designed for rapid deployment and uncrewed operations.
naval.impact: This modular sonar system addresses the growing need for flexible and rapid deployment in anti-submarine warfare, enhancing naval capabilities against evolving threats.

naval.t: Raytheon demonstrated Barracuda's autonomous mine neutralization
naval.body: Raytheon demonstrated the Barracuda mine neutralizer's autonomous capabilities, including navigation, communication, and target detection. The system is set for initial operational capability and low-rate production by 2030.
naval.impact: The demonstration marks a significant advancement in mine countermeasure technology, enhancing safety and efficiency for naval operations by reducing direct sailor involvement in hazardous tasks.

naval.t: Sea Fire radar qualified after 18 months of land-based tests
naval.body: The Sea Fire radar has been qualified after extensive land-based testing over 18 months. It is now ready for integration on French naval combat management systems.
naval.impact: The qualification of Sea Fire enhances France's naval surveillance capabilities, providing advanced detection and tracking of both air and surface targets.

naval.t: AWHero achieved basic military certification
naval.body: Leonardo's AWHero rotary wing unmanned system recently achieved basic military certification, making it viable for unmanned surveillance at sea. This system is on display at DIMDEX 2022.
naval.impact: The certification of AWHero enhances Leonardo's capability to offer advanced unmanned surveillance solutions, crucial for maritime security in the Middle East.

naval.t: KONGSBERG developed PROTEUS ASW and Sonar Trainer
naval.body: KONGSBERG developed the PROTEUS ASW and Sonar Trainer for high-fidelity training of sonar operators on various ASW platforms. It includes multiple sonar types and tools for comprehensive training.
naval.impact: PROTEUS enhances the operational readiness of naval ASW units by providing realistic training scenarios, improving detection and response capabilities.

naval.t: Rheinmetall develops ASTERIA multi-purpose underwater mines
naval.body: Rheinmetall is developing ASTERIA, a new generation of multi-purpose underwater mines. These mines can be deployed from various platforms including surface ships, transport aircraft, and submarines.
naval.impact: ASTERIA enhances naval defense capabilities by providing flexible and adaptable mine solutions to meet current operational requirements.

naval.t: HADALUS demonstrated undersea launch capabilities
naval.body: HADALUS, a low-cost, long-endurance UUV, successfully demonstrated undersea launch capabilities during a U.S. Navy exercise. This marks the first time the U.S. Navy has seen this integrated capability in the water.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights the potential for a single unmanned undersea platform to perform detect, recon, and launch missions, advancing autonomous undersea capabilities.

naval.t: KONGSBERG developed PROTEUS Submarine CTT
naval.body: KONGSBERG developed the PROTEUS Submarine CTT, which provides a realistic training environment for submarine command teams. The system can be linked to other simulators and is tailored to specific submarine classes.
naval.impact: The PROTEUS Submarine CTT enhances the operational readiness of submarine crews by allowing them to effectively use combat management systems and other onboard equipment in a realistic setting.

naval.t: AI enhances TALIOS nacelle for faster target detection
naval.body: Thales announced the AI integration into the TALIOS nacelle, which will significantly enhance its target detection speed. The AI will analyze images in real-time, providing target positions 100 times faster than manual search.
naval.impact: This advancement will greatly improve the efficiency and responsiveness of TALIOS in identifying and tracking mobile targets, enhancing overall combat effectiveness.

naval.t: Elbit Systems unveils a vision suite for military helicopters
naval.body: Elbit Systems has developed a vision suite for military helicopters that integrates advanced sensors, AI, and HMD to provide real-time, clear, colored wide field of view in degraded visibility conditions. This suite significantly expands operational capabilities by enabling low-altitude flights in challenging weather.
naval.impact: The suite transforms extreme weather conditions into an operational advantage, enhancing mission flexibility and safety for military helicopters.

naval.t: Thales developed a new acoustic buoy, SonoFlash
naval.body: Thales has developed a new acoustic buoy called SonoFlash for anti-submarine warfare. It can be deployed by various aircraft and ships, including drones.
naval.impact: SonoFlash enhances the detection and tracking capabilities against submarines, providing a strategic advantage in anti-submarine warfare.

naval.t: Kongsberg's C-Scope system distinguishes divers from marine life
naval.body: Kongsberg's C-Scope system, an integrated underwater surveillance solution, uses advanced sonar technology to distinguish divers and diver delivery vehicles from marine life like seals, sharks, and dolphins. The system includes active and passive sonars, software for sensor fusion, and countermeasures.
naval.impact: This capability is crucial for enhancing security at ports like Long Beach while minimizing harm to marine life, showcasing Kongsberg's expertise in shallow water surveillance.

naval.t: Rheinmetall received order to equip Halifax-class frigates with MASS missile avoidance system
naval.body: Rheinmetall Canada has received an order to equip the Halifax-class frigates of the Royal Canadian Navy with the MASS missile avoidance system. The system is designed to be fully automated and can be integrated into any naval command and control system.
naval.impact: The integration of MASS into the Halifax-class frigates enhances the Royal Canadian Navy's defensive capabilities by providing automated missile avoidance, reducing the need for ship maneuvering and improving tactical and logistical efficiency.

naval.t: Raytheon's SPY-6 radar reaches milestone
naval.body: Raytheon's SPY-6 radar program reached a significant milestone at SNA 2016, showcasing the radar on a DDG 51 scale model. The radar was designed, built, and transitioned to test within two years.
naval.impact: The rapid development and testing of SPY-6 demonstrate significant progress in naval radar technology, enhancing air and missile defense capabilities for the U.S. Navy's DDG 51 Flight III destroyers.

naval.t: NCSIST to co-produce Anduril AUVs for Taiwan
naval.body: NCSIST plans to co-produce Anduril's Dive-LD AUV for Taiwan, customizing it with multibeam scan capabilities. The Dive-LD can conduct ISR missions and remain submerged for 10 days.
naval.impact: This collaboration enhances Taiwan's underwater surveillance and mine detection capabilities, strengthening its maritime security.

naval.t: Rheinmetall to test laser source demonstrator on German Navy frigate
naval.body: Rheinmetall is set to conduct a yearlong trial of a laser source demonstrator on the German Navy frigate Sachsen. The demonstrator, based on spectral coupling technology, aims to study the practical use of lasers in military applications.
naval.impact: This trial represents a significant step towards the practical application of laser weapon systems in naval warfare, offering potential advantages in terms of complexity and modularity over other technologies.

naval.t: Leonardo's LIONFISH® Top 12.7mm turret selected by Royal Netherlands Navy
naval.body: Leonardo's LIONFISH® Top 12.7mm remotely-controlled naval turret was selected by the Royal Netherlands Navy for its Holland-class patrol vessels, LPD, and JSS units. The LIONFISH® Top weighs less than 300 kg and is effective against close threats and in asymmetric scenarios.
naval.impact: The selection of LIONFISH® Top by the Royal Netherlands Navy highlights its effectiveness and accuracy, especially in handling close threats and asymmetric warfare scenarios, positioning it as a reliable and advanced naval defence system.

naval.t: Lockheed Martin's AN/SPY-7(V)1 radar system reached TRL 7
naval.body: Lockheed Martin's AN/SPY-7(V)1 radar system for Aegis Ashore Japan reached TRL 7, indicating detailed testing and system maturity. The system uses GaN-based subarray radar building blocks and is scalable for future radar programs.
naval.impact: The SPY-7 radar's advanced capabilities in detecting and tracking air and missile threats will enhance the Aegis Ashore defense system and future naval radar programs, such as those for Canada's Surface Combatant ships.

naval.t: MQ-9B SeaGuardian to integrate Leonardo Seaspray 7500E V2 AESA radar
naval.body: GA-ASI's MQ-9B SeaGuardian will integrate Leonardo's Seaspray 7500E V2 AESA radar, enhancing maritime ISR capabilities. The integration will enable persistent surveillance and detection of maritime contacts.
naval.impact: This integration significantly enhances SeaGuardian's maritime surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities, providing persistent monitoring and intelligence gathering over wide areas.

naval.t: Thales upgrades Collins submarine simulator with C2000-X tech
naval.body: Thales Australia completed an upgrade to the Collins submarine simulator, incorporating C2000-X technology and new interfaces for ship components, ensuring high reliability and minimal downtime.
naval.impact: The upgrade enhances training standards for Australian submarine crews, providing advanced simulation capabilities and improved instructor facilities.

naval.t: Saab produces AUV62-MR mine reconnaissance system
naval.body: Saab produces the AUV62-MR, a mine reconnaissance system for maritime surveillance. It is designed to be modular, hydro-dynamically stable, and cost-effective for MCM operations.
naval.impact: The AUV62-MR offers high flexibility and low lifecycle costs, making it an ideal solution for naval forces to enhance their mine countermeasures capabilities.

naval.t: Seagull™ USV demonstrated autonomous ASW utility
naval.body: Elbit Systems UK's Seagull™ USV completed ASW trials with the UK MoD, showcasing autonomous ASW capabilities. The trials used the Progeny Framework to explore future ASW operations.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights the Seagull™ USV's potential to enhance naval ASW operations through autonomous technology, providing a tactical advantage against submarines.

naval.t: Saab's Double Eagle SAROV for MCM missions
naval.body: Saab's Double Eagle SAROV was contracted to the Kuwait Naval Force through the U.S. Navy's FMS program. The system functions as both an AUV and ROV, adept at mine detection, classification, identification, and disposal.
naval.impact: This procurement enhances Kuwait's naval operational capabilities, underscoring Saab's role in submarine technology innovation.

naval.t: track exchange demonstration for Aegis integration
naval.body: Lockheed Martin and Navantia Sistemas conducted a track exchange demonstration for the F-110 Bonifaz Class Frigate's Aegis integration. The demonstration was part of ongoing efforts to mature the interface between the two systems.
naval.impact: This demonstration marks a significant step towards the export and installation of the F-110 IAFCL computer program, enhancing the frigate's anti-submarine and anti-air capabilities.

naval.t: Blue Sentry system with autonomous detection and covert communication
naval.body: Thales and Ocius have developed the Blue Sentry system, which uses autonomous detection and long-range low frequency underwater communications for covert communication. The system is designed to be deployed in the Exclusive Economic Zone for maritime surveillance.
naval.impact: The Blue Sentry system represents a significant advancement in maritime surveillance, offering enhanced covert communication and autonomous detection capabilities, making it the quietest and most capable persistent USV platform.

naval.t: Saab develops naval Integrated Communication System (ICS) range
naval.body: Saab develops naval Integrated Communication System (ICS) range for vessels, including the Victory-class MRCVs for Singapore Navy. The ICS 2000 is an economical and flexible digital-communication system integrating voice and data-communication equipment.
naval.impact: The ICS 2000 system enhances naval communication efficiency and survivability, supporting advanced military operations and information management.

naval.t: Hanwha Systems developing ASWUUV with fuel cell and sonar
naval.body: Hanwha Systems is developing an ASWUUV with a fuel cell system and active sonar for anti-submarine missions. It is set to start sea trials in mid-2020.
naval.impact: The ASWUUV's long-range and endurance capabilities enhance South Korea's anti-submarine warfare, potentially improving maritime security and surveillance.

naval.t: Navy seeks two CCA prototypes for carrier-based combat drones
naval.body: The US Navy is developing two prototypes of carrier-based collaborative combat aircraft (CCA) to demonstrate extended range and payload capacity. These drones aim to integrate with existing carrier infrastructure and perform missions in contested skies.
naval.impact: The CCA project seeks to reduce the high costs and extended timelines associated with replacing manned platforms, enhancing the Navy's operational flexibility and resilience.

naval.t: Legion Pod completed integration and flight tests
naval.body: Legion Pod, a multi-function sensor system, has completed integration and flight tests on F-16 and F-15C aircraft. It successfully demonstrated detection and tracking capabilities in radar-denied environments.
naval.impact: The Legion Pod's ability to operate in radar-denied environments enhances situational awareness and collaborative targeting for fixed-wing aircraft, providing a significant tactical advantage.

naval.t: ARI demonstrates Bridge Operations Simulator
naval.body: ARI demonstrated the Bridge Operations Simulator for the Indian Navy, which replicates various hydrological conditions and geographical structures. The simulator integrates VR, AR, and AI technologies to meet operational training requirements.
naval.impact: The demonstration of the Bridge Operations Simulator enhances naval training capabilities by providing realistic and customizable training scenarios, improving operational readiness.

naval.t: Thales and CS GROUP demonstrated a cybersecure, jam-resistant navigation system
naval.body: Thales and CS GROUP demonstrated a cybersecure, jam-resistant navigation system on a Navy vessel. The system integrates Thales's TopAxyz inertial navigation unit with CS GROUP’s real-time computer, offering enhanced navigation and cybersecurity.
naval.impact: This system significantly enhances maritime navigation security by providing resilience against cyber and jamming attacks, ensuring safer and more reliable operations for naval vessels.

naval.t: AR integration on naval ship bridges demonstrated
naval.body: BAE Systems has made significant progress in developing AR technology for naval ship bridges, working closely with end users to meet customer expectations. Engineers are exploring the integration of AR onto naval ship bridges to enhance safety and operational efficiency.
naval.impact: The integration of AR on naval ship bridges can significantly improve situational awareness and operational efficiency for naval officers, enhancing overall safety and effectiveness of naval operations.

naval.t: KSOT autonomous submarine developed
naval.body: PT PAL developed KSOT, an autonomous submarine, which the Indonesian Navy is fielding for evaluation. KSOT aims to offset better-equipped adversaries through scale, ambiguity, and cost imposition.
naval.impact: KSOT represents a significant step in unconventional naval warfare, leveraging recent technological advances to develop autonomous systems that are necessary for asymmetric deterrence.

naval.t: Thales develops HF XL wideband HF technology
naval.body: Thales is developing HF XL, a wideband HF communications technology for naval use, in cooperation with the French DGA. The technology leverages US and NATO standards to increase bandwidth.
naval.impact: HF XL enhances naval communications by increasing bandwidth, enabling more efficient ship-to-shore and flagship-to-flagship communications, and potentially aligning allied navies with US standards.

naval.t: Rheinmetall unveils GMF 140 multi-mission naval combatant
naval.body: Rheinmetall has unveiled the GMF 140, a multi-mission naval combatant designed for blue-water operations and flexible mission support. The GMF 140 includes advanced anti-submarine warfare capabilities and can integrate with various combat management systems.
naval.impact: The GMF 140 represents a significant advancement in naval combat capabilities, offering enhanced flexibility and interoperability for modern naval missions.

naval.t: KONGSBERG provided an integrated underwater surveillance system
naval.body: KONGSBERG has deployed an integrated underwater surveillance system at the Port of Long Beach since June 2010, demonstrating its capability to monitor underwater movements.
naval.impact: The system's ability to classify objects in water and handle complex data processing is significant for maritime security and surveillance.

naval.t: Rheinmetall and MBDA develop laser demonstrator for German Navy corvette
naval.body: Rheinmetall and MBDA Deutschland are developing a high-energy laser demonstrator for the German Navy's corvette K130. The demonstrator will be tested under quasi-operational conditions to investigate the laser's capabilities.
naval.impact: This project marks a significant step in integrating advanced laser technology into naval defense systems, enhancing precision and reducing collateral damage.

naval.t: Ivory Coast receives two Chinese motorboats
naval.body: Ivory Coast has received two motorboats from China to enhance maritime security. The vessels were officially commissioned during a ceremony presided over by the Vice Prime Minister and Minister of Defense.
naval.impact: The donation strengthens China's strategic partnership with Ivory Coast and aids in combating maritime challenges such as piracy.

naval.t: IAI demonstrated BlueWhale, an autonomous submarine
naval.body: IAI demonstrated BlueWhale, an autonomous submarine at the 2023 Naval Technology Excellence Awards. BlueWhale is equipped with sophisticated sensors for detecting submarines and mapping naval mines.
naval.impact: BlueWhale represents a significant advancement in unmanned naval technology, offering reduced costs and maintenance while performing covert intelligence-gathering and other submarine tasks.

naval.t: Saab unveiled Sea Wasp ROV for IED neutralisation
naval.body: Saab unveiled the Sea Wasp, a remotely operated vehicle designed to identify, relocate, and neutralise IEDs in underwater and confined areas. It features a sensor suite including sonar, LED lights, and a pan-tilt camera.
naval.impact: The Sea Wasp provides a cost-effective and safe solution for naval and harbour security, enhancing the ability to neutralise underwater threats.

naval.t: Elbit unveiled Seagull USV for ASW and MCM
naval.body: Elbit Systems unveiled the Seagull prototype, a USV for ASW and MCM missions. It can operate for four days and cover up to 100 km, complementing or replacing manned vessels.
naval.impact: Seagull changes ASW dynamics by offering an unmanned, cost-effective solution that reduces operational risks and complements existing naval assets.

naval.t: Rheinmetall starts Australian assembly of MASS shipsets
naval.body: Rheinmetall Defence Australia has begun assembling MASS shipsets in Australia for the Royal Australian Navy. The system autonomously deploys countermeasures to generate decoys that divert incoming missiles.
naval.impact: MASS's unique capabilities, demonstrated through extensive trials, position it as a critical technology for protecting naval vessels against missile threats.

naval.t: Elbit developing helicopter-transported high-energy laser system
naval.body: Elbit Systems is developing a helicopter-transported high-energy laser system for the Israeli Defense Ministry. The system is expected to be operational soon and has generated interest from Europe and other regions.
naval.impact: The development of a helicopter-transported high-energy laser system could enhance aerial defense capabilities, providing a mobile and flexible solution for countering threats.

naval.t: Rheinmetall demonstrated GMF 140 guided missile frigate
naval.body: Rheinmetall introduced the GMF 140 guided missile frigate, designed to meet modern naval warfare needs and integrate advanced capabilities. The GMF 140 is optimized for open-sea operations and supports a range of missions with its multi-domain warfare platform design.
naval.impact: The GMF 140 aims to set new standards in engagement power and mission flexibility, addressing the most challenging threat environments with advanced missile defense and anti-submarine warfare capabilities.

naval.t: HII's Watcher ROMULUS-25 USVs passed critical DoW test
naval.body: HII's Watcher ROMULUS-25 USVs successfully completed a critical DoW test, demonstrating their readiness for operational use. The USVs, developed in partnership with MetalCraft Marine, are designed for the U.S. Marine Corps and feature HII’s Odyssey ACS for autonomous operations.
naval.impact: The successful test positions the Watcher ROMULUS-25 for potential transition to production, addressing the Navy's need for autonomous surface vessel interceptors.

naval.t: BAE Systems developed an unmanned boat with 10-day patrol capability
naval.body: BAE Systems has developed an unmanned boat that can operate for up to 10 days at patrol speed or travel 300 nautical miles in pursuit mode. The vessel can be remotely controlled or operate semi-autonomously.
naval.impact: This technology enhances maritime security by enabling persistent surveillance and anti-piracy operations without endangering sailors.

naval.t: Seagull USV successfully launched light weight torpedoes
naval.body: Elbit Systems' Seagull USV completed torpedo launch trials, demonstrating its capability to install and launch light weight torpedoes. This test highlights Seagull's modular mission system for ASW configurations.
naval.impact: The successful trial positions Seagull as a unique unmanned platform for ASW and mine countermeasures, offering capabilities previously exclusive to manned vehicles.

naval.t: Saab developing new lightweight torpedo system
naval.body: Saab is developing a new lightweight torpedo system for the Baltic Sea, featuring advanced propulsion and guidance systems. The system is designed to operate in complex and challenging marine environments.
naval.impact: The new torpedo system addresses the need for sophisticated naval defence in low-conflict scenarios with civilian traffic, offering enhanced capabilities in target indication and navigation.

naval.t: HELIOS system undergoes CDR
naval.body: The HELIOS system, a high-energy laser weapon, underwent a Critical Design Review. It will be integrated onto an Arleigh Burke destroyer and tested at Wallops Island.
naval.impact: The CDR reduces programme risk and advances the US Navy's goal of fielding laser weapon systems on surface ships.

naval.t: BAE Systems introduces ASF concept with autonomous systems
naval.body: BAE Systems introduced the Adaptable Strike Frigate (ASF) concept at Euronaval, focusing on modularity and autonomous systems. The ASF is designed to operate independently or as part of a littoral response group.
naval.impact: The ASF's modular design and integration of autonomous systems aim to enhance flexibility and adaptability in naval operations, addressing evolving threat environments.

naval.t: Saab demonstrated AUV62-AT ASW training system
naval.body: Saab and QinetiQ demonstrated the AUV62-AT ASW training system in multiple scenarios for the Royal Navy. The system is designed to provide realistic submarine noise and echo generation for ASW operator training.
naval.impact: The AUV62-AT offers a cost-effective solution for ASW training, eliminating the need for live submarine engagement, thus enhancing training efficiency and safety.

naval.t: MQ-8C drone first flight with AN/ZPY-8 radar
naval.body: The MQ-8C drone completed its first flight with the AN/ZPY-8 radar, enhancing detection and tracking capabilities. The radar is an AESA system from Leonardo, extending ranges and meeting Navy requirements.
naval.impact: The integration of the AN/ZPY-8 radar significantly boosts the MQ-8C's surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities, supporting the U.S. Navy's intelligence needs.

naval.t: SEARCHMASTER® radar with advanced detection modes demonstrated
naval.body: Thales demonstrated the SEARCHMASTER® radar on the French Navy's Falcon 2000LXS ALBATROS aircraft. The radar provides simultaneous short-range and long-range detection, high-resolution imaging, and advanced target detection modes.
naval.impact: SEARCHMASTER® significantly enhances the ALBATROS's operational performance and tactical situation awareness, making it a critical asset for maritime surveillance and intervention missions.

naval.t: Raytheon demonstrates layered naval defence system
naval.body: Raytheon demonstrated a layered naval defence system in a video, showcasing detection and engagement of pirate threats in the EEZ and Blue Water domains using OPVs and UASs.
naval.impact: The system highlights the capability to protect critical maritime assets and ensure safe trade through comprehensive surveillance and rapid response.

naval.t: successful field testing of a high-energy laser
naval.body: Australia successfully field-tested a high-energy laser, marking a significant milestone in naval defense technology. The test was conducted on home soil, demonstrating the system's readiness for deployment.
naval.impact: The successful testing of the high-energy laser represents a significant advancement in Australia's naval defense capabilities, providing a new tool for maritime security and defense against asymmetric threats.

naval.t: AN/SPN-50(V)1 radar demonstrated in 2019
naval.body: The AN/SPN-50(V)1 radar was demonstrated in October 2019, offering improved target detection and tracking. It is set to replace the AN/SPN-43C radar system.
naval.impact: The new radar system enhances naval capabilities by addressing spectrum constraints and improving performance in cluttered environments.

naval.t: ANZAC frigate systems upgrade project completed CDR
naval.body: Lockheed Martin Canada completed the critical design review for the ANZAC frigate systems upgrade project, allowing detailed design and installation to proceed.
naval.impact: This milestone ensures the timely and effective upgrade of New Zealand’s ANZAC class ships, enhancing their combat capabilities.

naval.t: Raytheon tests hot fire rocket motor for MAD-FIRES system
naval.body: Raytheon has conducted a hot fire test of a rocket motor for the MAD-FIRES system, designed to protect naval vessels from anti-ship missiles and other threats. The system aims to integrate the speed and rapid fire of gun systems with the precision of guided missiles.
naval.impact: The successful test demonstrates progress towards an advanced naval defence system that can provide real-time protection against evolving threats, enhancing the US Navy's capability to defend against simultaneous and diverse attacks.

naval.t: Spanish Navy selects Leonardo's 127mm LW Vulcano gun for F-110 frigates
naval.body: Leonardo's 127mm LW Vulcano gun was selected by the Spanish Navy for the F-110 frigates, marking the third European country to adopt this advanced naval gun system.
naval.impact: This selection underscores the 127mm LW Vulcano gun's capability and reliability, solidifying its position in modern naval warfare.

naval.t: Anduril completed longest XL-AUV test
naval.body: Anduril completed the longest demonstration test of its XL-AUV, traveling over 42,355 kilometers. This test was part of the CAMP program to address operational gaps under the sea.
naval.impact: This milestone showcases Anduril's capability to perform long-range, autonomous underwater operations, expanding operational access and continuous combat environment support.

naval.t: Ghost Commander II concept ship with UAV hangars and catapults
naval.body: Hanwha Ocean debuted the Ghost Commander II concept ship at MADEX 2025, featuring dedicated hangars and catapults for fixed-wing UAVs. The concept showcases advanced naval capabilities without being tied to a specific programme.
naval.impact: The Ghost Commander II highlights Hanwha Ocean's capability to integrate UAV systems into naval vessels, enhancing surveillance and strike capabilities for future amphibious assault operations.

naval.t: Thales develops autonomous passive hull-mounted sonar for Naval Group's XL-UUV
naval.body: Thales is developing an autonomous passive hull-mounted sonar for Naval Group's large unmanned underwater vehicle (XL-UUV). The sonar will provide autonomous detection, classification, and localization capabilities.
naval.impact: This sonar system enhances the operational capabilities of the XL-UUV, improving its autonomy and effectiveness in underwater combat scenarios.

naval.t: L&T designing and constructing 54 Fast Interceptor Boats and 7 Offshore Patrol vessels
naval.body: L&T is designing and constructing 54 Fast Interceptor Boats and 7 Offshore Patrol vessels for the Indian Coast Guard. These boats are designed for coastal defence, patrolling, surveillance, and high-speed interception.
naval.impact: The development of these vessels enhances India's coastal security capabilities, enabling effective day and night patrolling, anti-terrorist, anti-smuggling, and search-and-rescue operations.

naval.t: Thales et Nexter unveiled the final version of RAPIDFire naval CIWS
naval.body: Thales and Nexter unveiled the final version of RAPIDFire naval, a close-in weapon system for naval use. It includes a 40mm cannon, radar, C2 module, optronics, and missiles, designed to defend against drones and drone swarms.
naval.impact: The RAPIDFire naval system's precision and ability to defend against drone swarms significantly enhances naval defense capabilities, reducing the attrition of surface-to-air missiles in saturation attacks.

naval.t: KONGSBERG launches Aegir SSA sonar family
naval.body: KONGSBERG has launched the Aegir SSA, a family of sonars for subsea situational awareness. The system includes an AI-powered virtual sonar operator service for specific missions.
naval.impact: The Aegir SSA enhances security, safety, and operational awareness in maritime environments, addressing unique challenges in ports, harbors, and coastal areas.

naval.t: Prototype uncrewed missile ship to be in service by 2030
naval.body: The UK Ministry of Defence plans to integrate a prototype uncrewed missile ship by 2030, part of the Hybrid Navy initiative. The vessel will carry missile silos to enhance fleet magazine depth.
naval.impact: This development will enhance the UK's naval capabilities by providing an autonomous platform for extended missile deployment, potentially reducing crew requirements and increasing operational flexibility.

naval.t: IAI unveils HYPNOSIS electronic jamming system
naval.body: IAI has unveiled the HYPNOSIS electronic jamming system to counter drone swarms. It is designed to work alongside existing missile defenses and provides a soft-kill defense layer.
naval.impact: HYPNOSIS offers a cost-effective solution to defend against GNSS-based aerial threats, addressing the imbalance between expensive interceptor missiles and cheap drones.

naval.t: Raytheon to develop software-defined radar for naval use
naval.body: Raytheon will develop advanced radar software for next-generation naval radars, enabling each radar component to operate independently and adapt to changing needs.
naval.impact: This development allows a single radar to perform multiple missions and share crowded frequency bands more efficiently, enhancing naval radar capabilities.

naval.t: Rheinmetall begins local assembly of MASS shipsets
naval.body: Rheinmetall Defence Australia has commenced local assembly of MASS shipsets for the Royal Australian Navy. The MASS system is an offboard countermeasure to defeat missile threats by generating decoys.
naval.impact: This local assembly enhances Australia's naval defence capability and Rheinmetall's supply chain in the country.

naval.t: Hanwha Ocean unveiled Combat Unmanned Surface Vessel concept
naval.body: Hanwha Ocean unveiled a Combat Unmanned Surface Vessel (CUSV) concept at MADEX 2025, designed for manned-unmanned teaming operations with advanced sensor capabilities.
naval.impact: The CUSV concept showcases advanced connectivity and sensor integration, enhancing naval operations through unmanned support.

naval.t: NGJ-MB completed first flight test on EA-18G Growler
naval.body: Raytheon's NGJ-MB completed its first flight test on the EA-18G Growler, generating its own power for the first time. The test met all objectives and will inform production decisions.
naval.impact: This milestone advances the jamming capabilities of naval aircraft, enhancing electronic warfare effectiveness.

naval.t: Saab demonstrated SLWT at UDT 2017
naval.body: Saab demonstrated the Saab Lightweight Torpedo (SLWT) at the UDT exhibition in 2017. The SLWT is designed for anti-submarine warfare and can be launched from multiple platforms.
naval.impact: The SLWT's flexibility and effectiveness in challenging marine environments like the Baltic Sea make it a significant advancement in ASW capabilities.

naval.t: Destinus develops kinetic counter-UAS Hornet B2 interceptor
naval.body: Destinus is developing the Hornet B2 interceptor for the Royal Netherlands Navy to counter medium-range drone threats. The Hornet B2 uses electro-optical and infrared sensing with AI for terminal phase interception.
naval.impact: The Hornet B2 interceptor addresses the growing need for scalable naval protection against low-cost, high-volume aerial threats, enhancing fleet defense capabilities.

naval.t: LCS 21 'USS Minneapolis-Saint Paul' delivered to U.S. Navy
naval.body: Lockheed Martin delivered the LCS 21 'USS Minneapolis-Saint Paul' to the U.S. Navy. The LCS is designed for close-to-shore missions and can be modified to integrate various capabilities.
naval.impact: The LCS 21 enhances the U.S. Navy's force projection and mission flexibility, particularly for littoral operations.

naval.t: BAE Systems delivers Multifunction Modular Mast (MMM) systems for U.S. Navy submarines
naval.body: BAE Systems has delivered Multifunction Modular Mast (MMM) systems to the U.S. Navy for Virginia-class submarines, enhancing their situational awareness and threat detection capabilities. The MMM system integrates with Lockheed Martin’s AN/BLQ-10 electronic warfare system to provide critical capabilities for electromagnetic spectrum dominance.
naval.impact: The MMM system significantly improves the U.S. Navy submarines' ability to detect and analyze adversary communications, enhancing their operational effectiveness and strategic situational awareness.

naval.t: Saab reveals new Coast Control Radar at IDE
naval.body: Saab has developed and will reveal the Coast Control Radar at IDE. It is a phased-array, non-rotating, software-defined radar for safeguarding territorial waterways.
naval.impact: The radar offers comprehensive 360-degree coverage and flexible installation, enhancing maritime traffic safety and national sovereignty.

naval.t: Future Naval Strike Missile to engage surface ships and land targets
naval.body: Kongsberg is leading the development of the Future Naval Strike Missile, a joint Norwegian-German project set to engage both surface ships and land targets by 2035.
naval.impact: This missile will enhance naval and coastal defense capabilities, expanding the operational range and versatility of maritime strike weapons.

naval.t: BAE Systems to demonstrate autonomous RIBs at Unmanned Warrior
naval.body: BAE Systems will demonstrate autonomous RIBs and the MAPLE system at Unmanned Warrior. The PAC950 RIB can be controlled autonomously and is capable of 45 knots.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights the potential for reducing crew risk in dangerous waters and integrating unmanned systems into existing infrastructures.

naval.t: BAE Systems delivers Archerfish, a remote-controlled underwater mine neutraliser
naval.body: BAE Systems has delivered Archerfish, a remote-controlled underwater mine neutraliser that can be launched from various platforms and relays real-time video and sonar data. It protects personnel by eliminating the need for divers and reduces the cost of mine clearance missions.
naval.impact: Archerfish significantly enhances the US Navy's capability to safely and efficiently clear underwater mines, reducing risk to personnel and operational costs.

naval.t: Aegis destroyer demonstrated hypersonic missile interception
naval.body: An Aegis guided missile destroyer successfully demonstrated its capability to detect, track, and intercept a maneuvering hypersonic missile in a simulated test. This capability is crucial for naval defense against advanced threats.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights the Aegis system's adaptability and effectiveness against hypersonic threats, enhancing naval defense capabilities.

naval.t: Ghost Shark underwater autonomous sub moves to production
naval.body: The Ghost Shark, an underwater autonomous sub, has moved directly from prototype to production. It is an ISR platform with potential for weapon fitting.
naval.impact: The Ghost Shark's rapid transition to production demonstrates advanced capabilities in underwater autonomous systems, enhancing Australia's undersea surveillance and defense.

naval.t: Raytheon and AEUK to demonstrate autonomous mine warfare system
naval.body: Raytheon and AEUK plan to demonstrate an autonomous mine warfare system for the Royal Navy. The system includes the AQS-20C sonar mine-hunting system and Barracuda unmanned underwater vehicle.
naval.impact: The demonstration aims to showcase advanced mine countermeasure capabilities, potentially accelerating the Royal Navy's MHC Block 2 timeline for autonomous mine hunting.

naval.t: Thales SAMDIS 600 sonar integrated with HII REMUS 620 UUV
naval.body: Thales and HII have integrated the SAMDIS 600 sonar with the REMUS 620 UUV, demonstrating advanced autonomous mine countermeasures. This integration highlights the adaptability of the REMUS 620 and the strength of industry partnerships.
naval.impact: The integration significantly enhances autonomous mine detection and imaging capabilities, setting a new standard for interoperable naval solutions.

naval.t: JS Izumo transformed into light aircraft carrier
naval.body: JS Izumo, originally a helicopter destroyer, is being transformed into a light aircraft carrier capable of carrying F-35B jets. This transformation marks a significant shift in Japan's military doctrine since World War II.
naval.impact: The transformation of JS Izumo into a light aircraft carrier enhances Japan's naval air capabilities, increasing pressure on China in the region.

naval.t: Surveyor USV demonstrated anti-submarine capabilities
naval.body: Saildrone presented the Surveyor USV, a 20-meter sail-equipped autonomous drone. It demonstrated effective detection and identification of submarine threats and real-time information transmission.
naval.impact: The Surveyor's high availability and advanced sensor suite significantly enhance maritime surveillance and anti-submarine warfare capabilities.

naval.t: Saab to integrate upgraded ISCMMS on RAN's Collins-class subs
naval.body: Saab will integrate an upgraded ISCMMS on RAN's Collins-class submarines. The system was previously developed and integrated on the lead vessel, with the remaining four vessels to follow in 2019.
naval.impact: The upgraded ISCMMS enhances the operational capability and safety of the submarines, ensuring they have the latest technology for their duties.

naval.t: Thales supplies two coastal surveillance radars
naval.body: Thales has supplied two coastal surveillance radars to the French Defence Procurement Agency to enhance maritime threat detection. The radars provide real-time surveillance and control capabilities.
naval.impact: The radars significantly enhance the French Defence Procurement Agency's ability to detect and respond to maritime threats in real-time, improving overall maritime security.

naval.t: Raytheon demonstrated AQS-20C mine-hunting sonar with Barracuda neutralizer
naval.body: Raytheon demonstrated the AQS-20C mine-hunting sonar and Barracuda neutralizer at ANTX, showcasing their ability to detect and neutralize various types of mines autonomously.
naval.impact: This demonstration marks a significant technological advancement in unmanned mine warfare, enhancing naval capabilities to quickly and effectively clear minefields.

naval.t: Thales demonstrated SAMDIS SAS system on ECA A27 AUV
naval.body: Thales demonstrated its SAMDIS Multi-view Synthetic Aperture Sonar system on an ECA A27 AUV, showcasing high-resolution imaging and reduced ambiguity in mine detection.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights Thales's capability to provide advanced mine-hunting solutions, crucial for navies transitioning to unmanned mine countermeasures.

naval.t: CRN 91 Gun, naval version of Medak 30mm gun, demonstrated
naval.body: The CRN 91 Gun is a naval adaptation of the Medak 30mm automatic gun, manufactured by Ordnance Factory Medak. It features a 30mm caliber and a rate of fire of 200 to 300 rounds per minute in single mode and 550 rounds per minute in slow mode.
naval.impact: This development enhances naval close-range defense capabilities with a high rate of fire and adaptability to ship installations.

naval.t: MEDUSA system development contracted by US Navy
