naval.body: General Dynamics Mission Systems has been contracted to develop the MEDUSA system for the US Navy. The Navy aims to create a hybrid fleet of crewed and uncrewed vessels to boost operational effectiveness and agility.
naval.impact: The MEDUSA system development underscores the US Navy's strategic focus on integrating uncrewed technology to maintain maritime dominance and enhance naval preparedness in evolving security environments.

naval.t: BAE Systems developed S-IKM for data management
naval.body: BAE Systems developed S-IKM, a digital tool for secure and efficient data management for naval operations. It aims to provide faster and more cost-effective support to the Royal Navy.
naval.impact: S-IKM significantly enhances the operational support and data sharing capabilities for naval vessels, aligning with the Royal Navy's digital ambitions.

naval.t: STR8 Industries demonstrates Ghostwake USV with 55 knots speed
naval.body: STR8 Industries has demonstrated the Ghostwake USV, capable of speeds up to 55 knots and operating in Sea State 6. It can be on station for seven days and carry 350 kg payloads.
naval.impact: The Ghostwake USV's high-speed and endurance capabilities enhance maritime security and surveillance, aligning with Taipei's $6.6 billion investment in drone systems.

naval.t: Rafael delivers 1000th TYPHOON naval weapon station
naval.body: Rafael has delivered the 1000th TYPHOON naval weapon station to the Israeli Navy, a combat-proven system integrated on various naval platforms worldwide.
naval.impact: The TYPHOON's widespread deployment and combat effectiveness enhance naval defense capabilities against a range of threats, including UAVs and drones.

naval.t: Kongsberg demonstrated HUGIN AUV capabilities to US Navy
naval.body: Kongsberg showcased its HUGIN Autonomous Underwater Vehicle to a US delegation, highlighting its advanced capabilities and reliability for naval missions.
naval.impact: The demonstration underscores Kongsberg's leadership in AUV technology, positioning HUGIN to meet diverse naval requirements without customization.

naval.t: 100th Multi-Function Console ready for export
naval.body: Saab Australia has reached a milestone with its 100th Multi-Function Console (MFC) ready for export. The MFC is designed for demanding naval operations and is in-service with the Royal Australian Navy.
naval.impact: The export of the MFC to countries in Europe and North America highlights Saab's trusted capability in naval operations and strengthens Australia's sovereign industrial capability.

naval.t: Seagull USV Platform remotely operated via SATCOM
naval.body: Elbit Systems will demonstrate the Seagull USV Platform at IMDEX 2017, showcasing its remote operation capabilities via SATCOM in Haifa Bay, Israel. The platform will perform operational missions controlled from a booth console.
naval.impact: This demonstration highlights Elbit Systems' capability to provide remote maritime surveillance and operational support, enhancing naval security and operational flexibility.

naval.t: KAAV-II amphibious assault vehicle in exploratory development
naval.body: Hanwha Defense is developing the KAAV-II amphibious assault vehicle for the ROK Marine Corps. The vehicle is in exploratory development and is set to enter mass production in 2029.
naval.impact: The KAAV-II represents a significant upgrade in amphibious assault capabilities for the ROK Marine Corps, offering improved speed and endurance compared to existing AAVs.

naval.t: Thales HFSAS sonar deployed in OZZ-5 UUV
naval.body: Thales has deployed its High Frequency Synthetic Aperture Sonar (HFSAS) in the OZZ-5 UUV for mine countermeasures. The sonar, combined with Japanese LFSAS technology, enhances mine detection capabilities.
naval.impact: This deployment marks a significant advancement in unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) technology for mine warfare, improving maritime security and operational efficiency.

naval.t: US Navy chose CAPTAS-4 sonar for future frigates
naval.body: The US Navy selected the CAPTAS-4 sonar from Thales and Leonardo for its future Constellation class frigates, citing its proven performance and technical maturity. The decision was made due to the unreliability and underperformance of the DART sonar.
naval.impact: This selection underscores the CAPTAS-4 sonar's reliability and effectiveness in anti-submarine warfare, securing its role in the US Navy's fleet modernization.

naval.t: TYPHOON Mk-30c naval weapon station delivered
naval.body: Rafael delivered the TYPHOON Mk-30c naval weapon station to the Israeli Navy. The system is combat-proven and integrates advanced fire control and tracking capabilities.
naval.impact: The TYPHOON Mk-30c enhances naval defense by effectively engaging surface and aerial threats, including small, fast, low-signature targets like UAVs and drones.

naval.t: Laser Weapon Demonstrator tested against targets
naval.body: MBDA Deutschland and Rheinmetall tested a Laser Weapon Demonstrator with over 100 field firings against various targets. The Bundeswehr completed trials of the system at sea.
naval.impact: The operational laser weapon system is effective in countering drones and other agile targets at short ranges, enhancing naval defense capabilities.

naval.t: Lockheed Martin to integrate JQL system on Saildrone USVs
naval.body: Lockheed Martin plans to integrate the Joint Air-to-Ground Missile Quad Launcher (JQL) system onto Saildrone's unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). Larger Saildrone vehicles are being developed to support larger payloads and capabilities.
naval.impact: This integration could significantly enhance the offensive capabilities of USVs, enabling them to carry and launch missiles, thus expanding their role in naval operations.

naval.t: Demonstrated distributed sensing software for SPY-6 radar
naval.body: Raytheon Missiles & Defense and the Office of Naval Research completed demonstrations of distributed sensing software for SPY-6 radar, using two surface-based radar emulators to detect targets.
naval.impact: The software updates enhance SPY-6's capabilities, supporting the Navy’s Distributed Maritime Operations concept and ensuring it remains a critical component for future naval defense.

naval.t: Thales NS110 radar passed factory acceptance test
naval.body: Thales' NS110 radar successfully completed a factory acceptance test for the UK's Type 31 frigates, demonstrating its capabilities in situational awareness and long-range detection.
naval.impact: This milestone is crucial for the Type 31 programme, ensuring the radar meets specifications and progresses towards integration on the frigates.

naval.t: Saab demonstrated MSA capabilities at Dubai Airshow
naval.body: Saab demonstrated the capabilities of the Saab 340 Maritime Surveillance Aircraft (MSA) at the Dubai Airshow in 2013. The MSA is a complete airborne surveillance system based on the civil Saab 340 aircraft.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights the MSA's role in providing flexible and reliable coastal security solutions, showcasing its integration of remote sensors and mission system components.

naval.t: 127 mm ammunition integrated with BAE Systems Mk 45 Mod 4 naval gun
naval.body: Diehl Defence and BAE Systems are developing an integration of 127 mm ammunition with the BAE Systems Mk 45 Mod 4 naval gun. This collaboration aims to enhance the effectiveness of maritime defense systems.
naval.impact: This integration will provide high-precision and long-range capabilities for naval defense, addressing complex maritime defense requirements.

naval.t: mini-UAS integrated on Seagull USV
naval.body: Elbit Systems has integrated a mini-UAS on the Seagull USV, enabling point water recovery and real-time visual feed transmission to land-based units and CMS of other vessels.
naval.impact: This integration enhances the Seagull USV's situational awareness and operational flexibility in underwater warfare scenarios.

naval.t: BAE Systems to demo pod-mounted RFCM system for P-8A Poseidon
naval.body: BAE Systems is developing a pod-mounted RFCM system for the P-8A Poseidon, aiming to add self-protection capability. The system's development process has been significantly accelerated.
naval.impact: This rapid development highlights BAE Systems' capability to meet urgent customer needs, potentially setting a new standard for quick integration of advanced naval defense systems.

naval.t: Marine-Laserdemonstrator has traveled 28,000 nautical miles
naval.body: The Marine-Laserdemonstrator has traveled 28,000 nautical miles aboard the frigate SACHSEN, demonstrating its capability in various maritime environments. This system is part of a joint venture with MBDA Deutschland GmbH to develop a complete laser weapon system for the German Navy.
naval.impact: The extensive sea trials indicate the system's readiness for operational use, enhancing the German Navy's defense capabilities against aerial, maritime, and land threats.

naval.t: RapidFire Naval T40AA gun system successfully tested
naval.body: Nexter and Thales developed the RapidFire Naval T40AA gun system, which was successfully tested on land. The system is designed for naval use, featuring a 40mm CTA gun and advanced stabilization.
naval.impact: The system's compact design and multi-role capabilities make it a versatile addition to naval defense, providing effective close-range protection against various threats.

naval.t: Saab and FMV develop underwater capability concepts for A26 submarines
naval.body: Saab and FMV are developing underwater capability concepts for the A26 submarines, expected to be delivered by 2028. These concepts will integrate into the construction of the submarines, which feature special steels, high-seakeeping performance, and an X-rudder configuration for manoeuvrability.
naval.impact: The development of these underwater capabilities will enhance the operational effectiveness and stealth of the A26 submarines, positioning them as advanced conventional submarines.

naval.t: Leonardo demonstrates X-Gun 30x173 mm weapon system
naval.body: Leonardo has demonstrated the X-Gun 30x173 mm weapon system, which is already securing naval clients. The system is electrically powered with a double channel supply.
naval.impact: The X-Gun's advanced capabilities and existing client base indicate a significant market entry for Leonardo in naval weapon systems.

naval.t: MBDA develops naval version of MMP missile
naval.body: MBDA is developing a naval version of the MMP missile, following experiments with ECUME boats in Djibouti. This version aims to improve naval platforms' ability to neutralize small targets.
naval.impact: The naval MMP will enhance the anti-ship and anti-missile capabilities of naval vessels, providing a more versatile and effective defense against asymmetric threats.

naval.t: High Frequency laboratory for JORN upgrade
naval.body: BAE Systems Australia opened a High Frequency laboratory to develop technology for the Jindalee Operational Radar Network (JORN) upgrade. The lab will support the next decade's surveillance enhancement.
naval.impact: The new lab will significantly enhance JORN's surveillance capabilities, crucial for Australia's air and maritime operations, border surveillance, and disaster relief.

naval.t: Saab demonstrated a new coast control radar at IDEX
naval.body: Saab presented a new coast control radar at IDEX in the UAE. The radar is a next-generation phased array, non-rotating, software-defined system.
naval.impact: The radar's 360-degree coverage and ease of integration into existing infrastructure enhances coastal surveillance capabilities, providing a robust defense solution.

naval.t: Saab to deliver new naval radars and combat management system for F123 frigates
naval.body: Saab will deliver and integrate new naval radars and a combat management system for the German Navy’s F123 frigates, overhauling the existing system.
naval.impact: This modernisation enhances the F123 frigates' combat capabilities and strengthens Germany's naval defence infrastructure.

naval.t: Seagull™ deployed with HELRAS dipping sonar
naval.body: Elbit Systems deployed the Seagull™ Multi-Mission Surface Vessel with HELRAS dipping sonar in an ASW exercise. The deployment demonstrated increased operational working time and effectiveness.
naval.impact: The integration of HELRAS on Seagull™ enhances anti-submarine warfare capabilities, providing extended operational range and efficiency for naval missions.

naval.t: Hanwha Systems integrates Cambridge Pixel's SPx radar technology
naval.body: Hanwha Systems is integrating Cambridge Pixel's SPx radar technology into its naval systems for advanced radar processing. This includes radar display and tracking for new patrol boats and naval vessels.
naval.impact: The integration enhances the radar capabilities of South Korean naval vessels, improving situational awareness and operational effectiveness.

naval.t: P950 RIB USV with automated navigational decision-making
naval.body: BAE Systems completed trials of the P950 RIB USV, which is equipped with automated navigational decision-making technologies developed with L3Harris and MSI Defence Systems. The technology is designed to be retrofitted to existing RIBs to enhance warship capabilities.
naval.impact: This development allows operators to focus on mission-critical tasks while automated systems handle navigation, potentially improving operational efficiency and safety for naval missions.

naval.t: FLASH SONICS sonar system for ASW
naval.body: Thales and Leonardo are supporting the Polish Navy's ASW capability with the FLASH SONICS sonar system. The system has been fielded in numerous navies and is recognized for its high performance in ASW operations.
naval.impact: The FLASH SONICS sonar system's proven effectiveness in operational deployments enhances the Polish Navy's anti-submarine warfare capabilities, ensuring superior operational readiness against submarine threats.

naval.t: Elbit Systems' HELRAS sonar system successfully completed sea acceptance test with Israeli Navy
naval.body: Elbit Systems' HELRAS sonar system has completed a sea acceptance test with the Israeli Navy on board the Seagull unmanned surface vessel. The system demonstrates advanced capabilities in anti-submarine warfare, including detection of low-strength targets at slow speeds and second convergence zone detection in deep water.
naval.impact: The successful test of HELRAS on Seagull USV enhances naval operational effectiveness by reducing risk to human life and cutting costs, while providing superior detection and localization capabilities.

naval.t: Saab demonstrates Autonomous Ocean Core at WEST 2025
naval.body: Saab will showcase Autonomous Ocean Core at WEST 2025, a control system for un-crewed naval platforms. It enables various missions like ISTAR and electronic warfare.
naval.impact: This system enhances naval autonomy and interoperability, providing a tactical edge by integrating third-party capabilities.

naval.t: 9LV Combat Management System next gen developed
naval.body: Saab is developing the next generation of the 9LV Combat Management System at its new Advanced Maritime Systems Centre in Adelaide. This system will contribute to Australia's naval capabilities, particularly in fire control and missile integration.
naval.impact: The development of advanced naval systems like the 9LV Combat Management System enhances Australia's maritime defense and supports Saab's global naval systems integration program.

naval.t: Thales successfully tested Franco-British MMCM prototype in operational config.
naval.body: Thales announced the successful testing of a Franco-British Maritime Mine Counter Measures (MMCM) prototype in operational configuration. The MMCM programme, initiated in 2010, aims to develop an autonomous system for detecting and neutralizing sea mines and underwater improvised explosives.
naval.impact: This milestone marks the delivery of the world's only operational system-of-systems for mine countermeasures, consolidating Thales's leadership in conventional and autonomous mine countermeasure solutions.

naval.t: Lockheed Martin demonstrated uncrewed HIMARS navigation
naval.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated an uncrewed HIMARS launcher capable of navigating without a driver using non-emitting perception sensors, enabling seamless day and night operations. This capability is designed to be integrated into the existing HIMARS fleet, enhancing artillery adaptability.
naval.impact: This autonomous capability significantly enhances the flexibility and adaptability of the HIMARS fleet, allowing for seamless integration and operation in complex environments, while retaining crewed operation options.

naval.t: Raytheon delivers SeaRAM ship self-defence system
naval.body: Raytheon has been awarded a contract to supply the SeaRAM ship self-defence system for Australia's Sea 3000 frigate programme, to be built by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.
naval.impact: The SeaRAM system enhances the defensive capabilities of the Improved Mogami frigates, providing advanced protection against anti-ship missiles and other threats.

naval.t: BAE Systems developed Hunter digital simulation tool
naval.body: BAE Systems Maritime Australia developed the Hunter digital simulation (HUDS) tool to enhance the shipbuilding process for the Hunter-class frigate programme. The tool optimises the programme schedule and supports rapid development of shipbuilding scenarios.
naval.impact: The HUDS tool improves the efficiency and effectiveness of shipbuilding by optimising schedules and enabling better data exploitation, which can lead to faster and more informed decision-making in naval construction projects.

naval.t: Raytheon's AN/SPY-6(V)1 radar demonstrated against complex targets
naval.body: Raytheon's AN/SPY-6(V)1 radar has demonstrated its performance against singular and multiple complex targets. It provides enhanced range, accuracy, and resistance to electronic clutter.
naval.impact: The radar's capabilities significantly enhance the Aegis BMD system's ability to detect and track a wide range of threats, improving overall naval defense effectiveness.

naval.t: Saab delivers new lightweight torpedo to Sweden
naval.body: Saab has delivered its new lightweight torpedo to Sweden, marking a significant milestone in the project. The torpedo is tailored for the Baltic Sea's unique conditions.
naval.impact: This delivery ensures Sweden has advanced submarine detection capabilities, enhancing its naval defense in shallow and complex waters.

naval.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates MASS nova with new trainable launcher
naval.body: Rheinmetall has unveiled the MASS nova, featuring a new trainable launcher with variable fan angle and increased capacity for decoy ammunition. The system also includes a new radio frequency countermeasure.
naval.impact: The MASS nova enhances naval self-protection capabilities by providing faster and more effective decoy deployment, improving the survivability of naval vessels against missile threats.

naval.t: MTWAN system supports RAN's maritime communication
naval.body: Thales Australia has been awarded a contract extension to support the SEA 1442 Phase 3 programme, focusing on the MTWAN system which upgrades the RAN's communication systems into an IP-based network. The MTWAN system interfaces with existing RAN systems and is considered low-risk with potential to reduce through-life support expenses.
naval.impact: The MTWAN system's ability to integrate with existing naval communication systems and support future requirements enhances interoperability and efficiency for the RAN, ensuring secure and reliable communication.

naval.t: SIGEN secures contract for Horizon frigates' electronic warfare system upgrade
naval.body: SIGEN, a joint venture between Thales and Elettronica, secured a contract to upgrade the electronic warfare systems of Horizon frigates. The upgrade will integrate components from national naval programs, including RESM and radar electronic countermeasures.
naval.impact: This upgrade enhances the naval capabilities of Horizon frigates, ensuring they remain effective against evolving threats. It also strengthens the partnership between Thales and Elettronica in the electronic warfare domain.

naval.t: Rheinmetall develops array flares for aircraft protection
naval.body: Rheinmetall develops array flares as part of its protection solutions for aircraft against modern infrared threats. These flares are designed to protect various aircraft types from missile attacks.
naval.impact: The development of array flares enhances aircraft survivability by providing advanced countermeasures against sophisticated missile systems, crucial for modern aerial combat scenarios.

naval.t: Turkey tested Typhoon Block 3 ASBM hitting small naval target
naval.body: Turkey successfully tested the Typhoon Block 3 ASBM, which hit a small naval target. The missile is part of a larger system integrating coastal surveillance and naval resources.
naval.impact: The test demonstrates Turkey's capability to engage small naval targets with an ASBM, enhancing its maritime defense and deterrence capabilities.

naval.t: Rheinmetall delivers 300th MASS naval countermeasures system
naval.body: Rheinmetall has delivered its 300th MASS system, a naval countermeasures system that protects ships and boats. The system can be integrated into existing combat management systems or operate standalone, covering all relevant wavelengths of the electromagnetic spectrum.
naval.impact: The delivery of the 300th MASS system underscores Rheinmetall's market leadership in naval countermeasures, providing comprehensive protection to vessels across 14 user nations.

naval.t: Kongsberg Maritime delivers HUGIN AUV systems to GRSE
naval.body: Kongsberg Maritime has supplied four HUGIN AUV survey systems to GRSE, including HiPAP 502 systems for AUV operations. The systems are configured for the Indian Navy's current and future needs.
naval.impact: This delivery enhances India's naval survey and reconnaissance capabilities, providing advanced underwater vehicle technology for deep-water operations.

naval.t: Saab demonstrates Autonomous Ocean Core for unmanned naval vessels
naval.body: Saab has demonstrated Autonomous Ocean Core, an autonomous control system for unmanned naval vessels. The system enables continuous feature addition and supports various missions like mine detection and electronic warfare.
naval.impact: This system enhances naval operational flexibility and autonomy, potentially reducing risks to human operators in hazardous missions.

naval.t: Raytheon develops Coyote Block 2 variant
naval.body: Raytheon is developing the Coyote Block 2 variant, an advanced expendable drone. The Block 2 is progressing towards a more sophisticated version compared to Block 1.
naval.impact: The development of Coyote Block 2 enhances Raytheon's capability to provide advanced drone systems for military applications, particularly in naval and battlefield scenarios.

naval.t: Raytheon develops advanced software-defined radar software
naval.body: Raytheon is developing advanced radar software for naval radars, enabling independent operation of radar building blocks and simultaneous multi-mission performance. The software allows radars to adapt to changing needs and share crowded frequency bands.
naval.impact: This development enhances naval radar flexibility and adaptability, potentially improving situational awareness and operational effectiveness in complex electromagnetic environments.

naval.t: Thales unveils miniaturized AI-enabled Sonar 76Nano
naval.body: Thales has developed the Sonar 76Nano, a miniaturized AI-enabled sonar system for UUVs. It will be showcased to the UK Royal Navy in December.
naval.impact: The Sonar 76Nano aligns with the UK's Atlantic Bastion sensor network, enhancing undersea surveillance capabilities.

naval.t: MFRA radar detected and tracked ballistic missiles
naval.body: Leonardo’s MFRA radar was used by the Italian Navy to detect and track ballistic missiles during Formidable Shield 2019. The radar demonstrated exceptional accuracy and confirmed its suitability for anti-ballistic missile defence.
naval.impact: The MFRA radar's ability to detect and track ballistic missiles enhances the Italian Navy's and potentially NATO's capability to defend against long-range threats, improving overall maritime security.

naval.t: Saab demonstrated autonomous operation of unmanned surface vessels
naval.body: Saab demonstrated the autonomous operation and collaboration capabilities of two unmanned surface vessels, the Patrol Craft CB 90 (Enforcer III) and the Surveillance Craft Piraya, during the OCEAN2020 Baltic Sea Live Demonstration.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights Saab's ability to integrate unmanned systems for maritime surveillance and threat neutralization, showcasing advanced naval capabilities.

naval.t: Raytheon awarded $590M contract for NGJ-MB EW system
naval.body: Raytheon received a $590M contract to continue developing the Next Generation Jammer Mid-Band (NGJ-MB) system, a state-of-the-art electronic warfare solution for the Navy.
naval.impact: The NGJ-MB system, replacing the aging ALQ-99 jammer, introduces advanced technology like active electronically scanned arrays and a fully digital backend, significantly enhancing the Navy's offensive electronic attack capabilities.

naval.t: Rheinmetall demonstrated a laser weapon station in tests
naval.body: Rheinmetall conducted tests of a laser weapon station in Switzerland, successfully engaging drones and mortar rounds. The station is designed for ground, air, and naval operations and is modular and scalable.
naval.impact: The successful engagement of drones and mortar rounds demonstrates the operational readiness of laser weapon technology for naval and other military platforms, enhancing defensive capabilities against asymmetric threats.

naval.t: Leonardo DRS to provide hybrid electric drive system for USCG OPC
naval.body: Leonardo DRS will provide a hybrid electric drive system for the U.S. Coast Guard’s Offshore Patrol Cutter, enhancing operational efficiency and reducing emissions. The system includes a high-performance, permanent magnet motor-based Auxiliary Propulsion System.
naval.impact: The hybrid electric drive system increases mission duration and reduces fuel and maintenance costs, providing the Coast Guard with a strategic advantage in maritime operations.

naval.t: surface drones passed endurance tests
naval.body: Defcomm's surface drones have passed endurance tests, and Fincantieri will develop deployment capabilities for these autonomous vehicles.
naval.impact: The successful endurance tests of Defcomm's surface drones and Fincantieri's integration efforts will enhance naval autonomy and operational capabilities.

naval.t: Raytheon develops advanced maritime sensing and targeting system
naval.body: Raytheon is developing a maritime defense system with EO/IR sensors and advanced detection software for DARPA’s Pulling Guard program. Phase one will focus on simulated engagements to evaluate system performance.
naval.impact: This system aims to enhance real-time target tracking and rapid engagement decisions for naval and commercial vessels, improving maritime defense capabilities.

naval.t: Raytheon developing sensing and targeting system for naval security
naval.body: Raytheon is developing a new sensing and targeting system under DARPA’s Pulling Guard programme to protect naval logistics vessels and commercial shipping from emerging threats.
naval.impact: The system aims to enhance maritime security by integrating electro-optical/infrared sensors, detection software, and command and control tools, providing a scalable and cost-effective solution.

naval.t: Saab develops AN/SPN-50 radar variant for U.S. Naval Air Systems Command
naval.body: Saab is developing a variant of the AN/SPN-50 radar for air traffic control on Nimitz-class aircraft carriers. This follows the company's continuous development of the Giraffe AMB sensor for various U.S. naval missions.
naval.impact: The development of the AN/SPN-50 variant underscores Saab's capability to tailor advanced radar systems to meet specific naval requirements, enhancing air traffic control and operational effectiveness for U.S. carriers.

naval.t: Developing advanced software for SPY-6 radars
naval.body: The US Office of Naval Research awarded Raytheon a contract to develop advanced software for SPY-6 radars, enabling multi-mission flexibility and improved spectrum sharing.
naval.impact: This development enhances the adaptability and efficiency of naval radars, allowing them to better handle evolving operational needs and share frequency bands with 5G.

naval.t: Lockheed Martin completed Aegis upgrades on RAN's Hobart Class Destroyers
naval.body: Lockheed Martin Australia completed Aegis upgrades on the Royal Australian Navy's Hobart Class Destroyers, showcasing Australian sovereign sustainment of the Aegis Weapon System.
naval.impact: This achievement demonstrates Australia's capability to sustain and upgrade its naval systems independently, enhancing its naval defense and reducing reliance on external support.

naval.t: Leonardo's ULISSES Firefly system achieved live test milestone
naval.body: Leonardo's ULISSES Firefly system was installed on a ship in La Spezia and successfully integrated with sonobuoys and a dipping sonar for real-time data transmission to shore.
naval.impact: The live test demonstrated the system's capability for real-time acoustic data processing and transmission, enhancing naval surveillance and interoperability.

naval.t: Kronos radar system tested against ballistic missiles
naval.body: Leonardo's Kronos radar system was tested on the Carlo Bergamini frigate during Formidable Shield 2019. The system successfully detected, classified, and tracked ballistic missiles.
naval.impact: The successful testing of Kronos enhances the naval fleet's capability to defend against ballistic missile threats, demonstrating advanced radar technology.

naval.t: Elbit Systems developed DESEAVER MK-4 CMDS
naval.body: Elbit Systems developed the DESEAVER MK-4 Countermeasure Dispensing System (CMDS), an advanced maritime EW solution. This system effectively counters complex missile attack scenarios by combining ECM capabilities with decoy launchers.
naval.impact: The DESEAVER MK-4 CMDS enhances naval vessels' defense capabilities against various threats, providing high situational awareness and advanced countermeasures.

naval.t: RAPIDFire remotely operated 40mm artillery system qualified
naval.body: Thales and KNDS France have qualified the RAPIDFire system, a remotely operated 40mm artillery system. It has been installed on French naval vessels and participated in live fire exercises.
naval.impact: The RAPIDFire system enhances naval close-in self-defence capabilities against modern threats, providing a technological edge to the French Navy.

naval.t: Thales demonstrated a fully integrated drone-based mine countermeasures system
naval.body: Thales conducted at-sea trials of a fully integrated drone-based mine countermeasures system, showcasing its ability to neutralize sea mines autonomously. The system, including remotely operated underwater vehicles, was evaluated by the French and Royal Navies.
naval.impact: This system represents a significant advancement in naval mine countermeasures, enhancing operational safety and efficiency by keeping naval personnel out of danger zones.

naval.t: Leonardo unveils AWHERO unmanned rotorcraft with Gabbiano Ultra-Light radar
naval.body: Leonardo unveiled the AWHERO unmanned rotorcraft at the Paris Air Show, featuring the Gabbiano Ultra-Light radar. AWHERO is in pre-production and will be used for maritime surveillance under the OCEAN 2020 initiative.
naval.impact: AWHERO's maritime surveillance capability enhances naval safety and surveillance, positioning Leonardo as a leader in unmanned naval technology.

naval.t: Raytheon and Composite Energy Technologies demonstrated HADALUS, a drone submarine launching weapons while submerged
naval.body: Raytheon and Composite Energy Technologies demonstrated HADALUS, a drone submarine, during a US Navy exercise. HADALUS can launch weapons while submerged and has an endurance of over 2,000 nautical miles.
naval.impact: HADALUS represents a significant advancement in drone submarine technology, capable of performing detect, reacquire, and engage functions within a single mission, marking a shift from traditional roles like mine laying and payload delivery.

naval.t: AOEW AMP AN/ALQ-248 passed US Navy preliminary design review
naval.body: Lockheed Martin's AOEW AMP AN/ALQ-248 system has passed the US Navy's preliminary design review. The system is designed to integrate with MH-60 helicopters, providing advanced electronic warfare capabilities.
naval.impact: The AOEW system will enhance the US Navy's ability to detect and counter anti-ship missile threats, significantly improving maritime security.

naval.t: Saab will demonstrate CB90 Next Generation combat boat
naval.body: Saab will showcase the CB90 Next Generation combat boat at DSEI 2021, featuring enhanced combat management systems, surveillance sensors, and improved stealth, maneuverability, and speed.
naval.impact: The CB90 NG's advanced capabilities will likely attract interest from navies seeking multi-mission amphibious assault craft, enhancing Saab's competitive edge in naval warfare systems.

naval.t: Rheinmetall's Multi Ammunition Softkill System (MASS) ordered by Australian Navy
naval.body: Rheinmetall's MASS ship protection system was selected by the Australian Navy after trials. The first systems will be delivered by the end of 2023, with full operational capability by 2027.
naval.impact: MASS's unique capabilities have secured it as the largest naval protection technology order for Rheinmetall, underscoring its effectiveness and marking a significant milestone for Rheinmetall Defence Australia's local industrial growth.

naval.t: Saab delivers SLWT torpedo system to Finnish Navy
naval.body: Saab has delivered the SLWT torpedo system to the Finnish Navy for their SQ2000 MLU and SQ 2020 programs. The SLWT is designed to adapt to difficult hydro-acoustic conditions and is modular, allowing for easy switching between warhead and exercise versions.
naval.impact: The SLWT system's adaptability and modular design enhance the Finnish Navy's anti-submarine warfare capabilities, providing a flexible and efficient solution for submarine detection and engagement in the Baltic Sea.

naval.t: Developing Above Water Warfare System (AWWS) for Royal Netherlands Navy
naval.body: Thales and the Netherlands DMO are developing the AWWS for the Royal Netherlands Navy's new frigates. AWWS is a state-of-the-art surface warfare fire control system designed to counter evolving threats.
naval.impact: AWWS will enable the new frigates to defend against complex, coordinated, and high-speed threats, ensuring the ships can protect themselves and continue their missions effectively.

naval.t: Design collaboration for naval combat consoles
naval.body: Saab Australia and UniSA are collaborating to design future naval combat consoles for submarines and surface naval platforms. This collaboration aims to enhance naval capabilities through academic-industry partnership.
naval.impact: The collaboration leverages Saab's expertise in high-performance consoles and UniSA's industrial design and human factors knowledge, potentially leading to advanced naval combat systems.

naval.t: Anduril demonstrates long-duration XL-AUV
naval.body: Anduril completed a long-duration demonstration of its XL-AUV, showcasing extended range and endurance. The CAMP programme will conduct an operationally representative demonstration of its Dive-XL vehicle.
naval.impact: This demonstration advances the capability of autonomous underwater vehicles, enabling extended-range and endurance operations critical for naval missions.

naval.t: USS Theodore Roosevelt equipped with Unmanned Air Warfare Center
naval.body: The USS Theodore Roosevelt became the first carrier with an Unmanned Air Warfare Center in March 2026, supporting the MQ-25A drone. This center enables the carrier to deploy MQ-25A for operational missions.
naval.impact: This development enhances the carrier's operational flexibility by freeing up F/A-18 Super Hornets for strike missions, improving overall fleet efficiency.

naval.t: Seagull USV conducted live ASW mission
naval.body: Elbit Systems' Seagull USV conducted a live ASW mission, demonstrating its multi-mission capabilities including mine-hunting and electronic warfare.
naval.impact: The mission highlights Seagull's operational readiness and autonomy, enhancing naval security and surveillance capabilities.

naval.t: UK Royal Navy exploring jet-powered UAS demonstrator
naval.body: The UK Royal Navy aims to demonstrate a jet-powered UAS from a Queen Elizabeth-class carrier. Leonardo is developing the Proteus autonomous helicopter for naval use.
naval.impact: This development could enhance naval surveillance and combat capabilities, providing a platform for advanced autonomous operations.

naval.t: Kongsberg supplies new PSPS for Dutch Walrus class subs
naval.body: Kongsberg signed a contract to supply new PSPS for Dutch Walrus class submarines, integrating hydrophone data for more accurate target solutions.
naval.impact: The PSPS enhances submarine detection capabilities, providing more accurate and timely target solutions, crucial for naval warfare.

naval.t: Lockheed Martin and U.S. Navy demonstrated SensorMAX™ AI sonar expert for ASW
naval.body: Lockheed Martin and the U.S. Navy demonstrated SensorMAX™, an AI/ML sonar expert for antisubmarine warfare, during RIMPAC 2026. The system monitors spectral energy and assists with rapid threat detection, doubling legacy capabilities.
naval.impact: SensorMAX™ significantly enhances the U.S. Navy’s subsurface detection and threat identification capabilities, enabling rapid retraining and over-the-air updates.

naval.t: Leonardo and Lacroix developed SYLENA Mk2/MJTE anti-torpedo suite
naval.body: Leonardo and Lacroix developed the SYLENA Mk2/MJTE, integrating Lacroix's SYLENA MK2 launcher and Leonardo's MJTE jammer, enhancing anti-torpedo defense capabilities.
naval.impact: The MJTE allows for a significant number of defensive actions at reduced costs, improving naval vessels' anti-torpedo defense efficiency.

naval.t: laser battle complex passed sea tests
naval.body: Rheinmetall and MBDA's laser battle complex passed sea tests, a high-energy laser weapon system for naval use. The system is a demonstrator for further testing.
naval.impact: The successful sea tests mark a significant step in developing a high-energy laser weapon system for naval defense, offering cost-effective and rapid response against drones and small, fast targets.

naval.t: Hanwha Ocean developed a 3,000-tonne submarine with AIP
naval.body: Hanwha Ocean developed a 3,000-tonne submarine with advanced air-independent propulsion. The submarine is proposed for Canada and is suitable for Arctic operations.
naval.impact: The submarine's innovative lithium-ion batteries and AIP system enhance its operational capabilities, making it a strong contender for Canada's submarine procurement initiative.

naval.t: Marine Laser Demonstrator tested on Fregatte SACHSEN
naval.body: MBDA Deutschland GmbH and Rheinmetall tested a Marine Laser Demonstrator on the Fregatte SACHSEN for over a year, covering 28,000 nautical miles. The demonstrator fired over 1,000 shots and was effective against air, sea, and land targets.
naval.impact: The successful testing of the high-energy laser weapon system enhances the German Navy's defense capabilities against multiple threats, showcasing advanced tracking and precision.

naval.t: Saab demonstrates A26, a 5th-generation submarine
naval.body: Saab has demonstrated the A26, the world's first 5th-generation submarine, which can remain undetected in complex maritime environments and gather critical information. It is equipped with long-range precision strike torpedoes and submarine-launched missiles.
naval.impact: The A26 significantly enhances operational flexibility and strategic deterrence by maintaining a covert presence and supporting information warfare efforts, contributing to multi-domain operations (MDO).

naval.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates ASTERIA, a multi-influence sea mine
naval.body: ASTERIA is a remotely controlled sea mine with multi-sensor architecture and smart processing, designed to resist modern countermeasures and tampering. It can be deployed from various platforms and is modular.
naval.impact: ASTERIA's advanced features enhance naval security by providing superior target selectivity and resistance to countermeasures, making it a significant advancement in underwater warfare.

naval.t: Super Rapido naval gun with 76mm DART guided ammunition demonstrated protection capability
naval.body: Leonardo's Super Rapido naval gun with 76mm DART guided ammunition demonstrated its ability to protect its host ship from sophisticated threats during the Formidable Shield 2021 exercise. The gun's performance was part of a broader suite of technologies showcased by Leonardo on the Italian Navy’s Antonio Marceglia.
naval.impact: The successful demonstration of the Super Rapido’s protection capability underscores its potential as a robust defensive system for naval vessels, enhancing their ability to counter advanced threats.

naval.t: AWHero received military certification
naval.body: Leonardo presented the AWHero, a 200 kg RUAS, which has received military certification in Italy. The AWHero is optimized for naval and multi-domain operations.
naval.impact: The certification marks a significant milestone for AWHero, positioning it as the first and only RUAS of its kind to achieve military certification, enhancing its operational readiness and interoperability.

naval.t: Thales demonstrated SAMDIS Multi-view sonar system
naval.body: Thales demonstrated the SAMDIS Multi-view sonar system on an ECA A27 A platform, showing its reliability and detection capabilities. The system, when paired with PRACTIS software, ensures high confidence in classifying non-military contacts.
naval.impact: The demonstration highlights SAMDIS's effectiveness in mine detection and classification, reducing unnecessary investigations and improving operational efficiency in mine countermeasures.

naval.t: Rheinmetall Canada developed the MASS missile defence system
naval.body: Rheinmetall Canada has developed the MASS system, which calculates and implements the best missile defeat solution by firing decoys in optimal positions. The system is fully automatic and can be integrated into naval command and control systems on various ship types.
naval.impact: MASS significantly enhances naval vessels' missile defence capabilities, providing tactical and operational advantages by integrating seamlessly with existing naval systems.

naval.t: Elbit Systems showcased Skylark C- Ship-borne Mini UAS
naval.body: Elbit Systems showcased the Skylark C- Ship-borne Mini UAS, a highly autonomous mini-UAS designed for naval applications. The system is part of Elbit's wide naval systems portfolio.
naval.impact: The Skylark C- Ship-borne Mini UAS enhances naval surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities, providing a force multiplier for navies.

naval.t: NSWC IHD cast first regrained Mk 70 SRM
naval.body: NSWC IHD cast its first regrained Mk 70 solid rocket motor, a high-performance booster used by the DoW and NASA. This marks a significant step in becoming a second source for reclaimed and re-grained SRMs.
naval.impact: This milestone addresses a bottleneck in the defense industrial base, enhancing production capacity and reliability for critical naval and aerospace missions.

uav.t: MESMER counter-drone system integrated into Thales Bushmaster vehicle
uav.body: MESMER, a counter-drone system, has been integrated into the Thales Bushmaster vehicle, providing a mobile platform for its operations. This integration aims to protect personnel and infrastructure from dangerous drones.
uav.impact: The integration of MESMER onto a mobile platform enhances its operational flexibility and effectiveness, allowing it to be deployed in various military scenarios to counter drone threats.

uav.t: Developed LAD system for drone detection and neutralization
uav.body: Arquus is developing a LAD system for drone detection and neutralization, based on technologies from the SCORPION program. The system is designed to be integrated into existing vehicles and tested in a controlled environment.
uav.impact: The LAD system represents a significant step in enhancing France's capability to counter drone threats, leveraging existing infrastructure to rapidly deploy effective solutions.

uav.t: Anduril demonstrates EagleEye augmented reality glasses
uav.body: Anduril demonstrated its EagleEye augmented reality glasses, which replace a mask and wires, and include features like a mini-map and compass. The system is closer to being convenient for use, unlike Microsoft's IVAS which faced technical issues and delays.
uav.impact: The demonstration of EagleEye signifies a significant step towards practical augmented reality for military use, offering a more comfortable and feature-rich solution compared to previous attempts.

uav.t: Proposed Watchkeeper drone with Polish requirements
uav.body: Thales UK has developed the Watchkeeper drone, which is being proposed to Poland. The drone will be assembled in Poland and integrated with Polish requirements, including an armed version with surface-to-air missiles designed by Thales UK.
uav.impact: The proposal of the Watchkeeper drone to Poland represents a significant export opportunity for Thales UK and enhances Poland's tactical drone capabilities with advanced features.

uav.t: Elbit Systems demonstrates AMPS NG with SWIR technology
uav.body: Elbit Systems has developed AMPS NG, integrating Shortwave Infrared technology to enhance observation performance in challenging conditions. The system is in final integration stages and undergoing flight tests on an unmanned aircraft for a European Air Force.
uav.impact: The addition of SWIR technology significantly improves AMPS NG's operational capabilities in high humidity, smoke, or dust conditions, making it suitable for a range of airborne intelligence missions.

uav.t: Thales unveiled mini COMINT sensor payload for UAVs
uav.body: Thales unveiled a mini COMINT sensor payload for UAVs at the Paris Air Show 2025. The sensor operates between 200 MHz and 6 GHz, detecting signals from SDRs, tactical datalinks, and satcom.
uav.impact: This advance enhances UAVs' intelligence gathering capabilities, enabling precise 3D localisation of signal direction.

uav.t: Turgis Gaillard unveils AAROK MALE drone
uav.body: Turgis Gaillard unveiled the AAROK MALE drone at the 2023 Paris Air Show, designed for ISR and maritime surveillance. The drone integrates Thales's AirMaster S radar, enhancing its operational capabilities.
uav.impact: The AAROK drone represents a significant step towards French strategic autonomy in drone technology, offering advanced ISR capabilities.

uav.t: Leonardo demonstrated Manned-Unmanned Teaming (MUMT) between AW159 and UAV
uav.body: Leonardo demonstrated Manned-Unmanned Teaming (MUMT) on September 17, integrating an AW159 helicopter with a UAV. The demonstration showed the helicopter crew controlling the UAV from the cockpit during missions.
uav.impact: This capability increases operational awareness, effectiveness, and safety by combining manned and unmanned aircraft strengths.

uav.t: M72 rocket launcher fired from Alare Technologies BLADE
uav.body: Nammo demonstrated firing the M72 rocket launcher from the BLADE UAV. BLADE is a man-packable, versatile VTOL system with low cost-per-shot.
uav.impact: This integration showcases BLADE's capability to support precision strike missions, enhancing tactical flexibility and cost-effectiveness.

uav.t: Rheinmetall showcases Hermelin C-UAS for silent drone defence
uav.body: Rheinmetall is showcasing the Hermelin C-UAS, a modular hybrid platform for silent drone defence. It combines autonomous mobility, powerful sensor technology, and hybrid power supply to address the growing threat of unmanned systems.
uav.impact: The Hermelin C-UAS offers a highly mobile and low-signature solution for drone defence, enhancing the security of critical areas and operations.

uav.t: Leonardo unveils first pre-production AWHERO RUAS
uav.body: Leonardo unveiled the first pre-production AWHERO RUAS at a new facility in Pisa. The AWHERO is a state-of-the-art unmanned helicopter.
uav.impact: The unveiling marks a significant milestone in AWHERO's development, positioning Leonardo to compete for growing unmanned systems market share.

uav.t: Interceptor-S integrated into BOXER RCT30
uav.body: TYTAN's Interceptor-S was integrated into the BOXER RCT30 and showcased during Bundeswehr’s Experimentalserie Land in Munster/Bergen in 2025. KNDS and TYTAN are collaborating to field such solutions to protect against unmanned aerial threats.
uav.impact: This integration demonstrates a concrete step towards protecting land systems from drone threats, showcasing the practical application of C-UAS technologies.

uav.t: Rheinmetall developed RCWS320C-UAS for counter-UAS
uav.body: Rheinmetall developed the RCWS320C-UAS, a remote-controlled weapon station designed to counter unmanned aerial threats. It provides scalable counter-UAS capability for various platforms.
uav.impact: The RCWS320C-UAS enhances air defence by offering reliable, high-precision protection against unmanned aerial threats, ensuring mission success in diverse operational environments.

uav.t: Polish tactical medium range UAV to be developed
uav.body: WB Electronics and Thales signed a cooperation agreement to develop a new Polish tactical medium range UAV under the Gryf programme. The UAV will utilize critical technologies developed by Polish engineers, including software, mission computers, cryptographic systems, and data transmission devices.
uav.impact: This development signifies a significant step towards Polish autonomy in UAV technology, leveraging international cooperation while maintaining control over critical technologies.

uav.t: Proteus unmanned rotary-wing technology demonstrator unveiled
uav.body: Leonardo unveiled the Proteus, a 3-tonne unmanned rotary-wing technology demonstrator, designed to showcase autonomy and payload modularity for the Royal Navy.
uav.impact: Proteus supports the Royal Navy’s Maritime Aviation Transformation strategy, demonstrating advanced autonomous capabilities and modular payload systems to enhance maritime operations.

uav.t: Anduril demonstrated multi-domain launch capabilities of Altius UAVs
uav.body: Anduril demonstrated the multi-domain launch and expeditionary capabilities of the Altius family of systems, executing multiple beyond-line-of-sight launches from partner USVs.
uav.impact: This capability extends Altius’s operational range and flexibility, enabling highly-mobile, unmanned launch points for extended mission coverage.

uav.t: Nammo unveiled modular strike system for UAVs
uav.body: Nammo unveiled a modular strike system for UAVs at Eurosatory 2026, featuring a 66mm high-explosive anti-tank warhead capable of penetrating over 450mm of RHA.
uav.impact: The system's modular design allows operators to select appropriate munitions for target engagement, enhancing UAV combat effectiveness.

uav.t: Rheinmetall's ultra SHORAD system demonstrated superior drone neutralization capabilities
uav.body: Rheinmetall Canada demonstrated its ultra SHORAD system's effectiveness in neutralizing drones at ultra-short ranges in extreme desert conditions during a Saudi Arabia exercise. The system showed resilience and efficiency in various weather conditions.
uav.impact: The system's success in harsh environments and its AI-driven tracker capability significantly enhances operational readiness against drone threats, setting a benchmark for future CUAS development.

uav.t: Daher developed MALE drone demonstrator prototype
uav.body: Daher developed a MALE drone demonstrator prototype in under six months with Thales, integrating Thales' ScaleFlyt avionics system for autonomous flight.
uav.impact: This rapid development showcases Daher's capability to meet defense objectives efficiently, highlighting its expertise in rapid prototyping and autonomous systems.

uav.t: NORINCO unveiled UAV cluster concept
uav.body: NORINCO first unveiled its UAV cluster concept in late 2018, involving the use of several MR40-series and MR150-series multirotor UAVs. These UAVs are fitted with search and targeting sensors and can be armed with a variety of weapons, including guided missiles.
uav.impact: The UAV cluster concept demonstrates NORINCO's capability to adapt to various tactical scenarios, enhancing surveillance and combat effectiveness through coordinated UAV operations.

uav.t: KNDS France demonstrated Centurio X-30 with 30mm cannon
uav.body: KNDS France officially unveiled the Centurio X-30, a new armed robot equipped with a 30mm cannon. The robot was showcased at the IDEX 2024 defense exhibition in Abu Dhabi.
uav.impact: The Centurio X-30 represents a significant advancement in robotic warfare capabilities, offering enhanced firepower and mobility for military operations.

uav.t: COBRA drone performed first flight
uav.body: COBRA, an unmanned aerial vehicle developed by POLARIS Raumflugzeuge in collaboration with Diehl Defence, successfully completed its first flight. The drone is designed to carry and launch the Iris-T air-to-air missile.
uav.impact: The successful first flight of COBRA marks a significant milestone in the development of unmanned combat air vehicles, potentially enhancing air defense capabilities and cost efficiency.

uav.t: VNav software demonstrated on Black Widow drone
uav.body: Red Cat and Palantir successfully completed flight testing of VNav software on the Black Widow drone, which is part of a U.S. Army program. VNav uses edge-based sensor fusion to enable navigation in GPS-denied environments.
uav.impact: The demonstration marks a significant advancement in drone navigation technology, providing the Army with a reliable solution for real-world conditions.

uav.t: Rheinmetall developed an independent observation and reconnaissance system
uav.body: Rheinmetall has developed an independent observation and reconnaissance system that can be mounted on various platforms including vehicles, masts, and tripods. The system includes a sensor head with interface, power electronics, and drive units, and a control and display unit with a monitor, console, joystick, and electronic control unit.
uav.impact: This system enhances situational awareness and reconnaissance capabilities across multiple platforms, providing versatile and integrated sensor and control solutions.

uav.t: Developed surface power technology for drone charging
uav.body: Rheinmetall Canada and Quaze Technologies developed a surface power technology for drone charging, eliminating the need for physical connections and human intervention. The DSTOW™ module facilitates fully unmanned drone operations.
uav.impact: This technology enhances real-time and persistent information gathering on battlefields, improving situational awareness and reducing risks to soldiers.

uav.t: Rheinmetall to deliver autonomous UGVs to Japan
uav.body: Rheinmetall will deliver autonomous UGVs to Japan for testing. The UGVs are designed for missions like resupply and surveillance.
uav.impact: This delivery marks Japan's first fleet of autonomous vehicles, enhancing its capability in unmanned ground operations.

uav.t: Nammo unveiled NMSS UAV dropping 66mm HEAT munition
uav.body: Nammo unveiled the NMSS at Eurosatory 2026, featuring an Orca MRM2-10 UAV dropping a 66mm HEAT munition. The system was demonstrated in a video filmed in Ukraine.
uav.impact: The NMSS showcases advanced precision strike capabilities for UAVs, targeting armoured vehicles and soft targets with significant destructive power.

uav.t: KIZILELMA demonstrated advanced crewed-uncrewed teaming capabilities
uav.body: KIZILELMA, an uncrewed fighter aircraft, demonstrated advanced crewed-uncrewed teaming capabilities in recent tests with the Leonardo M-346 F light fighter. LBA Systems, a joint venture between Leonardo and Baykar, has achieved full operational readiness.
uav.impact: This capability showcases the maturity of LBA Systems' autonomous systems and their integration with manned aircraft, positioning them competitively in the global UAV market.

uav.t: Sentrycs develops autonomous drone threat management system
uav.body: Sentrycs Horizon is an autonomous system for detecting and managing drone threats in real-time, supporting various transmission types and providing early warnings.
uav.impact: This system is significant for enhancing security against DIY drones by offering real-time threat detection and adaptive threat management capabilities.

uav.t: IAI delivers Drone Guard systems to South Asian country
uav.body: IAI is delivering Drone Guard systems to a South Asian country. The system can detect, classify, and defeat drone threats.
uav.impact: The Drone Guard system's ability to handle multiple targets simultaneously and integrate AI for automated detection enhances the country's defense against evolving drone threats.

uav.t: LUNA NG drone received provisional airworthiness certification
uav.body: Rheinmetall's LUNA NG drone has received a provisional airworthiness certification from the Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr, allowing it to operate in regular European airspace. The drone has completed extensive flight trials, including 150 flights and 200 flight hours.
uav.impact: This certification sets a new standard for military drones in Europe, overcoming regulatory barriers and enabling operations over densely populated areas.

uav.t: Tata Advanced Systems developed a next-gen UGV
uav.body: Tata Advanced Systems Limited unveiled a cutting-edge UGV with a payload capacity of up to 1,000 kg, featuring both tracked and wheeled configurations for diverse missions.
uav.impact: The UGV's versatility in logistics support, reconnaissance, and combat roles enhances India's capability for indigenous unmanned systems, improving operational efficiency and soldier safety.

uav.t: India’s KAL 1,000 km-class long-range one-way attack drone
uav.body: IG Defence is developing and positioning the KAL drone for international export. KAL is India’s first indigenous long-range one-way attack drone with a range of 1,000 km.
uav.impact: KAL's capabilities in deep-penetration missions and strategic target engagement make it a significant addition to India's export portfolio, enhancing its reputation in advanced defence technologies.

uav.t: Leonardo completed live trials of ALE with ALTUUS-600 drones
uav.body: Leonardo completed live trials of Air Launched Effects (ALE) using ALTUUS-600 drones, demonstrating the integration of uncrewed aircraft into AW159 helicopter mission systems. The trials involved releasing and controlling drones from host aircraft, gathering real-world performance data.
uav.impact: These trials significantly enhance the survivability of military aircraft and increase force effectiveness by allowing crews to deliver precise effects from a safe distance.

uav.t: Raytheon demonstrated a C-UAS system with a 10 kW laser
uav.body: Raytheon demonstrated a Counter-UAS system at IDEX 2019, featuring a 10 kW laser mounted on an ATV. The system includes optronic sensors and a laser illuminator, with the laser capable of neutralizing multiple drone targets.
uav.impact: The system's ability to consistently shoot down drones and its mobility on an ATV enhance its operational flexibility and effectiveness in countering UAV threats.

uav.t: MQ-28 Ghost Bat completes over 150 flights
uav.body: The MQ-28 Ghost Bat has completed over 150 flights and is being offered to the German Air Force. Rheinmetall will manage the system for Germany.
uav.impact: The partnership ensures Germany can tailor the MQ-28 to its needs, enhancing operational capability and supply security.

uav.t: STM debuted ALPAGU-B, a larger, longer-range loitering munition
uav.body: STM showcased ALPAGU-B, a new fixed-wing loitering munition at SAHA 2026. It is a larger and longer-range version of ALPAGU, designed to enhance 'surgical strike' capabilities.
uav.impact: ALPAGU-B bridges the gap between ALPAGU and long-range loitering munitions, providing a critical force multiplier for special forces and infantry units.

uav.t: Rheinmetall increases Hero drone production
uav.body: Rheinmetall announced an increase in production of the Hero family of strike drones, opening a new facility in Sardinia to support this expansion.
uav.impact: This production boost enhances Rheinmetall's capability to supply advanced strike drones to European defense forces, leveraging the Hero series' combat effectiveness.

uav.t: Demonstrated CUC-T of M-346FA and Kizilelma
uav.body: Baykar and Leonardo demonstrated crewed-uncrewed teaming (CUC-T) of the M-346FA and Kizilelma under the K-Swarm programme. The demonstration involved the M-346FA controlling the Kizilelma, showcasing advanced autonomy and data exchange capabilities.
uav.impact: This milestone advances the development of CUC-T and swarm tactics, enabling more effective coordination between manned and unmanned aircraft, and simplifying integration processes.

uav.t: Polaris completed first flight of Cobra drone prototype
uav.body: Polaris completed the first flight of the Cobra drone prototype, which flew more than 20 km.
uav.impact: The successful flight sets the stage for further development and testing of the Cobra drone, which is designed to launch air-to-air missiles.

uav.t: Raytheon develops Coyote Block 2 with improved sensors and rocket motors
uav.body: Raytheon is developing Coyote Block 2, an advanced suicide drone with improved sensors and rocket motors, adopting a missile-style configuration with a jet engine for enhanced speed and range.
uav.impact: The Coyote Block 2's enhanced capabilities, including increased maneuverability and extended range, significantly improve its effectiveness in engaging distant and larger targets without a substantial cost increase.

uav.t: Kawa UAV's Divyastra Mk3 jet-powered loitering munition flew successfully.
uav.body: Kawa UAV Pvt Ltd achieved the maiden flight of the Divyastra Mk3, India's first indigenous jet-powered loitering munition, within a year of inception. The system features a high-performance jet engine and zero imported critical subsystems.
uav.impact: This development enhances India's precision strike capabilities and supply chain security, minimizing the window for enemy air defenses and ensuring rapid operational scalability.

uav.t: YFQ-44A CCA made its first autonomous flight
uav.body: Anduril's YFQ-44A CCA completed its first autonomous flight in late October 2025, demonstrating semi-autonomous capabilities. The flight was planned and executed with extensive software testing.
uav.impact: This milestone showcases rapid development and integration of autonomy in flight systems, advancing the technology for unmanned combat aircraft.

uav.t: Falco Xplorer completed first test flight campaign
uav.body: Leonardo's Falco Xplorer, a new entry in the Falco family of drones, completed its first test flight campaign at Trapani Birgi military airport in Sicily with Italian Air Force support. The second test campaign will validate its advanced capabilities and certify its fitness to fly.
uav.impact: The successful test flights and certification will enable the Falco Xplorer to operate over populated areas and support public safety, expanding its market reach.

uav.t: Hanwha Aerospace and Agency for Defense Development unveiled prototypes of two domestically developed uncrewed aircraft
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace and South Korea's Agency for Defense Development unveiled prototypes of two domestically developed uncrewed aircraft system engines, marking a significant step in the development of advanced UAV propulsion systems.
uav.impact: This development enhances South Korea's capability to produce advanced UAVs with domestically developed engines, reducing reliance on foreign suppliers and improving the competitiveness of South Korean UAV systems.

uav.t: Nammo unveiled NMSS combining Orqa MRM2-10 UAV with N7 66mm HEAT warhead
uav.body: Nammo unveiled the NMSS at Eurosatory 2026, integrating a Croatian-built Orqa MRM2-10 UAV with its N7 66mm HEAT warhead. Ukrainian forces have adapted the N7 warhead for use with various UAVs.
uav.impact: This modular system demonstrates the trend of battlefield improvisation leading to innovative military solutions, potentially reducing costs and increasing flexibility in anti-armour operations.

uav.t: Rheinmetall develops Mission Master SP2 low-profile A-UGS
uav.body: Rheinmetall is developing the Mission Master SP2, a next-generation low-profile Autonomous Uncrewed Ground System (A-UGS) designed to assist soldiers and reduce danger in various missions. The system is networked with Rheinmetall’s soldier system and command and control software.
uav.impact: The Mission Master SP2 represents a significant advancement in A-UGS technology, offering enhanced capabilities for soldier support and mission flexibility, potentially setting new standards in military assistance systems.

uav.t: ASELSAN demonstrated integrated Drone Defense System
uav.body: ASELSAN demonstrated an integrated Drone Defense System in Ankara, showcasing coordination of IHTAR, GÖKBERK, and EJDERHA systems. The demo validated a layered defense approach.
uav.impact: The demonstration highlights ASELSAN's advanced capabilities in countering UAV threats, integrating detection, soft-kill, and hard-kill methods.

uav.t: Lockheed Martin demonstrated Vectis drone
uav.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated the Vectis drone, a large UAV designed for multi-domain interaction and long-range missions. Vectis, developed by Skunk Works, is intended to support fifth-generation fighters and has stealth features.
uav.impact: Vectis represents a significant advancement in drone technology, enhancing multi-domain operations and providing support for advanced fighter aircraft.

uav.t: Hanwha and GA-ASI to co-develop Gray Eagle STOL UAV
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace and GA-ASI signed an agreement to co-develop the Gray Eagle STOL UAV, which requires only a 100 m runway for take-off and landing.
uav.impact: This development enhances the operational flexibility of UAVs, allowing them to be deployed from smaller airfields and naval platforms.

uav.t: Hermes 900 StarLiner UAS launched
uav.body: Elbit Systems launched the Hermes 900 StarLiner, a MALE UAS with adverse weather capabilities and NATO STANAG 4671 compliance. It has been performing Civil Aviation Authority certified flights.
uav.impact: The Hermes 900 StarLiner's ability to safely operate in civilian airspace alongside manned aircraft addresses a growing demand for advanced yet mature UAS in Europe.

uav.t: Saab developing uncrewed demonstrators with fighter-like characteristics
uav.body: Saab is developing uncrewed demonstrators with fighter-like characteristics to complement future combat air capabilities. These demonstrators are intended to fly before 2030.
uav.impact: The development of these uncrewed demonstrators could enhance Sweden's future combat air capabilities, particularly in high-risk missions such as electronic warfare and precision strikes.

uav.t: Nexter Robotics updates NERVA® S with thermal imaging camera
uav.body: Nexter Robotics updated its NERVA® S robot with a thermal imaging camera at CANSEC 2017. The NERVA® family includes various robots designed for defence and safety applications.
uav.impact: The addition of thermal imaging enhances the robot's surveillance and detection capabilities, making it more versatile for defence missions.

uav.t: Lockheed Martin developing Vectis CCA UAV
uav.body: Lockheed Martin Skunk Works is developing the Vectis CCA, a Group 5 UAV designed for advanced air dominance and seamless integration with fifth- and next-generation aircraft.
uav.impact: Vectis aims to provide unparalleled air dominance and integrated capabilities at a competitive speed and price point, advancing the 'family of systems' concept.

uav.t: Sheshnaag-150 long-range swarming attack drone demonstrated
uav.body: Sheshnaag-150 is a long-range, swarming one-way attack drone developed by NewSpace Research & Technologies. It made its public debut at Aero India 2025 and was used during the 2025 India–Pakistan conflict.
uav.impact: The drone's capability to autonomously track, detect, and destroy targets, with a range of 15–1,000 km, enhances India's strategic military options in contested regions.

uav.t: Threod Systems unveils Eos D ISTAR VTOL drone
uav.body: Threod Systems unveiled the Eos D ISTAR, a new-generation small VTOL drone at Eurosatory. The drone integrates a high-capability sensor system for laser designation and reconnaissance.
uav.impact: The Eos D ISTAR enhances Threod Systems' capability to provide advanced UAV solutions for laser designation and reconnaissance, leveraging combat feedback from Ukraine.

uav.t: KHRONOS tethered drone deployed in under 2 minutes
uav.body: Elistair demonstrated the KHRONOS, a tethered drone that can deploy in under two minutes and stay aloft for up to 24 hours. The drone covers an area 10 kilometers in radius and provides continuous day/night coverage.
uav.impact: KHRONOS's rapid deployment and long endurance make it a valuable asset for persistent surveillance and emergency communications, enhancing situational awareness for military and civilian applications.

uav.t: RMAF flight tested Anka-THS MALE drone
uav.body: The Royal Malaysian Air Force (RMAF) conducted the first flight test of the Anka-THS medium-altitude, long-endurance (MALE) drone in Malaysian airspace.
uav.impact: This flight test represents a significant step in the operational readiness and capability of the RMAF to deploy advanced surveillance and reconnaissance systems.

uav.t: Developed AI-powered platform to neutralize fiber-optic threats
uav.body: Axon Vision developed an AI-powered platform called ForceField to neutralize fiber-optic threats. The system was demonstrated in live-fire trials and is now part of a layered defense strategy.
uav.impact: The ForceField system addresses a specific threat from fiber-optic drones, enhancing the military's ability to counter modern drone threats effectively.

uav.t: Wired microdrone integrated on vehicle
uav.body: ARASTELLE developed a wired microdrone that can remain in flight up to 100m altitude, integrated by ARQUUS into various vehicles. The system enables rapid deployment and automated take-off and landing.
uav.impact: This innovation enhances surveillance and tactical options for ground vehicles, providing persistent aerial coverage without the need for modifications to existing micro-UAVs.

uav.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates Skyspotter drone detection system
uav.body: Rheinmetall showcased the Skyspotter drone detection system at Eurosatory 2026, designed to protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. The system uses multi-sensor technology to detect, identify, and track airborne threats in real-time.
uav.impact: Skyspotter addresses the growing concern of targeted drone attacks on critical infrastructure, enhancing security forces' ability to respond to hybrid threats.

uav.t: Elta Systems demonstrated SAR/GMTI UAV payloads
uav.body: Elta Systems Group demonstrated SAR/GMTI payloads for UAVs, which can operate in all weather conditions and provide high-quality images for target tracking.
uav.impact: The demonstration of SAR/GMTI payloads enhances UAVs' ability to conduct persistent surveillance and target tracking in various weather conditions, significantly improving operational effectiveness.

uav.t: Leonardo's Proteus unmanned helicopter completed first flight
uav.body: Leonardo's Proteus unmanned helicopter completed its maiden flight, demonstrating its autonomous capabilities. The flight follows extensive ground tests and is part of a £60m programme.
uav.impact: The successful flight supports the Royal Navy's strategic plan for a 'New Hybrid Navy' with autonomous systems, marking a significant step in the development of full-sized autonomous helicopters.

uav.t: tested UAV control from Eurofighter in synthetic env
uav.body: BAE Systems and QinetiQ tested UAV control from a Eurofighter Typhoon in a synthetic environment, validating connectivity and interoperability. The trials will inform future ACP design and development.
uav.impact: This advance enhances the Eurofighter's capability to integrate with UAVs, improving overall mission flexibility and efficiency.

uav.t: Microdrone system integrated on vehicles for surveillance
uav.body: Arastelle developed a microdrone system for Arquus vehicles, enabling quick deployment and enhanced surveillance. The system is compatible with existing microdrones without modifications.
uav.impact: This system provides ground forces with aerial surveillance capabilities, enhancing tactical options and situational awareness.

uav.t: Hanwha Aerospace developing 4,500-lbf UAV engine
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace is developing a 4,500-lbf-class turbofan engine for UAVs and collaborative combat aircraft, with KASA funding. The engine will integrate a starter-generator on the engine shaft and aims to be delivered by 2029.
uav.impact: This development marks a significant step towards South Korea's domestic engine capability for UAVs, enhancing the country's autonomy in military aviation.

uav.t: Bug nano drone delivered to British Army
uav.body: BAE Systems and UAVTEK delivered 30 units of the Bug nano drone to the British Army. The drone, weighing 196g, has a 40-minute battery life and a 2km range.
uav.impact: The Bug drone's ability to operate in strong winds and harsh weather conditions sets it apart, making it a valuable asset for the British Army in various operational scenarios.

uav.t: Thales demonstrated GO20 MM radar for early detection of hostile drones
uav.body: Thales unveiled the GO20 MM radar, designed for early detection and classification of drones and low-flying threats. The radar offers 360-degree coverage and is intended to protect military camps and convoys.
uav.impact: The GO20 MM radar enhances situational awareness and defense capabilities against unmanned aerial threats, providing a critical layer of protection for military assets.

uav.t: Argentine Army displayed upgraded UGV technology demonstrators
uav.body: The Argentine Army displayed upgraded UGV technology demonstrators at a military ceremony, showcasing the PM EA 1 UGV with FPV deployment capability and the Kabuto UGV with a gyrostabilised turret and MAG machine gun.
uav.impact: These developments enhance the Argentine Army's capability for reconnaissance and support missions, integrating advanced features like FPVs and machine guns.

uav.t: Elbit Systems debuted Hermes 45 UAS with 200km range
uav.body: Elbit Systems introduced the Hermes 45 UAS at the Paris Airshow 2019, featuring a 200km flight range and multi-payload capability. The system supports various payloads including EO/IR, marine radar, terrain dominance, EW, and communications.
uav.impact: The Hermes 45 expands Elbit Systems' UAS portfolio, offering enhanced surveillance and operational flexibility with its extended range and payload versatility.

uav.t: Elbit Systems demonstrated Hydrop system for high-altitude aerial firefighting
uav.body: Elbit Systems demonstrated the Hydrop system, enabling high-precision aerial firefighting from 500-2,000 ft, integrating fighter aircraft avionics and allowing night flights.
uav.impact: Hydrop significantly enhances aerial firefighting by improving safety, operational flexibility, and effectiveness through high-altitude precision drops.

uav.t: Rheinmetall unveils Mission Master UGV
uav.body: Rheinmetall unveiled the Mission Master UGV, which is now in production. The vehicle features autonomous capability and remote control via a detachable touch screen.
uav.impact: The Mission Master's autonomous and remote-controlled capabilities, along with its modular design, enhance operational flexibility and efficiency for military applications.

uav.t: Anduril unveils Roadrunner-M, a VTOL drone with high-explosive interceptor
uav.body: Anduril Industries has unveiled the Roadrunner-M, a VTOL drone designed to destroy aerial threats. It can be reused for surveillance or used in a kamikaze-like fashion.
uav.impact: The Roadrunner-M offers a versatile solution for aerial defense, capable of intercepting a range of threats from small loitering munitions to full-sized aircraft.

uav.t: STING counter-UAS munition available for deployment
uav.body: Helix Defense announced the STING counter-UAS munition, designed to defeat drone threats in the last 100 meters. It has completed testing and evaluations with U.S. Army and Special Operations organizations.
uav.impact: STING provides a critical solution for close-range drone threats, enhancing last-layer defense capabilities.

uav.t: BAE Systems demonstrated Brontanax, a British unmanned combat air vehicle prototype
uav.body: BAE Systems presented Brontanax, a British unmanned combat air vehicle prototype, at the Farnborough International Airshow. The prototype is being prepared for ground tests and its first flight.
uav.impact: Brontanax represents a significant step in the development of British unmanned combat capabilities, potentially enhancing the country's air warfare strategy.

uav.t: BAE Systems and Lockheed Martin develop autonomous drone Blizzard
uav.body: BAE Systems and Lockheed Martin are developing an autonomous drone named Blizzard, which is designed to operate alongside piloted aircraft and has open architecture.
uav.impact: Blizzard's ability to operate without GPS and dynamically reassign tasks enhances its flexibility and resilience in diverse combat scenarios.

uav.t: Terra Drone supplies Terra B1 interceptor drone
uav.body: Terra Drone is supplying the Terra B1 interceptor drone to Japan’s Self-Defense Forces under a fast-tracked selection process. The drone is intended for trials to defend military bases and naval vessels.
uav.impact: The Terra B1 interceptor drone aims to address the growing threat of unmanned aerial threats to Japan’s military infrastructure, enhancing its defensive capabilities.

uav.t: Rheinmetall's Mission Master UGV dominated ELROB 2018 competition
uav.body: Rheinmetall's Mission Master unmanned vehicle dominated the Mule category at ELROB 2018, scoring 3,151 points in its first competition appearance. The vehicle is designed for autonomous transport and heavy load carrying.
uav.impact: The Mission Master's performance highlights its advanced capabilities in autonomous operations and logistics support, positioning it as a leading system in military ground robotics.

uav.t: Themis-K UGV with RCWS demonstrated
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace demonstrated the Themis-K, a multi-purpose UGV integrating its RCWS, alongside other UGVs. The Themis-K showcases MUM-T capabilities.
uav.impact: The Themis-K's integration with RCWS and MUM-T capabilities enhances its utility in future combat scenarios, improving battlefield flexibility and efficiency.

uav.t: Rheinmetall displayed unmanned multimission wheeled vehicle
