uav.body: Rheinmetall showcased an unmanned multimission wheeled vehicle with modular design, capable of reconnaissance, surveillance, and transport roles. It can be remotely controlled or operate autonomously.
uav.impact: This unmanned vehicle enhances infantry combat operations by providing rapid reconnaissance and action capabilities, especially in complex and urban terrains.

uav.t: Nexter Robotics proposes a 20mm armed ground robot
uav.body: Nexter Robotics has proposed a ground robot armed with a 20mm cannon. The robot is part of a growing trend in military robotics, with other countries also developing similar systems.
uav.impact: This development signifies an advancement in autonomous combat systems, potentially altering battlefield dynamics and raising ethical considerations.

uav.t: KNDS Deutschland demonstrated EW/C-UAV-Sensorpaket module
uav.body: KNDS Deutschland demonstrated the EW/C-UAV-Sensorpaket module for the THeMIS unmanned ground vehicle, featuring radar, multisensor camera, RF scanner, and jamming systems.
uav.impact: The module enhances THeMIS's capability to detect, identify, and counter unmanned aerial threats, providing a comprehensive electronic warfare solution.

uav.t: ROKAF plans AI-piloted aircraft by early 2030s
uav.body: ROKAF plans to field AI-piloted aircraft by the early 2030s to fly alongside KAI F-50 and KF-21 fighters, aiming to strengthen its force with attritable uncrewed aircraft.
uav.impact: This development will enhance ROKAF's operational flexibility and combat effectiveness by integrating AI-driven UAVs with manned fighter jets.

uav.t: IAI unveils HERON MK II UAV with extended range
uav.body: IAI will unveil the HERON MK II UAV at the Singapore Airshow, featuring improved altitude, speed, and endurance. The UAV has a wider and stronger body structure, enabling new configurations and carrying a wide range of payloads.
uav.impact: The HERON MK II's extended capabilities enhance its utility for long-range surveillance and intelligence gathering, providing strategic advantages in border monitoring and standoff operations.

uav.t: AVIC flight-tested a hybrid energy-powered UAV
uav.body: AVIC unveiled and flight-tested a hybrid energy-powered UAV in 2026, featuring a 'three-in-one' power system combining solar cells, hydrogen fuel cells, and lithium batteries. The UAV is designed for low-altitude surveillance and reconnaissance.
uav.impact: The UAV's innovative power system extends operational endurance by approximately 10% and optimizes energy management, enhancing surveillance capabilities for the PLA.

uav.t: Lockheed Martin demonstrated control of three unmanned systems
uav.body: Lockheed Martin completed Phase 2 tests of a centralized controller for unmanned air and ground systems, demonstrating control of three different unmanned systems. The latest prototype incorporates a touch screen, hand grips, and several switches.
uav.impact: This advancement reduces risk for the U.S. Army’s Future Combat System Centralized Controller Device by enabling control of multiple unmanned systems with a single device.

uav.t: Saab is developing a sixth-generation fighter aircraft
uav.body: Saab is developing a sixth-generation fighter aircraft and has chosen to participate in the FCAS program rather than Tempest. The F-series includes Gripen E/F and a new piloted bomber, along with three classes of drones.
uav.impact: Saab's F-series program represents a significant advancement in aerial combat systems, integrating advanced fighter jets and a range of drones to enhance air dominance capabilities.

uav.t: Arquus demonstrates DRAILER, a robotic ground platform
uav.body: Arquus showcases the DRAILER, a robotic ground platform designed to support units and enhance operational capabilities. The DRAILER can carry up to 750 kg and achieve an autonomy of up to 200 km.
uav.impact: The DRAILER's modular design and advanced autonomy capabilities significantly enhance the mobility and flexibility of military units on challenging terrains.

uav.t: Airbus unveiled U760 Ravenstorm drone
uav.body: Airbus unveiled the U760 Ravenstorm drone at ILA 2026, designed for multidomain operations. It is a collaborative combat drone based on previous work like the LOUT project.
uav.impact: The U760 Ravenstorm represents a significant step in developing advanced unmanned systems for future combat scenarios, enhancing multidomain operational capabilities.

uav.t: India reveals first indigenous MALE drone Drishti 10 Starliner
uav.body: India unveiled the Drishti 10 Starliner, an indigenous MALE drone with over 70% Indian content, designed for ISR. It has a 36-hour endurance and can carry a 450 kg payload.
uav.impact: The Drishti 10 Starliner's high Indian content and NATO certification signify a significant step in India's self-reliance in military drone technology.

uav.t: MQ-28 Ghost Bat completed over 150 test flights
uav.body: The MQ-28 Ghost Bat, an autonomous combat aircraft, has completed over 150 test flights. It is being developed in Australia and is adaptable for the German Air Force.
uav.impact: The extensive testing indicates significant progress towards operational readiness, highlighting its capability for manned-unmanned teaming in contested airspace.

uav.t: Paramount launches N-Raven long-range swarming UAV
uav.body: Paramount Group has launched the N-Raven, a 41 kg UAV with a range of 250 km and loitering capabilities. It can carry 10-15 kg payloads and operates covertly in contested environments.
uav.impact: The N-Raven enhances surveillance and strike capabilities, reducing risk to personnel and minimizing collateral damage.

uav.t: TOUTATIS short-range loitering munition developed
uav.body: Thales developed TOUTATIS, a short-range loitering munition for high-intensity conflicts. It can be deployed by dismounted soldiers and launched from various platforms.
uav.impact: TOUTATIS provides a versatile operational advantage, resistant to jamming and equipped with a mission-configurable warhead, enhancing target neutralization capabilities.

uav.t: Developed autonomous IED detection and neutralization system
uav.body: Israel Aerospace Industries has developed an autonomous system for detecting and neutralizing IEDs. The system uses multiple sensors and a robotic platform to operate in complex terrains without endangering human life.
uav.impact: This system significantly enhances the safety of military personnel by autonomously detecting and neutralizing IEDs in dangerous environments.

uav.t: Anduril unveiled Thunder, a large tilt-rotor attack drone
uav.body: Anduril unveiled Thunder, a large tilt-rotor attack drone capable of flying at altitudes higher than 18,000 feet. It can carry 76 weapons or up to 16 Air Launched Effects.
uav.impact: Thunder's capabilities in carrying a large number of weapons and effects make it a formidable addition to aerial combat and defense systems.

uav.t: xCell 3D printer deployed on USS Essex
uav.body: Firestorm Labs deployed xCell, a 3D printer aboard USS Essex, to produce drones and spare parts without shore resupply. Service members assembled drones and printed repair parts to assess the printer's efficacy.
uav.impact: xCell enables naval vessels to produce drones and parts locally, reducing logistical burdens and enhancing operational flexibility.

uav.t: TerMIT 2.0 UGV production in Finland
uav.body: Insta Advance and Tencore plan to manufacture TerMIT 2.0 UGVs in Finland to support Ukraine's defense needs. The cooperation aims to integrate Ukrainian solutions into Finland’s industrial ecosystem.
uav.impact: This production cooperation will accelerate delivery of UGVs to Ukraine and strengthen Finland's production continuity and supply security.

uav.t: Leonardo demonstrates new Falco drone with dual capabilities
uav.body: Leonardo showcased a new Falco drone at Le Bourget with enhanced dual capabilities, including satellite communication and improved sensor systems. The new drone can reach altitudes over 7,000 meters and has a high-mounted wing structure for external loads.
uav.impact: This new Falco variant expands Leonardo's tactical-strategic platform offerings, leveraging its extensive experience since 2017, and positions the company to compete in advanced drone markets with enhanced ISR and combat surveillance capabilities.

uav.t: Rheinmetall Mission Master SP fired Thales FZ275 70mm LGRs
uav.body: Rheinmetall demonstrated its Mission Master SP A-UGV firing Thales FZ275 70mm LGRs at a 4km range during a live-fire drill in Sweden. The drill marked the successful qualification of the Fieldranger Multi weapon station with the Thales rocket launcher.
uav.impact: This demonstration showcases the Mission Master SP's capability to provide precise and effective fire support, extending the reach of guided rocket systems to autonomous ground vehicles.

uav.t: DOK-ING develops modular heavy-duty hybrid platform Komodo
uav.body: DOK-ING has developed the Komodo, a modular heavy-duty hybrid platform with a payload capacity of over 8.5 tonnes. Rheinmetall is contributing functional modules and equipment kits to enhance the platform.
uav.impact: The Komodo platform, combined with Rheinmetall's expertise, aims to set new standards for unmanned ground systems and pave the way for series production and deployment.

uav.t: Anduril demonstrated Thunder unmanned combat VTOL concept
uav.body: Anduril, in collaboration with Archer Aviation, demonstrated the Thunder unmanned combat VTOL concept. It can carry up to 10 guided missiles and 16 unguided bombs, and is equipped with a hybrid electric power system and advanced AI.
uav.impact: The Thunder's capability to carry a mix of guided and unguided weapons, coupled with autonomous decision-making and coordination, marks a significant advancement in unmanned combat vehicle technology.

uav.t: Rheinmetall and DOK-ING form joint venture for unmanned vehicles
uav.body: Rheinmetall AG and Croatian company DOK-ING formed a joint venture to develop unmanned vehicles, combining DOK-ING’s expertise with Rheinmetall’s global capabilities.
uav.impact: This partnership aims to establish Croatia as a hub for advanced defence technology development and manufacturing, leveraging local expertise and global market access.

uav.t: France completed C-UAS rocket integration for Rafale
uav.body: France completed the integration of Thales' 68 mm Aculeus LGR on Rafale aircraft for C-UAS role. It will be rolled out operationally to French Air and Space Force and Navy.
uav.impact: This cost-effective solution will replace high-value missiles for C-UAS, enhancing operational efficiency and readiness.

uav.t: SAASM Real-Time Kinematic GPS receiver demonstrated
uav.body: Collins Aerospace has demonstrated a SAASM Real-Time Kinematic GPS receiver for unmanned aircraft systems, offering centimeter-level accuracy and SAASM security. This system is part of a suite of advanced guidance and control systems used in over twenty types of UAS.
uav.impact: The SAASM GPS receiver significantly enhances the precision and security of unmanned systems, crucial for military and critical infrastructure applications.

uav.t: Adani Defence & Aerospace unveiled Drishti 10 Starliner UAV
uav.body: Adani Defence & Aerospace unveiled and handed over the Drishti 10 Starliner UAV, an advanced ISR platform with 36 hours endurance and 450 kg payload capacity, certified by NATO’s STANAG 4671.
uav.impact: The Drishti 10 Starliner's certification and capabilities represent a significant step towards indigenous defence capabilities in India, aligning with the Navy's requirements.

uav.t: Attack helicopters equipped with micro-missiles for drone hunting
uav.body: The Indian Air Force is transforming its attack helicopters into specialised drone hunters by equipping them with micro-missiles. These compact weapons are tailored for slow-moving, low-altitude aerial targets and were validated during Exercise Rotor Clapp-III.
uav.impact: The micro-missiles are particularly effective against swarming drones, enhancing the IAF's capability to address complex challenges posed by unmanned systems and complementing ground-based air defence networks.

uav.t: Rheinmetall Mission Master SP A-UGV qualified with Thales 70mm rocket launcher
uav.body: Rheinmetall demonstrated its Mission Master SP A-UGV equipped with Thales 70mm rocket launchers at a Swedish base for six European allies. The system is now qualified for integration into other platforms.
uav.impact: This qualification enhances the Mission Master SP's capability for precision fire support, offering a significant advantage in modern warfare scenarios.

uav.t: Lithuania develops ultra-compact UAV laser systems
uav.body: Lithuania, through Aktyvus Photonics, is developing ultra-compact UAV laser systems for extreme environments. This technology aims to provide a specialized niche in defense readiness.
uav.impact: The development of these systems allows Lithuania to reduce reliance on traditional arms powers and achieve strategic military independence.

uav.t: Coyote Block 3 Non-Kinetic defeated drone swarms
uav.body: Raytheon's Coyote Block 3 Non-Kinetic system successfully defeated multiple drone swarms during an exercise, showcasing its launch, flight, intercept, and recovery capabilities.
uav.impact: The system's non-kinetic payload minimizes collateral damage and allows for cost-effective defense against drone swarms, providing a significant operational advantage.

uav.t: Rheinmetall delivers LUNA NG reconnaissance drone
uav.body: Rheinmetall has delivered the LUNA NG reconnaissance drone to Ukraine, which has already seen active deployment. The drone can remain aloft for over 12 hours and has a datalink range of up to 300 kilometres.
uav.impact: The LUNA NG's real-time reconnaissance capabilities significantly enhance operational effectiveness, providing critical intelligence at the tactical level.

uav.t: Hanwha showcases 6x6 UGCV TAIpers with ATGMs
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace demonstrated a 6x6 UGCV named TAIpers at ADEX 2023, featuring six ready-to-fire ATGMs. The vehicle was previously unveiled at MSPO 2023.
uav.impact: The TAIpers UGCV, with its ATGM armament and potential for lightweight composite armour, enhances South Korea's capability for unmanned ground combat operations.

uav.t: BAE Systems unveiled Brontanax, UK's first uncrewed autonomous Collaborative Combat Aircraft
uav.body: BAE Systems unveiled Brontanax, an uncrewed autonomous Collaborative Combat Aircraft, at the Farnborough International Airshow. The aircraft is designed to provide electronic warfare and precision strike capabilities.
uav.impact: Brontanax represents a significant advancement in autonomous combat aircraft technology, enhancing the UK's capabilities in electronic warfare and precision strike.

uav.t: Uncrewed rotorcraft demonstrator unveiled
uav.body: Leonardo, UK DE&S, and Royal Navy unveiled the Proteus uncrewed rotorcraft demonstrator. The maiden flight is scheduled for mid-2025.
uav.impact: Proteus represents a significant step in the development of autonomous naval aviation capabilities.

uav.t: Co-development of Aarok MALE UAV
uav.body: Turgis Gaillard and Bharat Forge are co-developing the Aarok MALE UAV in India, focusing on production and integration. Aarok is designed for ISR and combat missions.
uav.impact: This partnership enhances India's sovereign defence capability and aligns with domestic manufacturing policies, addressing the Indian armed forces' substantial requirements.

uav.t: USAF conducts tests of Anduril's YFQ-44A CCA drone
uav.body: USAF's EOU conducted hands-on tests of Anduril's YFQ-44A CCA drone, focusing on operational concepts and tactics. The drone was designed for ease of operation and minimal infrastructure needs.
uav.impact: The tests highlight the drone's potential for rapid deployment and reduced logistical footprint, aligning with USAF's strategic objectives for combat readiness.

uav.t: LUNA NG drone successfully tested in swarm and reconnaissance
uav.body: Rheinmetall's LUNA NG drone was successfully tested in a swarm and reconnaissance network, demonstrating time savings in target detection and counter-attack.
uav.impact: The test highlights LUNA NG's capability to integrate into digitalized reconnaissance networks, enhancing operational efficiency and responsiveness.

uav.t: SPEAR ™ family enables UAVs to outsmart radar threats
uav.body: Elbit Systems’ SPEAR ™ family enables UAVs, jet fighters, and small tactical drones to outsmart radar systems, enhancing their survivability in hostile territories.
uav.impact: This capability significantly improves the operational range and effectiveness of UAVs by enabling them to evade detection and relay critical information back to headquarters.

uav.t: Rheinmetall developed FIRST IRST for 360° coverage
uav.body: Rheinmetall developed the FIRST InfraRed Search and Track system for 360° coverage with short reaction times. It can detect various aerial targets including UAVs, helicopters, and missiles.
uav.impact: FIRST's high sensor sensitivity and resolution provide superior detection capabilities compared to radar systems, enhancing situational awareness and defense against aerial threats.

uav.t: Anduril unveils Thunder, a hybrid-electric armed drone gunship
uav.body: Thunder is a hybrid-electric drone gunship designed to enhance combat power and survivability of Apache helicopters. It can carry various payloads including missiles, rockets, and electronic warfare systems.
uav.impact: Thunder's modular payload system and hybrid-electric powertrain offer significant operational flexibility and efficiency, potentially revolutionizing aerial combat support.

uav.t: Leonardo unveils new Falco unmanned air system with enhanced capabilities
uav.body: Leonardo unveiled a new iteration of the Falco unmanned air system at a preview event in Rome, featuring a maximum take-off weight of 1,250 kg, 24-hour endurance, and a 350 kg payload capacity. The new platform includes a more powerful engine, larger wings, and a 'V' rear empennage structure.
uav.impact: The new Falco iteration, classified as a light MALE, represents a significant advancement in unmanned aerial surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities, positioning it to compete with systems like the Predator 1A.

uav.t: KNDS developed Boxer UxV CS drone command module
uav.body: KNDS Deutschland demonstrated the Boxer UxV CS drone command module at Enforce Tac 2026, designed to manage multiple unmanned systems. The module optimizes communication range and data flow for simultaneous control of air and ground systems.
uav.impact: The Boxer UxV CS module enhances operational flexibility and efficiency by enabling centralized control of various unmanned systems, advancing the integration of unmanned platforms in future military doctrines.

uav.t: Leonardo demonstrated Falco Xplorer UAV
uav.body: Leonardo presented Falco Xplorer, a large drone with a 350 kg payload and 24-hour endurance. It will be certified to NATO standards and delivered next year.
uav.impact: Falco Xplorer's capabilities and certification to NATO standards position it as a competitive and immediately operational system for international markets.

uav.t: Elbit Systems demonstrates SkylarkTM 3 Hybrid STUAS
uav.body: Elbit Systems will showcase the SkylarkTM 3 Hybrid STUAS at Singapore Airshow 2022, featuring a hybrid propulsion system that triples endurance to up to 18 hours of operations.
uav.impact: The Skylark 3 Hybrid's extended endurance and dual payload capacity enhance its utility for long-duration surveillance and reconnaissance missions.

uav.t: Lockheed Martin debuted MORFIUS X-rotor HPM counter-drone system
uav.body: Lockheed Martin introduced the MORFIUS X-rotor, a high-powered microwave counter-drone system designed to target multiple drones simultaneously. The system builds on earlier MORFIUS HPM systems that have been in experimental use since 2017.
uav.impact: The MORFIUS X-rotor represents a significant advancement in countering drone threats, capable of neutralizing over 50 drones at once, enhancing defense capabilities against swarm attacks.

uav.t: Lockheed Martin demonstrates MORFIUS X-Rotor HPM drone hunter
uav.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated the MORFIUS X-Rotor, a reusable high-power microwave system capable of disabling up to 50 drones. It integrates with existing military networks and is set for additional flight tests.
uav.impact: The MORFIUS X-Rotor sets a new benchmark for counter-drone capability, offering a high kill rate at a low cost, aligning with the US DoD's counter-UAS roadmap.

uav.t: NewSpace Research and Technologies demonstrated Sheshnaag 150 swarm drone
uav.body: NewSpace Research and Technologies showcased the Sheshnaag 150 at the World Defense Show, a 1,000+ km range swarm drone with a 25 to 40 kg payload.
uav.impact: The Sheshnaag 150 represents a significant advancement in long-range collaborative loitering munitions, targeting deep strike missions with enhanced precision and payload flexibility.

uav.t: Hellhound S3 drone range increased to 60 km
uav.body: Cummings Aerospace demonstrated Hellhound S3's extended range of 60 km after tests in September. The drone can now fly one and a half times further than its previous 40 km range.
uav.impact: This range enhancement allows Hellhound S3 to cover larger areas and potentially engage targets at greater distances, enhancing its operational flexibility.

uav.t: Patria and General Cherry to develop drones in Finland
uav.body: Patria and General Cherry signed a letter of intent to develop drones in Finland, combining General Cherry’s expertise in small drones with Patria’s unmanned-technology experience.
uav.impact: This collaboration aims to meet Western European defense needs and enhance Europe’s defense capabilities.

uav.t: Rheinmetall Mission Master participates in Dutch army experimentation
uav.body: Rheinmetall's Mission Master autonomous vehicle is participating in a multi-year experimentation phase for the Dutch army's future combat units. The vehicle has been tested in the Netherlands and Scotland and is now part of a two-year CD&E program.
uav.impact: This participation highlights the evolving role of autonomous systems in modern military operations, potentially influencing future combat unit designs.

uav.t: Fiber-optic FPV tethered drones demonstrated
uav.body: Hezbollah demonstrated fiber-optic FPV tethered drones in southern Lebanon, which rely on a direct link to the operator via a spool of fiber-optic cable.
uav.impact: These drones are immune to jamming and electronic warfare measures, providing a significant battlefield advantage.

uav.t: SGT STOUT demonstrated expanded effectiveness against Group 1-2 UAS
uav.body: SGT STOUT, developed by Leonardo DRS, demonstrated expanded effectiveness against smaller Group 1-2 UAS threats without adding new hardware, through software updates. This highlights the system's scalability and operational flexibility.
uav.impact: The demonstration underscores SGT STOUT's adaptability and robustness in countering a broader range of UAS threats, enhancing its utility in diverse operational scenarios.

uav.t: Developed S-MET unmanned ground vehicle prototype
uav.body: American Rheinmetall Vehicles is developing an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) prototype for the US Army's S-MET program, leveraging the Mission Master family of unmanned vehicles.
uav.impact: This development advances the capability of unmanned systems in tactical operations, providing the US Army with a versatile and autonomous vehicle for various missions.

uav.t: Demonstrated autonomous teaming in ALE swarm
uav.body: ALTIUS demonstrated autonomous teaming capabilities in the largest air-launched effects (ALE) swarm at US Army Project EDGE 22. Multiple ALTIUS platforms operated collaboratively, showcasing coordinated mission capabilities.
uav.impact: This demonstration significantly advances the capability for coordinated, autonomous operations in UAV swarms, enhancing battlefield situational awareness and effectiveness.

uav.t: LUNA NG UAV in final phase of certification
uav.body: Rheinmetall's LUNA NG UAV is in the final phase of certification and will be delivered to the German Ministry of Defense. The UAV can operate in both traditional ISR roles and sensor-to-shooter missions.
uav.impact: The certification and delivery of LUNA NG to the German MoD signifies its readiness for operational use, enhancing the military's capabilities in surveillance and targeted operations.

uav.t: Thales unveiled GO 20 MM radar for UAV detection
uav.body: Thales unveiled the Ground Observer 20 Multi-Mission (GO 20 MM) radar, designed for continuous 360° 3D detection and tracking of UAVs and other low-level air threats. The radar provides automatic classification and protection for troops in various scenarios.
uav.impact: The GO 20 MM radar enhances situational awareness and security for military units by effectively detecting and classifying UAVs and other threats, thereby improving defensive capabilities.

uav.t: GLADIUS demonstrated interoperability with NATO systems
uav.body: GLADIUS, an unmanned reconnaissance and strike system, was demonstrated during the Baltic Shield exercise, showing its ability to operate seamlessly in an allied environment and confirming full interoperability with NATO systems.
uav.impact: This interoperability enhances NATO's ability to integrate Polish and Swedish forces, strengthening the alliance's eastern flank.

uav.t: Light SPEAR detects and counters hostile emissions in real-time
uav.body: Light SPEAR is a system that detects and counters hostile emissions in real-time, mounted on UAVs to enhance their survivability. It provides fast awareness and answers by integrating the detection and response process.
uav.impact: This capability significantly enhances UAV survivability by enabling real-time countermeasures against hostile signals, reducing the need for manual intervention and analysis.

uav.t: N3X Labs developed HMV-mounted UAV launcher
uav.body: N3X Labs developed a HMV-mounted UAV launcher for their Wrath UAV, using a 'shoot-and-scoot' tactic to enhance mobility and reduce vulnerability. The launcher features a modular quick-swap magazine and onboard software for fire control.
uav.impact: This launcher concept addresses operational challenges in contested environments by enabling rapid relocation and quick reloading, enhancing the survivability and flexibility of UAV operations.

uav.t: Teledyne FLIR launches Black Recon autonomous micro-drone
uav.body: Teledyne FLIR has launched the Black Recon, an autonomous micro-drone designed for persistent situational awareness and ISR deployment. It features autonomous launch, recovery, and recharge capabilities, enabling near-continuous overwatch.
uav.impact: Black Recon enhances ground forces' reconnaissance capabilities by providing persistent surveillance, faster access to actionable intelligence, and supporting continuous target tracking.

uav.t: BAE Systems developing ducted-fan UAV for DARPA
uav.body: DARPA selected BAE Systems to develop a ducted-fan UAV for diverse missions including reconnaissance, surveillance, and targeting. The contract calls for the development and demonstration of the UAV.
uav.impact: This development enhances DARPA's capability to support diverse military operations with advanced UAV technology, potentially setting new standards for unmanned systems.

uav.t: NLR developed A* DAA system for drone collision avoidance
uav.body: NLR developed the A* DAA system to improve drone collision avoidance in congested airspace. The system uses an A* path-planning algorithm to recommend optimal routes and course adjustments.
uav.impact: The A* DAA system enhances drone safety and efficiency by providing clear, automated instructions to avoid collisions, crucial for increasing drone traffic.

uav.t: TYTAN developed kinetic Interceptor-S system
uav.body: TYTAN Technologies developed the kinetic Interceptor-S system, which has been successfully integrated into the KNDS-produced BOXER RCT30 turret. This partnership aims to expand mobile C-UAS solutions and set new European defense standards.
uav.impact: The successful integration of the Interceptor-S system into the BOXER platform enhances mobile defense against drone threats, potentially setting new standards in European defense.

uav.t: Thales's Spy'Ranger mini-UAV chosen by French DGA
uav.body: Thales's Spy'Ranger mini-UAV has been selected by the French DGA for reconnaissance. Each system includes three mini-UAVs, a ground segment, and technical support.
uav.impact: The Spy'Ranger's high-resolution imaging and real-time data transmission capabilities enhance situational awareness for French forces.

uav.t: Hanwha Aerospace to develop 1,400 hp engine prototype for MUAV
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace has won a contract to develop a 1,400 hp engine prototype for South Korea's Medium-Altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (MUAV) by 2028. The new engine aims to enhance the MUAV's capabilities as an alternative to the Northrop Grumman RQ-4 Block 30 Global Hawk.
uav.impact: The development of a more powerful engine for the MUAV could significantly improve its operational range and payload capacity, making it a more competitive alternative to existing high-altitude long-endurance UAVs.

uav.t: IAI unveils REX MK II unmanned land platform
uav.body: IAI will unveil the REX MK II at DSEI 2021, an unmanned land vehicle with advanced manoeuvrability and a 1.3-ton load capacity. It is a hybrid electric platform designed for various ground missions.
uav.impact: The REX MK II's advanced capabilities in manoeuvrability, load-carrying, and autonomy could enhance operational flexibility and efficiency for combat and logistical support.

uav.t: Saab demonstrated UAV training system with EXCON software
uav.body: Saab showcased a UAV training system at I/ITSEC 2024, featuring EXCON software and various sensors to enhance realism in military exercises. The system is designed to evaluate warfighters' skills and simulate aerial threats.
uav.impact: The UAV trainer is significant as it provides a cost-effective solution for integrating anti-drone capabilities into existing training systems, crucial for preparing troops against modern drone threats.

uav.t: DragonFire laser weapon successfully tested against aerial target
uav.body: The UK Ministry of Defence successfully tested DragonFire, a laser weapon system, against an aerial target. DragonFire is being developed to shoot down drones and missiles and could be deployed in Ukraine.
uav.impact: The successful test of DragonFire marks a significant step in the development of directed energy weapons, offering a cost-effective and rapid response capability against aerial threats.

uav.t: BAE Systems unveiled the UK's first uncrewed autonomous CCA
uav.body: BAE Systems unveiled the UK's first uncrewed autonomous Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) at the Farnborough International Airshow, designed for advanced technology programmes.
uav.impact: The unveiling of the CCA marks a significant step in the development of autonomous combat aircraft, enhancing the UK's military technological capabilities.

uav.t: Rheinmetall developed Effector RCWS320C-UAS for drone defense
uav.body: Rheinmetall developed the Effector RCWS320C-UAS for defending against unmanned aerial systems (UAS) in both mobile and stationary environments. It integrates quick sensor fusion, automated target acquisition, and flexible LANCE integration to provide reliable drone combat capabilities.
uav.impact: The system's scalable UAS defense capabilities and modular design enable layered defense concepts, enhancing the effectiveness of missions in various operational conditions.

uav.t: Градиент developed a drone countermeasure system
uav.body: Градиент developed a drone countermeasure system called 'Мультик' to counter FPV drones. The system has a detection range of 1000 m and can be installed on various types of equipment, including aircraft and helicopters.
uav.impact: The system provides a significant capability to detect and counter small drones, enhancing aerial security and defense against unmanned threats.

uav.t: Sentrycs Horizon analyzes RF environment for drone countermeasures
uav.body: Sentrycs Horizon is a drone countermeasure system that analyzes RF environments to detect and mitigate drone threats. It supports various communication protocols and provides early warning and actionable intelligence.
uav.impact: Sentrycs Horizon significantly enhances the ability to detect and counter drone threats by analyzing RF signals, offering a proactive approach to drone defense.

uav.t: Project VANQUISH trials jet-powered drones
uav.body: Project VANQUISH is trialling jet-powered drones designed to launch and recover from carriers without catapults or arrestor gear. These drones are part of the broader PANTHEON program to build a Hybrid Carrier Air Wing.
uav.impact: The development of jet-powered drones for carrier operations could enhance the Royal Navy's operational flexibility and reduce risks to crewed aircraft.

uav.t: Euroflir 410 optronics system unveiled for tactical drones
uav.body: Safran Electronics & Defense unveiled the Euroflir 410 optronics system at the Paris Air Show, designed for tactical drones like the Patroller UAV.
uav.impact: The system's development outside U.S. ITAR regulations positions it for international sales, particularly in markets wary of U.S. export restrictions.

uav.t: Rheinmetall's C-sUAS system tested by Austrian Armed Forces
uav.body: Rheinmetall's C-sUAS system was tested by the Austrian Armed Forces, demonstrating its capability to detect and jam various types of small drones.
uav.impact: The successful testing and extension of the lease contract indicate the system's effectiveness in countering a wide range of drone threats, enhancing the Austrian Armed Forces' defense capabilities.

uav.t: Raytheon developed a common ground control system for Predator UAVs
uav.body: Raytheon developed a common ground control system for Predator UAVs, aiming to improve operational efficiency and compatibility with existing infrastructure.
uav.impact: This system is expected to enhance the operational capabilities of Predator UAVs by allowing more operators to manage multiple unmanned aircraft systems.

uav.t: Hanwha showcased THeMIS-K tracked UGV
uav.body: Hanwha Aerospace showcased the THeMIS-K tracked UGV at Seoul ADEX 2025, featuring a remotely controlled weapon station and AI-based teaming technologies. The THeMIS-K is a joint effort with Milrem Robotics to develop tracked RCVs.
uav.impact: The THeMIS-K's advanced features and partnership with Milrem Robotics position Hanwha to compete in global markets for robotic combat vehicles.

uav.t: Leonardo selected to provide PicoSAR AESA radar for Patroller UAV
uav.body: Leonardo was selected to provide its PicoSAR AESA radar for the Patroller UAV used by the French Forces. The radar is designed for long-range, over-land surveillance and detection of moving targets.
uav.impact: The selection of PicoSAR enhances the surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities of the Patroller UAV, providing high-resolution SAR imagery and GMTI data.

uav.t: Anduril introduces Bolt-M autonomous attack drone
uav.body: Anduril has introduced the Bolt-M autonomous attack drone, optimized for usability and safety. It features a high-resolution camera and a simple payload interface, enabling seamless swapping of warheads.
uav.impact: The Bolt-M drone extends the reach of dismounted forces and enhances precision with Lattice software, which filters high-value information and enables swift reaction and precise tracking.

uav.t: Saab developing full-sized unmanned combat aircraft
uav.body: Saab is developing a full-sized unmanned combat aircraft within its next-generation combat aircraft program. The project, named F-series, is expected to fly by 2027 and involves significant initial research and development funding.
uav.impact: This development signifies Sweden's strategic move towards autonomous warfare capabilities, reducing reliance on manned aircraft and enhancing operational flexibility.

uav.t: Rheinmetall pitches unmanned turret as near-term alternative
uav.body: Rheinmetall has proposed an unmanned turret as a near-term alternative to the delayed MGCS. The Concept Unmanned Turret (CUT) is still in early development but could be ready for fielding in the early 2030s.
uav.impact: This unmanned turret offers a potential near-term solution for enhancing tank capabilities while waiting for the MGCS, providing advanced features like a 130mm gun system and active protection systems.

uav.t: Japan developing combat UAVs with US
uav.body: Japan is developing combat UAVs with the US to accompany combat aircraft and detect enemy aircraft and missiles. Prototypes are expected by 2025, with initial flights planned for 2026.
uav.impact: This development aims to enhance Japan's air defense capabilities by integrating UAVs with offensive missile systems, marking a significant step in its military modernization.

uav.t: Sanctum™ system demonstrated with GRIZZLY launcher
uav.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated the Sanctum™ system, which uses advanced AI and cloud computing to detect and track UAVs, and integrates with the GRIZZLY launcher to fire JAGM missiles.
uav.impact: The demonstration highlights Sanctum's capability to address evolving UAS threats, showcasing its modular and scalable design for modern defense needs.

uav.t: HAL CATS Warrior undergoes ground tests with HTFE-25 turbofan
uav.body: HAL's CATS Warrior unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) is being developed with an indigenous HTFE-25 turbofan, which provides enhanced thrust and capabilities. Recent ground tests and impending flight trials for the YFQ-44A Fury by Anduril offer a blueprint for attritable drones, suggesting a similar trajectory for the CATS Warrior.
uav.impact: The development of the CATS Warrior with the HTFE-25 turbofan indicates India's progress in indigenous UCAV technology, enhancing its capabilities in stealth, endurance, and payload.

uav.t: Saab's Ruby UAS nearing first flight
uav.body: Saab's Ruby UAS, a fixed-wing, jet-powered system, is nearing its first flight. Development has faced challenges with wing assembly.
uav.impact: The Ruby UAS, once operational, could offer a low-cost solution for surveillance and reconnaissance missions.

uav.t: Q3 2026 software release improves RF detection and tracking
uav.body: DroneShield announced a Q3 2026 software release for its counter-drone solutions, enhancing RF detection and tracking performance. The release addresses evolving drone threats and operational challenges.
uav.impact: The improvements in RF detection and tracking responsiveness significantly enhance the operational capability of DroneShield's counter-drone systems, making them more effective against sophisticated drone threats.

uav.t: Korean Air and Anduril co-develop Korean-type UAS
uav.body: Korean Air and Anduril are co-developing unmanned aircraft systems for the Asia-Pacific market. This partnership leverages Anduril's AI-driven autonomous systems and Korean Air's expertise in UAS.
uav.impact: The collaboration marks a significant milestone in the global unmanned systems market, enhancing Korean Air's capabilities in autonomous aircraft development.

uav.t: MQ-28 Ghost Bat conducts flights for German procurement
uav.body: The MQ-28 Ghost Bat is conducting flights as it competes for German procurement. Rheinmetall will manage the system in Germany.
uav.impact: This flight activity positions the MQ-28 Ghost Bat as a serious contender for the Bundeswehr's CCA procurement, potentially securing significant revenue for Rheinmetall.

uav.t: PHOBOS robotized carrier for mine clearance demonstrated
uav.body: Nexter and SERA Ingénierie demonstrated the PHOBOS robotized carrier, designed for mine clearance and ensuring operator safety. PHOBOS is a two-ton robot with a one-ton payload capacity.
uav.impact: PHOBOS significantly enhances mine clearance operations by reducing risk to personnel and showcasing advanced robotic capabilities.

uav.t: Completed facility for loitering munition assembly, testing, and warhead production
uav.body: Rheinmetall has completed a facility in Sardinia for the assembly, testing, and warhead production of loitering munitions in cooperation with UVision Air Ltd. The Sardinia sites currently produce three variants of the HERO loitering munition family.
uav.impact: This facility expansion enables Rheinmetall to meet rising demand for loitering munitions, enhancing its capability to supply precision strike systems to military customers.

uav.t: Falco EVO RPAS deployed for maritime surveillance
uav.body: Leonardo deployed its Falco EVO RPAS for maritime surveillance under Frontex's test programme, equipped with advanced sensors. The deployment includes 300 flight hours and may extend into a longer-term agreement.
uav.impact: The deployment showcases Falco EVO's capabilities in extended-range day and night missions, addressing evolving surveillance challenges for maritime borders.

uav.t: Saab demonstrated Sirius Compact L20C sensor
uav.body: Saab demonstrated the Sirius Compact L20C, a mobile passive sensor for tactical surveillance. It can detect, classify, locate, and track signals from drones or troop communications.
uav.impact: The sensor's capability to provide robust signal detection enhances situational awareness and operational flexibility in electromagnetic surveillance.

uav.t: Leonardo DRS demonstrated an advanced electronic warfare system
uav.body: Leonardo DRS demonstrated an advanced electronic warfare system in a DoD counter-UAS competition, showcasing its capability to integrate RF detection and datalink manipulation techniques. The system has been deployed across multiple platforms and operational theaters.
uav.impact: This demonstration highlights Leonardo DRS' ability to rapidly integrate and deploy advanced technologies to counter small UAS threats, reinforcing its leadership in the field of counter-UAS systems.

uav.t: APKWS integrated on TRV-150 UAS
uav.body: BAE Systems has trialled the APKWS on a modified TRV-150 UAS, demonstrating its multirole capability in engaging both air and ground targets.
uav.impact: This integration showcases the TRV-150's versatility and effectiveness in countering emerging UAS threats and traditional targets, offering militaries a highly effective and affordable tactical option.

uav.t: PHOBOS, a multipurpose robotic carrier, demonstrated
uav.body: PHOBOS is a robotic carrier designed for mobility, autonomy, and modular architecture. It can carry one-ton payloads and follow armoured vehicles on various terrains.
uav.impact: PHOBOS offers a versatile platform for military robotics, enhancing operational flexibility and mission adaptability.

uav.t: Garuda Aerospace and Lockheed Martin to develop joint algorithms for drone data processing
uav.body: Garuda Aerospace and Lockheed Martin Canada CDL Services are collaborating to develop joint algorithms for drone data processing. The partnership aims to cater to various drone-based service applications in sectors like defence, agriculture, mining, and industrial inspection.
uav.impact: This collaboration will enhance the capabilities of Indian drones by integrating advanced software solutions, potentially boosting the indigenous defence and aerospace manufacturing ecosystem.

uav.t: Sentrycs unveils version 4.7 with multi-sensor and multi-site management
uav.body: Sentrycs released version 4.7 of its anti-drone technology, featuring multi-sensor capabilities and multi-site management, supporting recent Autel and DJI drones.
uav.impact: This version enhances the ability to manage geographically dispersed sites with poor network conditions, improving the effectiveness of anti-drone systems against evolving threats.

uav.t: Denel's Seeker 400 UAV successfully tested
uav.body: Denel's Seeker 400 UAV has completed successful tests, demonstrating a 16-hour flight duration and the ability to carry dual payloads. It operates at altitudes up to 18,000 ft and is invisible and inaudible at typical operating heights.
uav.impact: The Seeker 400's extended flight time and payload versatility enhance its operational flexibility and intelligence-gathering capabilities, making it a competitive option for military and surveillance applications.

uav.t: ENBATA drone with optimized architecture for robustness and modularity
uav.body: AURA M revealed ENBATA, a multi-mission MALE drone with optimized architecture for robustness, maintenance, and modularity. ENBATA is designed for rapid deployment and can operate in non-segregated airspace.
uav.impact: ENBATA's design and certification for non-segregated airspace operation set it apart from traditional MALE systems, enabling more flexible dual-use missions.

uav.t: Anduril and Archer unveiled a hybrid-electric VTOL platform for defense.
uav.body: Anduril and Archer unveiled a hybrid-electric VTOL platform called Thunder, designed for defense applications. The platform aims to deliver operational value through advanced technologies and has completed multiple test flights.
uav.impact: Thunder represents a significant advancement in vertical lift capabilities, offering speed, range, and payload advantages that could redefine autonomous attack rotorcraft operations.

uav.t: Rheinmetall C-sUAS system tested for drone detection and jamming
uav.body: Rheinmetall's C-sUAS system was tested by the Austrian Armed Forces, demonstrating its capability to detect and jam small drones using a sensor mix and jammers. The system also showed integration with higher-level command and control systems.
uav.impact: The successful testing highlights the system's effectiveness in countering small drones, providing valuable insights for future development and adaptation of anti-drone technologies.

uav.t: MWARI ISR and light attack aircraft enters production
uav.body: Paramount Group's MWARI ISR and light attack aircraft has entered production. The aircraft integrates advanced surveillance, targeting, and precision strike capabilities.
uav.impact: MWARI's production marks a significant capability for intelligence gathering and precision strikes, minimizing collateral damage and enhancing operational flexibility.

uav.t: RapidDestroyer RFDEW downed two UAV swarms
uav.body: Thales UK's RapidDestroyer RFDEW successfully downed two swarms of UAVs in trials. The system was demonstrated by the MoD against UAVs in Wales in December 2024.
uav.impact: This demonstrates the capability of RFDEWs to counter multiple UAV threats simultaneously, enhancing air defence capabilities.

uav.t: Cargo drone with VTOL and modular payload delivery
uav.body: Elroy Air, Inc. is developing a cargo drone named Chaparral with VTOL capabilities and modular payload delivery. It is designed to operate in austere environments without a runway and can achieve an operational range of up to 450 miles.
uav.impact: The Chaparral's multi-mission payload delivery and autonomous capabilities enhance operational throughput and reduce risk for troops in challenging logistics scenarios.

uav.t: Leonardo unveiled Falco Xplorer, a large unmanned air system
uav.body: Leonardo unveiled the Falco Xplorer, its largest unmanned air system, featuring a 1.3 ton MTOW and 350 kg payload capacity. It includes satellite communication capability and a radome for beyond-line-of-sight operations.
uav.impact: The Falco Xplorer significantly expands Leonardo's unmanned capabilities, offering extended endurance and payload capacity for diverse military and civilian applications.

uav.t: Saab and General Atomics developing MQ-9B SkyGuardian as a long-range radar detection drone.
uav.body: Saab and General Atomics are developing the MQ-9B SkyGuardian drone to serve as a long-range radar detection system. The drone will integrate a reduced version of the Erieye radar system and feature three containers, two for radar systems and one for an energy generator.
uav.impact: This development aims to enhance air defense against missile and drone attacks at a lower cost and with greater autonomy compared to piloted aircraft.

uav.t: Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System with high-energy laser and gun
uav.body: DRDO and Adani Defence unveiled a Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System at Aero India 2025, featuring a high-energy laser and a 7.62 mm gun. The system is designed to provide long-range protection and precision against drone threats.
uav.impact: This system significantly enhances India's defence capabilities against asymmetric drone threats, reinforcing its position as a global defence leader.

uav.t: ATHENA laser weapon system engaged and shot down multiple drones
uav.body: Lockheed Martin demonstrated the ATHENA laser weapon system, which successfully engaged and shot down multiple fixed-wing and rotary drones. The system operated in a fully-netted engagement environment with a government C2 system and radar sensor.
uav.impact: The demonstration validates the full kill-chain performance of laser weapons against unmanned aerial systems, a priority for the US Air Force and other branches of the Department of Defense.

uav.t: Nexter Robotics awarded HRS-ROV contract for NERVA® robots
uav.body: Nexter Robotics received a contract for a High Research Secured Remotely Operated Vehicle system, involving the delivery of NERVA®-LG and NERVA®-XX robots. The NERVA®-LG robot is semi-autonomous and can be controlled via standard devices.
uav.impact: The contract highlights Nexter Robotics' capability in developing versatile and autonomous robotic systems for military and security missions, enhancing operational efficiency.

uav.t: Anduril unveiled Thunder, a fully autonomous, armed reconnaissance tiltrotor drone
uav.body: Anduril unveiled Thunder, a fully autonomous, armed reconnaissance tiltrotor drone designed to operate alongside helicopters like the Apache. Thunder can carry up to 10 Hellfires, 16 air-launched effects, and 76 rockets, and is hybrid-electric with advanced AI software.
uav.impact: Thunder represents a significant advancement in unmanned aerial systems, offering enhanced reconnaissance and combat capabilities for maneuver warfare. Its modular design allows for easy transport and storage, enhancing operational flexibility.

uav.t: Anduril delivered a rapid-deployable counter-UAS kit to USNORTHCOM
uav.body: Anduril delivered a rapid-deployable counter-UAS kit to USNORTHCOM, demonstrating its effectiveness at Falcon Peak 25.2. The kit is designed for rapid deployment within U.S. airspace, adhering to FAA regulations.
uav.impact: This delivery marks a significant step in operationalizing mobile counter-UAS defense across the United States, addressing the growing threat of unauthorized drone incursions.

uav.t: Elbit Systems tested Seagull USV with Skylark C UAV
uav.body: Elbit Systems tested its Seagull unmanned surface vehicle (USV) with the Skylark C UAV, providing visual feed to naval forces. This combination aims to enhance intelligence gathering and situational awareness.
uav.impact: This integration of UAV capabilities with USVs represents a significant step in advancing naval surveillance and reconnaissance, offering enhanced operational flexibility and efficiency.

uav.t: Anduril developed Thunder, a hybrid electric tilt-rotor drone
uav.body: Anduril, in partnership with Archer Aviation, developed Thunder, a hybrid electric tilt-rotor drone designed to deliver payloads similar to attack helicopters. Thunder can carry up to 10 Hellfire missiles or AGM-179 Joint Air-to-Ground Missiles, or employ M261 rocket pods with AGR-20 guided rockets.
uav.impact: Thunder's hybrid electric propulsion and payload capacity make it a versatile and potent addition to military drone fleets, offering high-speed and long-range capabilities.

uav.t: Thales developed a system for integrating UASs into live training.
uav.body: Thales launched a system at I/ITSEC 25 that integrates UASs into live training for ground forces, enabling non-kinetic systems to be employed against UASs during exercises.
uav.impact: This system enhances the complexity and realism of live training exercises, reflecting the increasing importance of UASs in modern warfare.

uav.t: GRIZZLY C-UAS system downed a Group 3 drone
uav.body: Lockheed Martin successfully demonstrated its GRIZZLY C-UAS system by downing a Group 3 drone using a Joint Air-to-Ground Missile. The system integrates Fortem R-40 radars and Sanctum battle manager for detection, tracking, and engagement.
uav.impact: This live-fire test showcases the GRIZZLY system's capability to provide rapid and effective defense against unmanned aerial threats, aligning with customer needs for agile and cost-effective solutions.

uav.t: Bayraktar AKINCI conducted its first flight test
uav.body: Baykar Savunma's Bayraktar AKINCI conducted its first flight test on 6 December 2019 at Çorlu Airfield Command. The drone has a payload capacity of 1350 kilograms and is designed to perform tasks typically handled by F-16 fighter jets.
uav.impact: The successful first flight of the Bayraktar AKINCI marks a significant milestone in Turkey's unmanned aerial vehicle capabilities, indicating its readiness to replace certain manned aircraft and perform advanced missions.

uav.t: STARLITE-X UAV became operational
uav.body: STARLITE-X UAV transitioned from development to operational use, becoming a key part of Elbit Systems' UAV operations. Major R. used a UAV to penetrate deep into Iranian airspace.
uav.impact: STARLITE-X's operational deployment signifies Elbit Systems' capability to deploy UAVs for strategic missions deep into enemy territory, enhancing surveillance and combat capabilities.

uav.t: LITENING 5 targeting pod supports UAV intercepts
uav.body: LITENING 5, a widely deployed targeting pod, supports UAV intercepts and is used by 28 air forces. It includes multi-spectral sensors and advanced image processing for precise target designation.
uav.impact: LITENING 5 enhances air forces' capability to counter small aerial threats, providing a precise and cost-effective solution for UAV interception in various weather conditions.

uav.t: India’s first Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System unveiled
uav.body: Adani Defence unveiled India’s first Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System, designed to counter unmanned aerial threats. The system was launched by DRDO’s Director General, BK Das.
uav.impact: This system provides a critical capability for protecting military vehicles from drone-based threats, enhancing operational security and flexibility.

uav.t: IAI unveiled C-UAS Swarm solution for countering UAS/drone swarms
uav.body: IAI unveiled the C-UAS Swarm solution at AUSA 2025, designed to counter UAS and drone swarms. The system was demonstrated to senior Israeli defense officials and is now in use.
uav.impact: The C-UAS Swarm solution enhances Israel's defense against aerial threats by providing advanced detection, disruption, and interception capabilities.

uav.t: Coyote LE SR launched from helicopter
uav.body: Raytheon launched the Coyote LE SR from a helicopter during a test at Nine Mile Training Center, demonstrating its capability to detect and intercept drones. The system uses collaborative autonomy to connect with other sensors and adjust tactics in real-time.
uav.impact: This development enhances military forces' ability to counter evolving drone threats from a helicopter platform, providing a flexible and low-cost solution.

materials.t: Developing specialised grades of high performance armour steel
materials.body: Bisalloy Steel Group is developing specialised grades of high performance armour steel for Rheinmetall's Boxer 8×8 Combat Reconnaissance Vehicles. The qualification process is in the final stages.
materials.impact: This development enhances the protection levels for Boxer CRVs and opens export opportunities for Bisalloy's advanced armour steel.

materials.t: Lockheed awarded $26.3M for high-power fiber laser
materials.body: Lockheed Martin received a $26.3 million contract to develop a high-power fiber laser for fighter aircraft under the SHiELD program. The company aims to test the laser on a fighter jet.
materials.impact: This development advances the integration of high-energy lasers into fighter jets for self-protection, marking a significant step in airborne laser weapon technology.

materials.t: Elbit Systems developed HattoriX
materials.body: Elbit Systems developed HattoriX, a system that enables safe and rapid acquisition of CAT-1 targets at the tactical level. HattoriX includes a Goniometer, mission computer, touch-screen display, and remote-controlled configuration.
materials.impact: HattoriX significantly enhances tactical operations by providing intuitive target acquisition and seamless integration with C2 systems, improving force protection and situational awareness.

materials.t: Raytheon demonstrates NGJ-MB for ground and ship use
materials.body: Raytheon is demonstrating its Next-Generation Jammer Mid-Band (NGJ-MB) for ground and ship use, expanding its non-kinetic capabilities to save on ammunition.
materials.impact: This development allows for versatile electronic attack capabilities on various platforms, reducing reliance on kinetic munitions and enhancing non-kinetic defense options.

materials.t: Nammo developed LEROS 4-ET rocket engine
materials.body: Nammo UK developed the LEROS 4-ET rocket engine, which successfully powered the Blue Ghost lunar lander's trans-lunar injection and landing on the moon in 2025.
materials.impact: The successful landing demonstrates the reliability and capability of Nammo's rocket engines in deep space missions, enhancing their reputation in the space propulsion market.

materials.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates autonomous driving in HX trucks
materials.body: Rheinmetall modified HX trucks and integrated autonomy, testing them in ELROB 2022. They demonstrated convoying and autonomous driving to visitors.
materials.impact: The demonstration highlights Rheinmetall's progress in autonomous vehicle technology, showcasing advanced capabilities in military logistics and convoy operations.

materials.t: Nexter demonstrated FINDADFI connected helmet
materials.body: Nexter showcased the FINDADFI connected helmet at Eurosatory 2016, now a demonstrator. It addresses specific needs of French special forces.
materials.impact: The FINDADFI helmet represents a significant step in integrating advanced communication and sensor technologies for tactical operations.

materials.t: Raytheon completed first RAIVEN sensor flight test
materials.body: Raytheon completed the first flight test of its RAIVEN sensor system aboard a UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter. The system provides 270-degree situational awareness in zero-light conditions using EO/IR technology.
materials.impact: The RAIVEN system enhances mission effectiveness and survivability by offering wide-angle situational awareness, which is crucial for detecting threats in various environments.

materials.t: 3D-printed nylon hatch tested on Gripen
materials.body: Saab tested a 3D-printed nylon hatch on a Gripen fighter to assess battlefield repair capabilities. The hatch was scanned and printed to fit the specific aircraft.
materials.impact: This advance could reduce the need for spare parts and repair time, enhancing operational readiness for deployed fighter aircraft.

materials.t: Leonardo presents the Long Range RAT-31 DL/M digital radar
materials.body: Leonardo showcased the Long Range RAT-31 DL/M digital radar with AESA antenna at FIDAE 2022. The radar is designed to detect fast-moving targets, including ballistic missiles.
materials.impact: This radar system enhances early warning and defense capabilities against fast-moving threats, providing a technological edge in modern warfare scenarios.

materials.t: Leonardo develops MAIR multi-aperture IR system
materials.body: Leonardo is developing the MAIR system, a multi-aperture infrared situational awareness and attack warning system. The system is expected to complete ground trials in 2018 and fly on test bed platforms in early 2019.
materials.impact: MAIR's advanced IR capabilities could enhance situational awareness and missile warning for various aircraft, improving survivability and combat effectiveness.

materials.t: Rheinmetall demonstrates 100kW laser weapon system feasibility
materials.body: Rheinmetall has demonstrated the fundamental feasibility of a 100kW laser weapon system, laying the groundwork for future development. This system is part of their broader efforts in laser weapon technology.
materials.impact: The demonstration marks a significant step towards the practical application of high-power laser systems for defensive purposes, enhancing naval and possibly land-based self-defence capabilities.

materials.t: Rheinmetall tested 50 kW laser weapon
materials.body: Rheinmetall tested a 50 kW laser weapon, capable of piercing steel and hitting drones. The test was conducted in Switzerland.
materials.impact: The successful demonstration of a 50 kW laser weapon highlights Rheinmetall's progress in high-energy laser technology, showcasing potential for future military applications.

materials.t: Yugoimport develops lightest MLRS based on Milosh platform
materials.body: Yugoimport is developing a lightweight MLRS based on the Milosh platform, which was introduced at IDEX 2017. The Milosh platform is a versatile 4x4 armored vehicle praised for its adaptability.
materials.impact: This development represents a significant leap in modern warfare technology, offering enhanced mobility, firepower, and versatility in a lighter form.

materials.t: Uncrewed turret with multiple weapon calibres demonstrated
materials.body: Lockheed Martin UK and Eraf unveiled an uncrewed turret at WDS 2026, featuring a 30 mm Bushmaster gun and a Javelin missile. Live fire tests with 30 mm ammunition are scheduled to start in Saudi Arabia.
materials.impact: The demonstration highlights the turret's flexibility with various weapon systems, enhancing its potential for integration into diverse combat roles.

materials.t: Rheinmetall and MBDA deliver laser demonstrator for testing
materials.body: Rheinmetall and MBDA have delivered a laser demonstrator to the Bundeswehr for testing on a Type 124-class frigate, including over 100 firing trials.
materials.impact: The demonstrator shows potential for countering UAVs, UAV swarms, and speedboats, complementing traditional weapons systems and paving the way for future operational laser systems by 2029.

materials.t: Trailblazer vehicle vision system delivered for MLRS A2
materials.body: Rheinmetall UK will deliver prototypes of the Trailblazer vehicle vision system for the UK's MLRS A2 vehicle upgrade in early 2026, with main production starting later that year.
materials.impact: The Trailblazer system, compliant with SIL-2 and DEF STAN standards, enhances vehicle manoeuvrability and crew effectiveness in complex environments, standardizing capabilities across the British combat vehicle fleet.

materials.t: Saab developed ARCASe reversible thermal camouflage
materials.body: Saab introduced ARCASe, a reversible thermal camouflage screen offering multispectral protection. It allows users to choose between different visible patterns and thermal signatures.
materials.impact: ARCASe enhances vehicle and asset protection in dynamic environments, providing a tactical advantage by effectively masking thermal signatures.

materials.t: Developing adaptive camouflage materials for soldier and vehicle protection
materials.body: Rheinmetall is developing adaptive camouflage materials for soldier and vehicle protection, funded by the European Union. The project aims to use innovative and current technologies to adapt signatures to the background and surveillance sensors.
materials.impact: This development could significantly enhance the stealth capabilities of land systems, providing tactical advantages in diverse environments.

materials.t: Lockheed Martin tests paraffin-fueled hybrid motor
materials.body: Lockheed Martin successfully tested a paraffin-fueled hybrid motor, demonstrating its potential for improved propulsion performance. The test firing met objectives for hybrid fuel development.
materials.impact: This test highlights paraffin's higher regression rate compared to HTPB, offering potential for enhanced hybrid propulsion in future applications.

materials.t: Developing domestic TFLN wafers
materials.body: Raytheon is developing a domestic production capability for TFLN wafers, foundational in high-performance communications and sensing technology, in collaboration with G&H.
materials.impact: This development aims to reduce reliance on a single Chinese supplier and enhance the quality and security of critical materials for US defence applications.

materials.t: Saab developed Barracuda Poncho for thermal stealth
materials.body: Saab developed the Barracuda Poncho to align soldiers' thermal signatures with the environment, providing static stealth against thermal sensors. It is designed to boost personnel survivability in combat zones with advanced surveillance systems.
materials.impact: The Barracuda Poncho enhances soldier survivability by masking body heat and allowing personnel to remain hidden from thermal imaging systems, making it a critical element in special operations and reconnaissance missions.

materials.t: L3Harris evolves BNVD-Fused night vision goggles
materials.body: L3Harris is advancing the BNVD-Fused night vision goggles, integrating white phosphor and thermal technologies. These goggles are used by special forces and NATO allies, providing superior situational awareness.
materials.impact: The BNVD-Fused system enhances warfighters' ability to target and neutralize threats quickly, giving them a significant advantage in low-light conditions.

materials.t: Leonardo and Thales demonstrated missile protection system
materials.body: Leonardo and Thales demonstrated an end-to-end missile warning and protection system in live-fire trials, showing its effectiveness against multiple heat-seeking missiles. The system, consisting of Leonardo's Miysis DIRCM and Thales' Elix-IR, successfully detected, tracked, and jammed incoming threats.
materials.impact: This demonstration highlights the system's capability to protect against MANPADS, a significant threat to ground targets, potentially enhancing the security of military and civilian aircraft.

materials.t: Raytheon showcases Silent Guardian non-lethal system
materials.body: Raytheon is showcasing the Silent Guardian non-lethal system at SOFEX 2012, which uses millimeter wave energy to repel individuals without causing injury.
materials.impact: The Silent Guardian system offers a non-injurious method for crowd control and infrastructure protection, enhancing security measures without risk of harm.

materials.t: Rheinmetall to develop lightweight high performance materials
materials.body: Rheinmetall Defence Australia will develop lightweight high performance materials for military applications through its new TECLAB in Melbourne. The research will be conducted in partnership with CSIRO and Swinburne University.
materials.impact: This development aims to enhance the performance and efficiency of military vehicles and equipment, potentially leading to lighter, more agile, and cost-effective systems.

materials.t: DRDO develops indigenous Electronic Warfare Suite for LCH Prachand
materials.body: DRDO has developed an indigenous Electronic Warfare Suite for the LCH Prachand, reducing reliance on foreign systems like Saab’s IDAS. The suite enhances the helicopter’s survivability in modern combat.
materials.impact: This development marks a significant step towards self-reliance in critical defence technologies, improving the LCH Prachand's operational capabilities and reducing dependence on imported subsystems.

materials.t: Saab demonstrates Giraffe AMB D radar
materials.body: Saab demonstrated the Giraffe AMB D radar at Eurosatory 2026, featuring AESA hardware and a modern software architecture. It provides enhanced situational awareness and continuous upgrade capabilities.
materials.impact: The Giraffe AMB D radar's advanced design and software-defined architecture enable it to meet evolving operational requirements, offering improved air surveillance and threat detection.

materials.t: AI device CADS for ALR-69A radar warning
materials.body: Raytheon unveiled CADS, an AI device that can be retrofitted into the ALR-69A radar warning receiver to enhance its capabilities against reprogrammable digital radars.
materials.impact: CADS allows real-time analysis and identification of radar signals, improving the survivability of US aircrews by countering rapidly reconfiguring threats.

materials.t: Leonardo tested miniaturized radar warning tech
materials.body: Leonardo has tested miniaturized radar warning receiver (RWR) technology, which is four times as accurate as existing sensors and one-tenth the size, with reduced power requirements.
materials.impact: This advance could enable more effective and compact radar warning systems, enhancing aircraft survivability and situational awareness.

materials.t: SSAB announced Armox 500 AM Powder for 3D printing
materials.body: SSAB announced Armox 500 AM Powder for 3D printing at Eurosatory2026, which has undergone ballistic and blast testing. This powder allows engineers to tailor internal structures for specific threats and optimise weight distribution.
materials.impact: The new powder extends SSAB’s position in armour steel into additive manufacturing, offering design freedom and potentially reducing production costs and lead times.

materials.t: Lockheed Martin delivers AHEL laser weapon for AC-130J
materials.body: Lockheed Martin has completed factory acceptance testing and delivered the Airborne High Energy Laser (AHEL) for integration with the AC-130J gunship. The AHEL is set for ground and flight testing.
materials.impact: The AHEL's integration with the AC-130J enhances its capability to defend against various targets, marking a significant milestone in directed energy weapon technology.

materials.t: NGI second-stage motor passed burst test
materials.body: Lockheed Martin's NGI second-stage motor completed a burst test, validating its strength and composite materials. The test involved inflating a carbon-fiber reinforced water vessel beyond expected launch pressures.
materials.impact: This milestone ensures the motor can withstand extreme conditions, advancing NGI's development.

materials.t: Giraffe 1X radar demonstrated without GPS timing
materials.body: Saab and the Royal Navy demonstrated the Giraffe 1X radar network operating without GPS timing in a UK quantum trial, showcasing resilience in contested operations.
materials.impact: This capability enhances the radar's operational flexibility and reliability in environments where GPS signals may be jammed or unavailable.

materials.t: Developing autonomous version of Stallion truck
materials.body: Ashok Leyland is developing an autonomous version of its Stallion truck for the Indian Armed Forces. This initiative aims to enhance operational efficiency and reduce risks to personnel.
materials.impact: The autonomous Stallion truck represents a significant engineering challenge and could set new benchmarks for indigenous defence manufacturing in the coming years.

materials.t: Developing domestic production of thin film lithium niobate
materials.body: Raytheon was awarded a contract to develop domestic production of thin film lithium niobate (TFLN) for defense and commercial applications. G&H will manufacture TFLN wafers starting in early 2026.
materials.impact: This development ensures a secure, domestic supply of TFLN, enhancing supply chain resilience for both defense and commercial sectors.

materials.t: BAE Systems to demonstrate new RFCM system
materials.body: BAE Systems will demonstrate a new radio frequency countermeasure (RFCM) system for the P-8A Poseidon aircraft. The system is designed to provide self-protection capabilities and will undergo flight testing in early 2021.
materials.impact: The RFCM system will enhance the P-8A Poseidon's ability to protect against RF missile threats, improving its survivability in combat scenarios.

materials.t: Hanwha unveils prototype engine design
materials.body: Hanwha unveiled a prototype engine design at the Farnborough Airshow, aiming to power the KF-21 fighter and unmanned systems within a decade. The engine features a six-stage compressor and a thrust range of 15,000-18,000 pounds.
materials.impact: This development marks a significant step towards domestic production of advanced military jet engines, reducing reliance on foreign suppliers.

materials.t: Developed additive-manufactured fluid storage device
materials.body: Nammo Space developed an additively manufactured fluid storage device for CubeSat propulsion systems, integrating a plenum tank and ports within a compact 1U x 1U x 0.2U envelope.
materials.impact: This development allows for tighter control of fuel state and cleaner final product, enhancing the efficiency and reliability of CubeSat propulsion systems.

materials.t: Nammo develops 220N Hydrogen Peroxide monopropellant thruster
materials.body: Nammo is developing a 220N Hydrogen Peroxide monopropellant thruster with a silver catalyst. The thruster uses 87.5% concentration H2O2 and has a total impulse of over 200,000 Ns.
materials.impact: This development represents a significant advancement in green propulsion technology, enhancing the performance and efficiency of attitude control systems for launchers and spacecraft.

materials.t: Rheinmetall launched Mobile Smart Factory for battlefield 3D printing
materials.body: Rheinmetall introduced the Mobile Smart Factory, a system of two shipping containers for on-site 3D printing and post-processing of metal parts, including quality control and documentation.
materials.impact: This capability enhances battlefield readiness by enabling rapid production of spare parts, reducing dependency on supply chain logistics.

materials.t: Demonstrated wearable technologies for infantry
materials.body: The DDR&D demonstrated wearable technologies for infantry soldiers, focusing on lethality, survivability, and team synergy. The demonstration included networked warfare technologies and communications.
materials.impact: The demonstration highlights advancements in soldier modernization, enhancing combat effectiveness and situational awareness.

materials.t: Developing a 100-kilowatt laser for Army
materials.body: Raytheon won a $10 million contract to develop a 100-kilowatt laser for the Army’s High Energy Laser Tactical Vehicle Demonstration program. The program aims to integrate the laser into the Indirect Fire Protection Capability Increment 2.
materials.impact: This development could enhance the Army's capability to protect against indirect fire threats with a high-energy laser system, demonstrating advancements in directed energy weapons.
